plugins.readme_text:
> 🕒 v3 · 2026-10-08 20:40 · dsh-agent ｜ 变更：诚实化定位（中文字体支持来自 SciencePlots）+ 新增效果截图区 ｜ 上一版：v2 · 2026-10-08 20:28

# sci-figures — 科研作图技能包（DSH Skill）

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的科研作图技能：从「这张图要证明什么」到成图，含期刊样式工具箱、四个可复用图式、六条出图路线实测对比。

**它做什么**：把科研出图的**图式**（怎么用图形讲一句话）和**踩坑**固化成可复用资产，并在 [SciencePlots](https://github.com/garrettj403/SciencePlots) 之上封装一个默认栈（字体回退链 + 关掉 `text.usetex` 冲突 + 矢量字体嵌入 + 色盲安全配色）。

> ⚠️ **中文字体支持主要来自 SciencePlots 的 `cjk-sc-font`**（其官方文档已支持简体中文），本技能做的是在其之上少踩坑，**不是它的替代品**。本技能独有的部分是**五个图式**与**踩坑清单**。

## 装

本仓库根目录**就是**技能目录。clone 后放进 DSH 的**用户级技能根**：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-sci-figures.git
cp -r dsh-sci-figures ~/.dsh/skills/sci-figures
```

Windows（PowerShell）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/yanggaihao5-sys/dsh-sci-figures.git
Copy-Item -Recurse dsh-sci-figures "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\skills\sci-figures"
```

依赖（按需，缺了会自动回退不报错）：

```bash
pip install scienceplots matplotlib            # 期刊样式（推荐）
pip install plotly kaleido plotnine altair vl-convert-python   # 可选：另外五条路线
```

## 有什么

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `SKILL.md` | 技能主文件：五步流程、硬规则、命名约定、更新协议 |
| `scripts/mpl_style.py` | 工具箱：`use()` / `save()` / `save_pgf()` / `PALETTE` + 四个图式函数 |
| `references/图式库.md` | 图式库：钉子 · 阶梯 · 滑轴 · 魔方串烧（append-only，持续追加实例） |
| `references/工具链.md` | 六条出图路线实测对比（SciencePlots / pgf / TikZ / Plotly / Plotnine / Altair）+ 实测坑 |

## 效果

示例图全部由 `examples/make_examples.py` 用固定 seed 生成，**可复跑**（不是手放的死图）：

| 钉子（钉住关键点） | 阶梯（分阶段抬升 + 事件标注） |
|---|---|
| ![钉子](examples/fig1_nail.png) | ![阶梯](examples/fig2_staircase.png) |

| 滑轴（断轴看全貌 + 尾部） | 魔方串烧（多快照共享色标） |
|---|---|
| ![滑轴](examples/fig3_sliding.png) | ![魔方串烧](examples/fig4_cube_skewer.png) |

复跑：

```bash
python examples/make_examples.py
```

## 自检

```bash
python scripts/mpl_style.py     # 四个图式各出一张，验证工具箱可用
```

## 一句话选法

- 图里有**中文**（中文期刊 / 毕业论文）→ 本技能，`use()` 已处理字体回退与 usetex 冲突
- 论文是 **LaTeX** 写的 → 再出 `.pgf`（`save_pgf()`），字体与正文完全一致
- 纯英文 + 目标是 Nature/CNS 系版式 → 用第三方 `nature-figure` 类技能

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-kidlab · 给小朋友的电脑启蒙插件系列

[![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-coder](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-coder?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-coder&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-coder) [![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-sysmon](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-sysmon?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-sysmon&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-sysmon) [![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-network](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-network?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-network&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-network) [![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-storage](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-storage?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-storage&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-storage) [![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-memory](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-memory?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-memory&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-memory) [![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-security](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-security?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-security&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-security) [![npm @kidlab/dsh-kid-process](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-process?label=%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-process&color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-process)

给 **DeepSeek Harness**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`，Cordis 插件框架）写的一整**系列**插件，
用小朋友听得懂的话 + 能动手玩的卡片，把「电脑里到底在发生什么」讲明白。

统一命名空间 `@kidlab/*`。**一个仓库 = 一个系列**：每个插件一个子目录，新增插件就是加一个目录。

> 📦 **已发布到 npm**：7 个包均在 <https://www.npmjs.com/org/kidlab> 下（`@kidlab/dsh-kid-*@0.2.0`）。装法见下方「安装 → C」。
> `npm i @kidlab/dsh-kid-coder` / `dsh plugin --profile web add @kidlab/dsh-kid-coder`

## 系列成员（第一批 7 个）

| # | 插件 | 吉祥物 | 讲什么 | 模型工具 | 形态 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [**kid-coder**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-coder) | 🐵 | 编程启蒙：真的把 Python/海龟画图跑起来 | `kid_run` `kid_explain` `kid_practice` `kid_review` `kid_steps` | ✅ 单包 bundle（工具+卡片） |
| 2 | [**kid-sysmon**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-sysmon) | 🐻 | 电脑体检：CPU/内存/磁盘/网络/电池/负载/进程 | `system_status` | ✅ 单包 bundle（工具+体检卡片） |
| 3 | [**kid-network**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-network) | 🕊️ | 网络 = 信鸽邮局：身份 / 送信 / 测速 | `net_my_identity` `net_dns` `net_trace_trip` `net_test_speed` `net_who_is_home` | ✅ 单包 bundle（工具+卡片） |
| 4 | [**kid-storage**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-storage) | 🐿️ | 存储 = 电脑的大仓库 / 长期记忆 | `storage_boxes` `storage_home` `storage_heavy` | ✅ 单包 bundle |
| 5 | [**kid-memory**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-memory) | 🦉 | 内存 = 电脑的工作台 / 短期记忆 | `mem_now` `mem_pressure` `mem_workbench` `mem_top` | ✅ 单包 bundle（工具+卡片） |
| 6 | [**kid-security**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-security) | 🐕 | 电脑安全 = 城堡守卫 | `sec_wall` `sec_lock` `sec_locker` `sec_door` `sec_login` | ✅ 单包 bundle |
| 7 | [**kid-process**](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40kidlab%2Fdsh-kid-process) | 🐝 | 进程 = 工作台上干活的小工人 | `proc_count` `proc_busiest` `proc_family` `proc_badge` | ✅ 单包 bundle |

> 隐喻是成体系的：**内存 = 工作台（短期）** ↔ **存储 = 大仓库（长期）**；**进程 = 工作台上干活的小工人**；**网络 = 信鸽邮局**；**安全 = 城堡守卫**。

## 卡片长什么样（演示）

每个插件在对话输入框上方都有一个**可折叠卡片**：平时只留一行摘要，点标题展开看明细。
下面是 7 张卡片的**真实录屏动图**（不是截图拼的）：

| 插件 | 演示 |
|---|---|
| 🐵 **kid-coder** · 跑代码 | ![kid-coder](docs/kid-coder-demo.gif) |
| 🐻 **kid-sysmon** · 电脑体检 | ![kid-sysmon](docs/kid-sysmon-demo.gif) |
| 🕊️ **kid-network** · 信鸽邮局 | ![kid-network](docs/kid-network-demo.gif) |
| 🐿️ **kid-storage** · 仓库大管家 | ![kid-storage](docs/kid-storage-demo.gif) |
| 🦉 **kid-memory** · 记忆小管家 | ![kid-memory](docs/kid-memory-demo.gif) |
| 🐕 **kid-security** · 城堡安检 | ![kid-security](docs/kid-security-demo.gif) |
| 🐝 **kid-process** · 工人点名 | ![kid-process](docs/kid-process-demo.gif) |

> `README 里放 GIF` 的意思就是——**首页放一小段几秒的录屏动图**，让人不用装就能一眼看到卡片真实的样子和交互。

## 系列约定（保证「一眼是同一套」）

- **命名**：包名一律 `@kidlab/dsh-kid-<名字>`；patch 行 id 一律 `kid-<名字>`；卡片槽位一律 `conversation.input.dock`。
- **形态**：优先**单包 bundle**——一个包同时提供 host 工具与 client 卡片（`index.js` + `tools.js` + `client.js` + `cordis.patch.yml`），零构建、纯 ESM。
- **版本**：整批对齐（当前目标 `0.2.0`）。
- **元数据**：每个包都带 `license`、`keywords`（含 `dsh-plugin`）、`dsh.bundle`、`dsh.client`。
- **不 import `@deepseek-ai/*`**：工具用 JSON-schema 普通对象交给 `ctx.tools.register`，client 只从模块表 `require('react')`——这样 bundle 能独立安装。

## 安装（任选其一）

```bash
# A. 用包名/路径装进某个 profile（推荐，持久）
dsh plugin --profile web add /本仓库/plugins/kid-coder
#   （或在 agent 会话里：plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<路径>" }）

# B. 从 GitHub 安装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:baixiaoustc/dsh-kidlab#path:plugins/kid-coder

# C. 从 npm 安装（已发布，按包名最省事）
dsh plugin --profile web add @kidlab/dsh-kid-coder
#   或直接： npm i @kidlab/dsh-kid-coder
#   其余同理：@kidlab/dsh-kid-{sysmon,network,storage,memory,security,process}
```

装完**首次需要重启 `dsh web`**（进客户端模块表），之后改内容只要刷新页面。
每个插件目录里的 `README.md` 有各自的细节与配置项。

## 许可

MIT。详见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH: W2M — one DeepSeek account, one instruction, every online Windows/macOS machine runs the same project. Rabbit relay + per-machine Localside + eight DSH tools. Accounts are isolated per fleet, devices sign with Ed25519 keys, and /run works from a WeChat window.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH: Windows2MacOS

**One DeepSeek account. One instruction. Every machine you own runs the same project.**

[![CI](https://github.com/TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4c6ef5)](#1-dsh-plugin-recommended--zero-configuration)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE)
[![platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/CI-windows%20%7C%20macos%20%7C%20linux-4c6ef5)](#verified-and-not-verified)

English | [中文](#中文说明)

---

## Install

Five routes in. They all end with **16 tools registered** in your agent. Pick one.

### 1. DSH plugin (recommended — zero configuration)

```bash
# 1. install the package into your DSH profile
dsh plugin add @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin

# 2. name it in the profile's bundle list — a package that is not bundled never loads
#    ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/dsh.profile.yml
plugins:
  - '@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin'

# 3. restart DSH; joining happens at mount time, so a hot reload is not enough
```

Since **1.1.15** the agent starts by itself (`autoStartAgent` defaults to `true`): a freshly installed machine
derives its account identity, joins the account's fleet, and shows up in `w2m_devices` with no pairing step.
To turn that off, patch the **existing** `w2m` row — do not add a second one:

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml
- id: w2m
  config:
    autoStartAgent: false
```

### 2. npm (MCP server, any client)

```bash
npm install -g @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin
w2m-mcp --help
```

Point any MCP client at `w2m-mcp`. **Zero runtime dependencies**; the package ships the relay, the agent and the
tools.

### 3. Claude Code

```bash
/plugin marketplace add TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos
/plugin install w2m@twinsearth
```

The manifests live in [`.claude-plugin/`](.claude-plugin/) and are version-locked to the release.

### 4. Codex and other MCP-capable CLIs

```toml
# copy this block into your own codex/mcp-servers.toml
[mcp_servers.w2m]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin@1.1.19", "w2m-mcp"]
```

### 5. Verified release tarball (offline)

From the `v1.1.19` release page download **both** files — `twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-1.1.19.tgz` and `SHA256SUMS` —
then:

```bash
curl -LO https://github.com/TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos/releases/download/v1.1.19/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-1.1.19.tgz
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS          # verify before installing, always
npm install -g ./twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-1.1.19.tgz
```

Every release carries `SHA256SUMS` for exactly this reason. If a release is missing it, do not install that release.

### 6. Beta (prerelease — never on npm)

A beta is a **GitHub prerelease**, not an npm version. Nothing about it is resolved by `npm install`, and `latest` never
points at one. It exists for a developer who has been granted `beta-access` and accepts that it can break.

```bash
# 1. find the newest prerelease (a beta is marked "Pre-release" on the releases page)
#    https://github.com/TwinsEarth/dsh-windows2macos/releases  -> latest entry labelled Pre-release
# 2. download BOTH files attached to it: twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-<version>.tgz and SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS          # verify before installing, always
npm install -g ./twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-<version>.tgz
```

- **Access**: the beta workflow waits on the protected `beta-access` environment, so a reviewer must approve each run
  before the artifact exists at all.
- **Risk acknowledgment**: install it only if you have read [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and accept that a beta may fail
  where a stable release does not.
- **Going back**: `npm install -g @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin@latest` returns you to the stable channel.
- **Why not npm**: there is no `npm publish` line in the beta workflow. A channel cannot leak into the default install if
  the publication cannot happen at all.


---

## Quick start

```text
w2m_status                       # am I paired? which fleet?
w2m_devices                      # what is in the fleet?
w2m_run mode="replicate" command_argv=["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]
w2m_wait task_id="..."
```

`replicate` runs on every online machine; the verdict is `consistent` only when every machine returned the same
result **and** the same commit anchor. `split` gives each machine a slice, `pipeline` chains stages, `broadcast`
names one executor and reports observers, `compose` merges results.

---

## What it is

An installable plugin that turns a set of machines into **one fleet**, keyed by **your account**, not by a
hand-maintained host list.

| Piece | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| **Relay** | a small HTTP server: task routing, leases, SSE, blob storage. Run it anywhere your machines can reach. |
| **Agent** | runs on each machine: pairs once, executes allow-listed commands, heartbeats. |
| **Plugin** | the tools your agent calls. |
| **Admission** (1.1.14+) | a new machine asks to join; an online member approves, **10 s auto-approves**, and a machine admitted in the last 24 h can be removed immediately. |

### Tools

`w2m_status` · `w2m_devices` · `w2m_run` · `w2m_wait` · `w2m_history` · `w2m_stats` · `w2m_report` ·
`w2m_memory` · `w2m_approvals` · `w2m_cancel` · `w2m_council` · `w2m_chat` · `w2m_update` `w2m_tasks` · `w2m_reduce`
- `w2m_intent` — map a structured intent (run-tests, node-version, git-status, git-head, fleet-facts, shard-probe) onto an allow-listed command; unknown intents are refused by name, never guessed.

### Environment a dispatched command receives (1.1.15+)

Values come from the offer, never from argv, so one machine cannot reshape a fleet-wide split.

| Variable | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `W2M_INDEX` / `W2M_INDEX_TOTAL` | this machine's slice number and how many slices exist |
| `W2M_STAGE_INDEX` | the pipeline stage; deliberately separate from `W2M_INDEX` |
| `W2M_TASK_ID` / `W2M_MODE` | the task and its mode |
| `W2M_MACHINE_ID` / `W2M_MACHINE_NAME` | this machine |

So `command_argv=["node","-e","process.exit(Number(process.env.W2M_INDEX)+1)"]` over four machines exits 1/2/3/4.
Single-machine behaviour is tested; the four-machine run is listed as **not verified** below.

---

## Fleet model

Identity is **the account**, not a list of hosts. A machine derives an Ed25519 identity from its account
material; the relay registers the matching public key when the account's first machine pairs; every later machine
proves the same account with a one-time signed challenge.

If the old pairing path fails for a **named** reason only — invalid pairing code, unreachable relay, timeout — the
machine falls back to asking for admission. Any other failure needs a human and does **not** change mechanisms. A
rejection is final; the machine does not re-ask.

The relay is authoritative for every time window and every quorum, because client clocks disagree (measured:
tens of seconds between machines in one fleet):

- **10 s** without a decision auto-approves, but only while at least one member is **online** — an empty fleet
  cannot consent, and that refusal is named (`NO_ONLINE_MEMBER`);
- within **24 h** of admission, any online member may remove the machine immediately;
- after 24 h a single machine may only **open a vote**, whose quorum set is **frozen at open time** so a voter
  going offline mid-vote cannot move the bar;
- the quorum is 3+ old members need **≥ 50 %** (rounded up); a two-member fleet needs **one** vote;
- a machine offline for more than **72 hours** leaves the **list** — it is never deleted, its records stay, and it
  returns by reporting again.

---

## Security posture

- The command allow-list is **argv-prefix** based and rejects argv-reparsing flags (`--import`, appended `-e`) with
  `COMMAND_REPARSE_ARGUMENT`. It is a boundary, not a sandbox.
- Dispatching tasks requires an operator token.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plan-mode-plus

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）计划模式的 ZCode 式增强插件。基于官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode` 的状态机（`plan/mode` 事件 + `plan` 投影），把计划模式补齐到 [ZCode](https://github.com/zai-org/ZCode) 开源实现的形态，新增三件事：

| 能力 | 说明 | 对应 ZCode 原件 |
|---|---|---|
| `enter_plan_mode` 工具 | 模型判断任务非平凡时主动请求进入计划模式，无参数、立即生效 | `EnterPlanMode`（`contracts/src/tools/plan-mode.ts`） |
| 硬拦截 | 计划模式期间，写类工具在分发前被 `ctx.tools.guard()` 直接拒绝，拒绝文案逐字取自 ZCode：`Plan mode only allows read-only, non-destructive tools` | `checkPlanMode()`（`permission/service.ts`） |
| 四阶段工作流提示词 | 仅计划模式活跃时渲染的 `plan:workflow-plus` 提示词节：探索 → 设计 → 评审 → `exit_plan_mode` | `buildPlanWorkflow()`（`runtime-reminders.ts`） |

**退出仍走官方 `exit_plan_mode`**（计划评审 UI、Approve / Keep planning + 反馈回流原样保留），`/plan` / `/plan off` 命令与 composer 蓝色 Plan chip 也原样可用——本插件只做增量，不替代官方任何部件。

客户端 half 在会话标题栏加一个"计划模式"胶囊按钮：未开启时点击执行 `/plan` 进入，开启时高亮并点击执行 `/plan off` 退出，切换排队期显示"生效中…"。与官方 chip 分工：chip 管"活跃指示 + 退出"，本按钮补"一键进入"。

## 安装

```bash
# Git Bash，桌面版（先完全退出 DeepSeek Harness 主程序）
ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 "/d/DeepSeek Harness/DeepSeek Harness.exe" \
  --expose-internals \
  "D:/DeepSeek Harness/resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host/lib/cli.js" \
  plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plan-mode-plus
```

`add` 后面也可以是本地 tgz 路径（`file:D:/.../dsh-plan-mode-plus-x.y.z.tgz`）或 Git 仓库地址。安装完成后重启主程序即可。

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 的 insert 行携带默认配置（denylist 逐名核实自 app.asar 内各官方 `dsh-tool-*` 的 `defineTool` 定义）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: plan-mode-plus
      name: dsh-plan-mode-plus
      config:
        enforce: true          # false = 回到官方"纯引导"行为，只留工具与提示词节
        denyTools:             # 计划模式期间被硬拦截的模型侧工具名
          - bash               # ZCode 的 Bash（write + destructive）
          - pwsh
          - write              # ZCode 的 Write
          - edit               # ZCode 的 Edit
          - str_replace_editor # ZCode 的 ApplyPatch 对应物
```

覆盖方式：在你的 profile 层（`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`）加同名 id 的 config 行，或直接改本插件 bundle 行的 config。未知配置键会在启动时报错（风格对齐官方 plan-mode 的 `resolveConfig`）。

**放行侧**（对齐 ZCode 的只读分类）：`read` / `read_image` / `glob` / `grep`、`web_search` / `web_fetch`、`todo_write`、`ask_user_question`、`skill`、`present`、goal 系列、`subagent`、`send_message` / `interrupt_agent`，以及全部 MCP 工具（ZCode 放行非破坏性 MCP）。想要更严的部署把 `subagent`、`subagent_fork` 加进 denyTools 即可堵住"子代理代写"的口子。

## 与官方 plan-mode 的关系

- **状态机完全复用官方**：本插件不追加任何新事件类型，进入计划模式 = 直接追加官方词汇表内的 `plan/mode` 事件（`KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` 内），plan 投影折叠出 `active=true` 后，官方 `plan:policy` 提示词节、`/plan off`、`exit_plan_mode` 评审流、UI chip 全部同步生效，双向兼容。
- **读状态走共享投影**：`sessionProjections.stateOf(session, 'plan')`。web/desktop 表面里 host 平面的官方 plan-mode 条目被 dsh-web-app 补丁 disable、`planMode` 服务按 agent preset 逐会话挂载在隔离域——因此本插件刻意不触碰 `planMode` 服务实例，只依赖全局可见的投影与会话日志，host 平面全局注册即对所有会话生效。
- **会话没挂官方 plan-mode 时**（如部分 headless preset）：`stateOf` 返回 `undefined`，工具报错、guard 与提示词节自动失活，不会让会话创建失败。

## 与 ZCode 的对齐点与有意偏离

1. **进入免审批**：ZCode 的 `EnterPlanMode` 描述写着 "REQUIRES user approval"，但实际实现是 `needsApproval: false` 自动放行（描述与实现不一致）。本插件跟实现不跟描述——进入计划模式完全可逆（`/plan off` 即回），无需打断用户。
2. **立即生效 vs step 边界**：官方 `planMode.set()` 在轮次中把切换排队到下一个 accepted pre-step；本工具直接追加事件立即生效（ZCode 的 EnterPlanMode 同款）。代价：若本次调用所在步骤之后被中止，"已进入计划模式"仍然成立——可逆，接受。
3. **硬拦截**：官方立场是 "Guidance, not enforcement"（工具目录保持不变、全靠文本约束）。guard 是本插件主动做出的加强；拒绝发生在分发前，不改工具目录，对请求缓存友好。ZCode 把 `TodoWrite` 归为只读，这里同样放行 `todo_write`（官方 plan-mode 引导词明确规划阶段不要用它，纪律交给文本）。
4. **提示词注入机制**：ZCode 每 5 个回合以 runtime reminder 重注入工作流（全量/精简交替）；dsh 的对应机制是条件化 system prompt section（`text` 回调按当前模式现算、非活跃返回空串），与官方 `plan:policy` 同机制、对请求缓存同样友好。
5. **子代理不剔除计划工具**：ZCode 从子代理工具面剔除 EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode（子代理没有计划评审恢复面）；dsh 里子代理会话独立，`enter_plan_mode` 只影响子代理自己的会话、不波及父会话，故不做剔除。

## 构建

```bash
pnpm install   # 或 npm install
npm run build  # tsc + esbuild（宿主 ESM / 客户端懒 CJS 工厂）+ disable-eval 补丁
npm pack
```

要求 Node ≥ 24。peerDependencies 锁 `@deepseek-ai/*` `0.2.0-rc.2`（开发者预览版本，升级宿主后需同步验证）。构建产物零运行时 npm 依赖；`scripts/disable-eval.mjs` 用于剥离打包进来的 Schemastery 字符串回调求值分支（零 eval 产物）。

## 已验证

- headless（plugtest profile）端到端：`enter_plan_mode` 调用 → 工具结果渲染 ZCode 原文 → 计划模式下 shell 工具被拦截并返回逐字拒绝文案 → 工作流四阶段标题被模型逐字引用。
- web（plugweb profile）浏览器实测：标题栏按钮进入/退出计划模式，官方 Plan chip 随投影同步出现/消失。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: NoName Agent Harness as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: context as an asset — append-only evidence, versioned memory, taste as a first-class citizen, audited approvals.
plugins.readme_text:
# NoName for DeepSeek Harness

**让下一次对话，接得上这一次的判断。**

NoName 为 DSH 工作区带来可追溯的项目记忆：决定与理由、当前进度、经过确认的品味，以及能看懂、能审核的本地账本。项目沿用 [NoName Agent Harness](https://github.com/yuchenlogin/NoNameAgentHarness) 的记忆基座，以 TypeScript 插件连接本地 Python sidecar。

正常工作时留下来路；重要阶段提出少量候选；你确认后，下一次上下文包带上当前版本。**工具结果留证，不等于长期记忆。**

## 快速开始

需要 DeepSeek Harness、Node.js 18+ 与 Python 3.10+。Python 基座仅使用标准库与 SQLite，无需另配模型 API key。

```sh
git clone --recursive https://github.com/yuchenlogin/noname-dsh-plugin.git
cd noname-dsh-plugin
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/noname-dsh-plugin
```

从源码安装时明确运行 `npm run build`，让 `dist/` 对应当前 TypeScript。DSH 安装与 profile 的更多说明见 [DSH 官方指南](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/guide/quickstart)。

启用插件后，在 DSH 项目工作区中试一次：

1. 让 agent 调用 `noname_package` 查看当前项目。初次使用会创建空账本，空记忆不会伪装成已经记住了什么。
2. 正常讨论一个决定，例如“首版用 SQLite，因为只在本地运行”。让 agent 用 `noname_record` 留下决定和理由，取得 `evt_…` 来源 ID。
3. 用 `noname_remember` 提出候选：稳定键 `storage`、人能读懂的决定、来源 ID 和保留理由。
4. 调用 `noname_ledger`，打开输出的 `live ledger` URL，查看来源并签署。
5. 在下一个会话让 agent 调用 `noname_package`，确认已批准内容与来源出现在上下文包中。

记忆审核在本地网页由人签署。日常继续工作时，agent 可以按工具描述选择性地记录、提议和组装；插件没有后台 LLM 自动提炼服务，也不保证宿主会在每次会话开始时自动调用 `noname_package`。

## 哪些值得记住

| 内容 | 合适的去处 |
|---|---|
| 项目约束、关键决定及原因 | `noname_remember` 的 `high` 候选，确认后成为项目记忆 |
| 阶段成果、阻塞与下一步 | `mid` 候选，保留可继续工作的最小信息 |
| 用户明确表达的判断与例子 | 自述品味；必须来自用户明确要求 |
| 从模型表现中观察到的喜好 | 品味候选，用户明确采纳后生效 |
| 普通工具输出、暂时想法、每一轮聊天 | 需要时留作证据，不逐条变成长期规则 |

决定改变时，复用同一个逻辑键。例如 `storage` 从 SQLite 修正为 PostgreSQL；新候选确认后取代旧的当前版本，旧决定保留在来路里。使用 `storage-v2` 会把同一件事拆成两个主题。

品味是软影响，不是事实或永久命令。`user` 范围目前也保存在当前账本内，尚未自动跨项目同步。

## 能读懂的交互式账本

![NoName 本地账本：当前决定、工作接续与需要确认的变化](docs/assets/ledger-overview.png)

`noname_ledger` 返回本机审核网页与离线 HTML 路径。网页与 NoName 主仓共享渲染逻辑：

- **此刻**：当前决定和工作接续。
- **等你判断**：候选、理由、来源与确认后的变化。
- **品味与偏好**：明确区分自述与待采纳的观察。
- **来路与变化**：修正链及审核来源。
- **活动档案**：按需展开原始事件与技术信息。

项目决定与工作进度支持接受、拒绝、暂缓、修改后接受；品味与卡片遵循各自的审核生命周期。签署人和理由写入同一本账。离线快照只读，审核请使用 `live ledger` 链接；静态文件导出失败时，工具会提示警告，本地审核页仍可使用。

服务仅监听 `127.0.0.1`，完整 URL 带访问令牌，不要公开分享。相同插件上下文和账本会复用服务，插件卸载时停止；一小时无活动后自动退出，再次调用工具可获得新链接。

远程 DSH 需将返回 URL 的端口转发到本机**相同端口**，保持 `127.0.0.1`、端口和令牌路径。例如：

```sh
ssh -L 45678:127.0.0.1:45678 your-host
```

浏览器审核没有多人账号系统，签署人是本机审计标签。当前 DSH 的 host 插件不能注册 client 的 `sidebarRightTabs`；账本通过浏览器入口打开。完整使用说明见 [账本指南](https://github.com/yuchenlogin/NoNameAgentHarness/blob/main/docs/ledger.md)。

## 配置与数据位置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `pythonPath` | `python3` | 本机 Python 解释器；建议用绝对路径 |
| `dbDir` | 空 | 默认使用会话所属工作区的 `<项目>/.noname`；指定后固定为该目录 |
| `autoIngest` | `true` | 将宿主工具结果写入证据流；跳过 NoName 自身读取和投影工具，避免回声与审核 URL 留档 |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 每次 Python sidecar 调用超时，单位毫秒 |

一个工作区一本账，多会话共享，通过真实 `session_id` 区分来源。路径由 DSH 的 `workspaceRegistry` 解析；无法获得工作区时回落到 `$DSH_HOME/noname`，不会猜测其他项目。HTML 放在工作区边界内的 `.noname/noname-ledger.html`。建议把 `.noname/` 加入 `.gitignore`。

默认隔离单位是工作区路径，不能假设 profile 必然隔离：若不同 profile 指向同一个工作区，也可能使用同一账本。需要独立数据时显式配置不同 `dbDir`。

## 工具参考

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `noname_record` | 留下有用的决定、发现或约束作为证据；返回来源事件 ID |
| `noname_remember` | 由证据提出项目决定或工作进度候选；不会自动批准 |
| `noname_package` | 组装项目记忆、偏好与相关证据，供新会话接续 |
| `noname_search` | 查找证据与记忆 |
| `noname_state` | 查看已批准状态；可选 `layer`，不填则返回 high 与 mid 两层 |
| `noname_inbox` | 查看候选及其来源 |
| `noname_taste_add` | 用户明确自述的品味，直接激活；不能用来写模型推断 |
| `noname_taste_propose` | 由模型表现提出待采纳品味 |
| `noname_taste_review` | 品味 adopt / edit / pause / resume / retire；须有用户明确决定 |
| `noname_card_queue` | 查看需要复核的品味卡 |
| `noname_ledger` | 获取本地可审核页面和离线快照 |
| `noname_verify` | 校验账本完整性及哈希覆盖范围 |
| `noname_extract` | 默认预览抽取结果；显式 `create_candidates: true` 才创建待审候选 |

`noname_remember` 的必填参数是 `layer`（`high` / `mid`）、稳定主题 `key`、可读 `text`、一个 `source_event` 事件 ID，以及说明为何值得保留的 `reason`。可选 `next_step` 保存接续指针。先记录再引用真实 ID，不编造证据。相同的已生效内容返回 `unchanged`，相同的最新待审内容返回 `already_pending`，避免重复提议。

品味审核会生成新记录并替代旧 head。后续操作请使用工具返回的 `head=<新 id>`；旧 ID 会报 `has been superseded`。`edit` 必须携带 `content` JSON string；它保留版本链，不直接改历史。

## 信任与现有边界

插件是记忆与证据适配层。DSH 继续负责模型、工具执行、权限和调度；NoName 独立 runtime 的执行审批门与沙箱不会自动接管 DSH。

`autoIngest` 捕获工具结果，不是全量聊天归档。长输出保留受限摘要；`noname_record` 用于主动保存有价值的来源。NoName 读取和投影结果不再重复写入，记忆写操作仍留证用于审计。自动留证、提出候选、人工确认是三个不同阶段。

完整性校验按每行写入时的哈希版本验证。较新 v2 哈希覆盖整行溯源字段；旧 v1 仅覆盖 payload，不能发现所有元数据篡改。`noname_verify` 的 `hash_coverage` 如实报告覆盖范围。数据在本机，不表示它自动加密或替你脱敏。

## 开发与内核快照

```sh
npm run build
npm test
npm run check:kernel
```

运行时使用 `vendor/noname_harness_pkg/` 快照；`vendor/noname-harness` submodule 和 `KERNEL_VERSION.txt` 提供可追溯来源。正常体验改进应在插件或共享展示层完成，不复制内核审核规则。

0.6.0 的基座固定为 [`a0673a9`](https://github.com/yuchenlogin/NoNameAgentHarness/commit/a0673a9d7181c030ba8c2de415451f3a4dbb6060)，包含 macOS 本地服务启动修复。共享展示层已从该提交导出，submodule pin、`KERNEL_VERSION.txt` 与运行快照保持一致，`npm run check:kernel` 已通过。构建、66 项插件回归和独立安装验证也已通过。

需要主动升级基座时：

```sh
npm run sync:kernel -- --commit <sha>
npm test
npm run check:kernel
```

`--dry-run` 只预览；不带 `--commit` 时从 submodule 当前精确 HEAD 导出。不要手工混合多个提交的快照。发布前应让源码、快照和版本声明一致；内核测试在主仓运行，插件测试验证实际 Python CLI 与 TypeScript 的桥接。

产品初心见 [NoName 愿景](https://github.com/yuchenlogin/NoNameAgentHarness/blob/main/docs/vision.md)，版本变化见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。本插件采用 [MIT](LICENSE)；内核遵守其原仓库许可。

plugins.description: Keep your OpenClaw persona and memory when moving to DeepSeek Harness: one shared Markdown workspace, bounded context, and a native DSH Sidebar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-openclaw-memory

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-openclaw-memory?color=cb3837&label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-openclaw-memory)
[![CI](https://github.com/zzy-fxxxexxxyxxx/dsh-openclaw-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zzy-fxxxexxxyxxx/dsh-openclaw-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-openclaw-memory)](LICENSE)

## Keep your OpenClaw continuity when you move to DSH

You have already invested in a persona, preferences, operating rules, and long-term memory in OpenClaw. Moving to DeepSeek Harness should not mean starting over.

**`dsh-openclaw-memory` is the continuity layer for that transition:** it lets DSH read the same OpenClaw workspace, apply explicit context budgets and privacy boundaries, and manage the shared Markdown files from a native DSH Sidebar.

```text
OpenClaw workspace  ──┬──> OpenClaw
                      └──> dsh-openclaw-memory ──> DSH

One workspace. Two clients. No duplicate memory store.
```

> **Designed for:** people who currently use OpenClaw, are moving part of their workflow to DSH, and want to preserve the same identity, preferences, instructions, and accumulated memory.

## Why this exists

An assistant is more than a model endpoint. The useful continuity is usually in the workspace around it:

- `SOUL.md` and `IDENTITY.md` define how the assistant behaves;
- `USER.md` records the user and interaction preferences;
- `AGENTS.md`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`, and `MEMORY.md` carry operating rules and durable context;
- `memory/` contains the daily record that makes the workspace evolve over time.

When a user moves from OpenClaw to DSH, the costly part is not installing another client. It is preserving that accumulated context without creating a second, divergent copy.

This plugin keeps the workspace as the source of truth. DSH reads it directly, injects only the bounded context you configure, and exposes the same files through a controlled Sidebar workflow.

## What you get

### A migration path without a second memory system

Point the plugin at the OpenClaw workspace you already trust. There is no import wizard, hidden database, or automatic file migration. The files stay where they are, and both clients can work from the same source.

### Explicit context, not an opaque prompt dump

Choose which bootstrap files are included and set per-file and total budgets. Preview the exact context before it reaches an agent, including source size, injected characters, limits, and truncation state.

### A real editing surface inside DSH

Use the Sidebar to browse top-level Markdown files and the `memory/` tree, switch between source and rendered Markdown preview, edit, and save. Writes are constrained to the allowed workspace surface and protected by optimistic version checks.

### A deliberate safety boundary

Credential-like files, JSON artifacts, symlinks, absolute paths, and traversal attempts are excluded by default. Shared workspace content is treated as data, not as a higher-priority instruction than DSH system policy.

### Stable continuity across turns

With `continuation-skip`, the same agent reuses an unchanged snapshot until a source file or relevant configuration changes. That keeps context predictable and avoids unnecessary re-injection.

## Product surface

- **Bootstrap context:** independently select `AGENTS.md`, `SOUL.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, `USER.md`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`, and `MEMORY.md`.
- **Daily memory:** optionally include recent `memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md` and up to four newest `memory/YYYY-MM-DD-*.md` files per day.
- **Context preview:** inspect the exact assembled snapshot and per-file budget accounting.
- **Memory search:** expose bounded keyword retrieval through `openclaw_memory_search`.
- **Remote API:** list, read, search, preview, and conflict-safe write operations through DSH Typert Remote.
- **Sidebar editor:** file tree, source/rendered preview, configuration editor, refresh, and explicit save.
- **Live settings:** update volatile configuration through DSH `Settings`/`ConfigEditor` with optimistic revision checks.

## See the workflow

### 1. Start from the DSH home surface

The plugin appears as a native DSH entry point alongside the workspace and terminal actions.

![DSH home surface with the shared-memory entry point](docs/screenshots/welcome.png)

### 2. Configure the handoff

Choose the OpenClaw files that should inform model context, set the shared root, and control daily memory independently. The configuration is visible rather than hidden in an opaque adapter.

![Shared OpenClaw workspace configuration in the DSH Sidebar](docs/screenshots/configuration.png)

### 3. Verify what DSH will actually receive

The injection preview shows the assembled context, per-file accounting, and truncation status. This is the checkpoint for a cautious migration: inspect the boundary before relying on it.

![Exact context injection preview](docs/screenshots/context-preview.png)

### 4. Continue maintaining the same workspace

Edit the same Markdown files from the Sidebar, preview the rendered result, and save only when you are ready. OpenClaw and DSH continue to meet at the same workspace boundary.

![Markdown file tree and editor in the DSH Sidebar](docs/screenshots/editor.png)

## Install

Install the published plugin into a DSH profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-openclaw-memory
```

For development from a local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-openclaw-memory
```

Then add the plugin configuration to the profile patch, or adapt the repository's [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml):

```yaml
- id: openclaw-memory
  name: dsh-openclaw-memory
  config:
    # Use the OpenClaw workspace that contains your existing memory.
    root: /home/sunrise/.openclaw/workspace
    contextInjection: continuation-skip
    bootstrapFiles:
      - AGENTS.md
      - SOUL.md
      - IDENTITY.md
      - USER.md
      - BOOTSTRAP.md
      - MEMORY.md
    bootstrapMaxChars: 20000
    bootstrapTotalMaxChars: 60000
    userMaxChars: 4000
    dailyMemoryDays: 2
    dailyFileMaxBytes: 16384
    dailyFileMaxChars: 1200
    dailyTotalMaxChars: 2800
    includeDailyStartup: true
    timeZone: Asia/Shanghai
    includeCredentials: false
    maxFileChars: 200000
```

`contextInjection` supports:

- `always`: assemble context for every model request;
- `continuation-skip`: reuse an unchanged snapshot for the same agent;
- `never`: disable model context injection and the model-facing search tool while keeping the file Remote available when the profile loads the plugin.

### A cautious migration sequence

1. **Keep the existing OpenClaw workspace unchanged.** Back it up using your normal operational process before changing production settings.
2. **Install the plugin in a test or DSH profile.** Point `root` at the workspace that already contains the OpenClaw identity and memory files.
3. **Start with a narrow selection.** Enable only the files you intend to share and keep `includeCredentials: false`.
4. **Open Injection Preview.** Check the exact snapshot, budgets, and truncation before enabling regular context injection.
5. **Move traffic gradually.** Keep OpenClaw available while you validate DSH responses and Sidebar editing against the same files.

This plugin does not change OpenClaw's agent configuration. If OpenClaw and DSH point at different workspace directories, they are not sharing the same source of truth; review that change separately.

## Trust and security model

This plugin is intentionally a workspace bridge, not a general filesystem browser.

- The default root is `/home/sunrise/.openclaw/workspace` in the example patch; set it to your own canonical workspace.
- Only the configured bootstrap Markdown files and `memory/**/*.md` are in the managed surface.
- Credential and secret filenames are excluded by default. `includeCredentials: true` is an explicit opt-in and is not recommended for production.
- JSON artifacts are not part of the default index, and symlinks are ignored.
- Absolute paths and traversal are rejected.
- Reads and writes are bounded by configurat

plugins.readme_text:
# @chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname

DeepSeek Harness host plugin: name a new conversation once, at its first naming
opportunity, as `MMDD｜类型｜主题` — the DSH port of a Codex `Stop`-hook renaming
setup. It also names any specified conversation on demand by summarizing its whole
content, and it catches up on sessions that were never named because the host died
mid-turn.

Installs as a profile bundle — from GitHub, or from the out-of-tree working copy at
`D:\__CODE__\_tookit\261002_dsh-session-autoname`:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname
# local development:
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname"
# or through the harness: plugin_manager install_bundle link:D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname
```

## Responsibilities

### 1. Automatic naming

- Trigger: the durable `turn/end` event of ANY turn on a root session
  (`session/event`) — normally turn 1, but also a later turn when the first one was
  lost. No `hooks.json`, no `Stop` handler, and **no title provider
  registration** — see below.
- Evidence: turn 1's own completed result when it has one (the user request plus
  the work that turn actually delivered, folded from the session log); otherwise
  the whole conversation so far, which is what keeps a session whose first turn was
  interrupted or killed still nameable.
- Date: `MMDD` from the session's own `header.createdAt` in `Asia/Shanghai`
  (never `updatedAt`, never the host clock).
- Write: `ctx.sessionTitle.rename()`, the interface the GUI itself uses.
- Skip conditions: not a root session; no assistant text anywhere; the human
  already renamed the session; the title is already compliant. Every failure keeps
  the title already on the session, and the reason is recorded in the admin tool's
  `auto.recent` ring.
- Exactly once: a compliant title, or a user-chosen one, ends the attempts, so
  later turns do nothing.

Accepted output is rebuilt from validated parts and must be exactly
`MMDD｜类型｜主题`: the date must equal the `createdAt`-derived value, the type must
be one of 功能/设计/修复/优化/发布/探索/文档/研究/诊断/验证, the separator must be
full-width `｜`, and the topic must be non-empty, within 24 characters and 60
bytes, free of control characters, and free of the project name. Markdown, code
fences, prose, extra JSON fields, `{"title":null}`, and over-long titles are all
rejected rather than guessed. A model call that ends `max-tokens` is still
accepted when the text it emitted parses and validates — a reasoning route can
exhaust its budget before stopping.

### 2. Naming a specified conversation

`session_title_admin` with `{"action":"summarize","session_id":"…"}` reads the
WHOLE conversation — its opening intent plus the per-turn outcomes that fit a
byte budget, biased to the end where the result lives — and writes one
`MMDD｜类型｜主题` title for it. `dry_run:true` previews without writing. Live
sessions are written through `sessionTitle.rename`; cold ones through
`sessionController.rename`. The same date and type rules apply.

Other actions: `list` (recent root sessions, their titles, and recent automatic
outcomes), `inspect` (one session's first-turn evidence), `apply` (exact renames,
each re-validated against that session's own `createdAt`), `archive` (hide
throwaway test sessions), `selftest` (create a throwaway session and prove real
first-turn auto-naming end to end).

### 3. Catch-up sweep after a crash or restart

The trigger above is a live event, so a host that dies mid-turn never delivers the
`turn/end` that would have named the session — and after the restart that turn is
restored as an open turn that can never end as `completed`. Five seconds after this
plugin applies, it therefore names every root session that is **still without a
compliant title** and holds assistant work, inside a bounded window:

| Bound | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| window | 48 h of `header.createdAt` | the crash case is minutes old; older sessions are reached when they are continued, or by `summarize` |
| cap | 5 named per start | a start must never become a mass rename of history |
| delay | 5 s | the sweep must not compete with the host's own startup |

Each outcome lands in `auto.recent` (`named` / `skipped` / `failed`, plus one
`sweep` line carrying the counts), so a start can be audited without reading logs.

## Why nothing has to be disabled

`ctx.sessionTitle.register()` accepts exactly ONE provider, and the stock
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-title-first-prompt-llm` occupies it. This plugin avoids
the conflict instead of resolving it in configuration:

- It never calls `register()`, so the slot's single-owner rule is irrelevant; the
  official provider stays enabled and untouched.
- `sessionTitle.rename()` calls `supersede()` internally, which aborts that
  provider's in-flight generation and invalidates its pending one, and a
  user-source title pins the session against later automatic revisions.
- Net effect: while the first turn runs, the sidebar shows the stock provider's
  plain-text title as a placeholder; once the turn closes, this plugin replaces it
  with the compliant one.

## Wiring

`cordis.patch.yml` is this bundle's patch layer — one row, no foreign rows:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-autoname
      name: '@chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname'
```

The row names the package rather than a file URL, so the bundle runs wherever it is
fetched from — `github:Chi-hong22/dsh-session-autoname` included. A bare name is
safe here because an installed copy is immutable: the loader resolves each specifier
once per host process, and that single resolution points at the installed package
for the life of the process.

For local development this profile links the working copy
(`link:D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname`), so the same bare name
resolves through the junction to this checkout's `session-naming.js` — checked with
`import.meta.resolve` from the profile directory. Editing the file and restarting
DSH loads the edited code.

> Need the row to be unable to name anything but this checkout (for example when an
> older copy of the package is also reachable from the profile)? Override it in the
> profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`: `- id: session-autoname` with
> `name: 'file:///D:/__CODE__/_tookit/261002_dsh-session-autoname/session-naming.js'`.

## Reloading after a code edit

Restart DSH — it re-imports the resolved file. Without a restart the module URL has
to change, and a package-name row always resolves to the same file: switch to the
file-URL override above, pointed at a renamed copy of the implementation file, so
the loader sees a URL it has not cached.

## Verifying

```powershell
node --test tests/provider.test.mjs      # offline: rules, rejections, trigger skips, catch-up, admin tool
node tools/history-evidence.mjs 0        # read-only first-turn digests of root sessions
```

Then on a live host: `session_title_admin {"action":"selftest"}` for the automatic
path, and `{"action":"list"}` to read the recent automatic outcomes.

## Known limits

- Automatic naming cannot run "before the answer is delivered": DSH streams the
  answer to the browser while the turn runs. The title lands as soon as the first
  turn closes, without delaying it.
- A first turn that ends `aborted`, `interrupted`, `error`, or `max-tokens` is
  named from the whole conversation instead of from that turn's partial result, and
  the model is told to stay conservative about the type. Only a session with no
  assistant work at all is left unnamed — name it later with `summarize`.
- The catch-up sweep is bounded (48 h, 5 per start). A session older than the window
  that was never continued and never named keeps its placeholder until `summarize`
  is asked for it.
- `sessionController.rename` resumes a cold session, so naming one whose recorded
  `agentPreset` no longer exists fails with `Unknown agent preset`.
- `D:\__CODE__` is inside a file-sync scope on this machine, so in-place edits can
  briefly fail with a Windows sharing violation; retry.

plugins.description: Laya Tool Router Using the SystemOne Jev Typed Decisions for Local Laya Model and Equivalents.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Tool Router

Lazy tool discovery for DSH: hides every tool schema from the model's prefill
and reveals exactly one tool on demand through a **decision model API**.

- **Prefill cost:** one small `find_tool` schema instead of every mounted tool
  (26 schemas on a default Standard profile — see [Why?](#why)).
- **Stage 0** — full-surface send: every mounted tool (≤ 24) carries a
  160-char criterion, ordered by a stopword-filtered lexical rank (the rank
  only bounds pathological mounts — d1-omni does not saturate as the choice
  count grows; see [Why?](#why)).
- **Stage 1** — one `POST /v1/systemone` to the decision model API: a
  `bestTool` choice plus a `usable` question kept as telemetry only
  (~235–500 tokens, ~6–7 s on-device).
- **Stage 2** — accept iff `confidence >= 0.70`: return the winner's JSON
  Schema and reveal exactly that one tool; otherwise return a
  **probability-ordered shortlist** whose reason names the closest match, so
  the model can retry with that exact tool name (or send an empty request to
  get the whole catalog). Exact tool-name requests skip the decision call and
  reveal instantly.

## Why?

Fresh session, first message, server-reported `usage.prompt_tokens` —
the DSH **Standard preset** (the platform default) versus this plugin's
`no-prefill` preset:

| Cost before the first word | Standard | no-prefill |
|---|---:|---:|
| Prefill tokens | **6,559** | **283** |
| System prompt | 5,816 chars | 372 chars |
| Tool schemas shipped up front | **26 schemas (21,417 B)** | 1 schema (697 B) |

Standard makes the model ingest a 5.8k-character system prompt plus **every**
mounted tool schema — 6,559 tokens — before it emits a single word, and pays
it again on every subsequent turn. `no-prefill` ingests 283 tokens (**23×
less**, 96% smaller prefill): a slim persona plus the single `find_tool`
schema. On the measured backend that difference was ~40 s versus ~14 min of
prompt evaluation for the first reply.

What that buys you:

- **Latency** — time-to-first-word scales with the whole tool shelf today.
  Reveal-on-demand makes it scale with the tool you actually call.
- **Context budget** — 6.5k tokens of standing preamble is 6.5k tokens you
  don't have for code, conversation, and results. On a 32k window that's ~20%
  of the model's world spent before work starts.
- **Reliability on small models** — a model reading 26 schemas behaves like a
  model reading 26 instructions it must never violate. One schema at a time is
  one schema to follow; the rest of the shelf doesn't exist for it.
- **Pay for what you use** — a turn that calls no tool costs 283 tokens
  instead of 6,559. A turn that calls one tool reveals that one schema once;
  the other 25 are never sent.

If a session ends up using most tools anyway, the gap narrows — but the unused
half of the shelf is exactly what a default profile charges for from word one.

## What the bundle patch declares

`cordis.patch.yml` (applied when the bundle is selected):

1. **`preset-no-prefill`** — an agent preset whose composition is only
   `persona` + `dsh-tool-router`. The persona tells the model: no tools are
   declared; call `find_tool` first — and if a result carries no schema,
   retry with an exact tool name or an empty request instead of giving up.
2. **Host tool rows enabled** — `tool-bash`, `tool-fs`, `tool-fs-search`,
   `tool-todo`, `tool-web` flipped to `disabled: false`, plus a `present`
   row inserted. Discovery needs the tools to exist somewhere; preset-scoped
   registrations shadow host ones, so other presets keep their own behavior.
   The slim preset keeps the Agent Presets page showing only `find_tool`.

## Prerequisites

- DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (bundles mechanism with `dsh.bundle.patch`).
- A running **decision model API** that speaks `POST /v1/systemone`
  (the router defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1/systemone`; edit
  `ROUTER_BASE` in `index.js` to point at another host or port).
- `pnpm` on PATH of the host running DSH (the plugin manager installs
  through pnpm; the CLI forwards pnpm arguments).

## Install

**From GitHub (recommended):** Plugins → install → spec

```
git+https://github.com/residenthiago2011/DSH-Tool-Router.git
```

or via the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add git+https://github.com/residenthiago2011/DSH-Tool-Router.git
```

**From a prebuilt tarball:** download
[`dsh-tool-router.tgz`](https://github.com/residenthiago2011/DSH-Tool-Router/releases/latest/download/dsh-tool-router.tgz)
from Releases, then install from the local path (also accepted: absolute
path, git URL, or an npm registry name after publishing):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-tool-router.tgz
```

Then select the bundle on the Plugins page (installation enables it by
default) and restart DSH if the profile runs without HMR.

## Uninstall

Deselect/remove the bundle on the Plugins page. The preset row and the host
tool flips vanish with the bundle patch; other presets are untouched.

## Files

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | The router plugin: registers `find_tool`, masks every other tool per agent, runs the 3-stage decision. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The bundle patch: preset declaration + host tool enablement. |
| `tool-registry.json` | Stage-0 labels and Stage-1 criteria (25 tools, both shells incl. `bash`). |

## Tests

```sh
node router-import-test.mjs   # module shape (no dependencies)
node rank-sim.mjs             # Stage-0 ranking on sample queries (needs tool-registry.json)
node router-e2e-test.mjs      # full flow: arm/deny-set/live reveal — requires the decision endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8081
```

`router-e2e-test.mjs` uses a stub DSH context that emits `tools/change`
synchronously (the worst case that once caused a ~970x feedback loop), then
drives the real `find_tool` against a live decision endpoint: armed-once,
deny-set dedup, late registration, reveal re-arm, empty-request catalog hint,
and the exact-name fast path. `ALL_PASS` is expected.

## Notes

- `find_tool` registers with a standard JSON Schema
  (`type/properties/required/additionalProperties`). A raw register with
  author-style parameters reaches the LLM unconstrained — the model then
  calls with `{}`. Always compile.
- The empty-request catalog hint and the exact-name fast path exist for
  small models; see `execute()` in `index.js`.

# Fly Skins — palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI

**A standard DSH skin plugin: four palettes, light and dark halves, a laser scan while the model
works, and a 125% sidebar type scale.**
**标准 DSH 皮肤插件：四套配色（各含明暗两半）、模型运行时的激光扫描、外加 125% 的侧栏字号。**

`@dsh-fly/dsh-plugin-fly-skins` · category **theme** · MIT

> Previews below are the **official DeepSeek Harness UI with this skin installed** — no Fly
> workbench, a fresh profile. The workspaces and sessions shown are **sample data**
> (`atlas-web` / `billing-api` / `infra-notes`); no real conversations appear.
> 下面的预览图是**官方 DeepSeek Harness UI + 本皮肤**（没有 Fly 工作台、全新 profile）；
> 侧栏里的工作区与会话是**示例数据**（atlas-web / billing-api / infra-notes），不含任何真实会话。

## Neon — the flagship palette

A scene light field behind the whole window: deep navy canvas, a 46px circuit grid running edge
to edge, cyan edge-glow bleeding out of the rail card, and text sitting on its own plate so it
stays sharp over the field. Dark and light are two halves of the same recipe, not two themes.

**霓虹是主打配色**：整窗一张场景光场（深蓝画布 + 46px 电路网格）、栏卡外溢青光、
文字坐字座；明暗两半是同一套配方的两个半区，不是两套主题。

![Neon, dark, on the official UI](docs/shots/preview-neon-dark.jpg)

### Laser scan while the model works

When a turn is running, a 2px cyan line sweeps bottom-to-top through the conversation column,
trailing a 48px glow in the same cyan as the todo panel's ring. It is tied to the harness's own
running marker (`data-chat-running`): the line exists only while the model is working and is
gone the moment the turn settles — idle reading never gets a moving line. Off under
`prefers-reduced-motion` and at ≤768px.

**模型工作时才扫**：2px 的青线自下而上扫过中列，尾迹 48px、与 Todo 任务列表卡同一颗青。
线挂在引擎自己的运行标记（`data-chat-running`）上——模型一停就消失，静态翻阅时不扫；
`prefers-reduced-motion` 与 ≤768px 下关闭。

预览图是一次**真实的示例任务**（`todo_write` 列出五步、每步跑一句 `echo "step N done"`）
进行中拍的：底部是**展开的 todo 卡**（准备 ◐ / 实现 · / 写测试 · / 跑验证 · / 总结 ·），
中间上方是**展开的命令卡**（第一步的 bash 调用与输出），todo 卡**上方那条空带里**
横贯画面的青光就是扫描线（16 秒一程的动画，抓帧时停在空带里，不压任何文字）。
The frame is a real capture of a harmless five-step example task in progress
(`todo_write` + one `echo` per step): the todo card at the bottom is expanded (one done, one in
progress, three pending), the command card in the middle is step 1's `bash` call and output, and
the line between them is the scan. It is sample content, not the owner's conversations.

![A five-step example task running: the expanded todo card, the expanded command card and the scan line](docs/shots/preview-neon-dark-tasks.jpg)

### Sidebar as a HUD

Workspace folders are drawn as cyan HUD plates — uppercase, 13px, 600 weight, 0.12em tracking,
a tinted plate and a 1px fading tail line — so a folder heading no longer reads as one more
session row between two groups. Session rows keep the plain 17.5px white type and the pill
selection; nothing about them moved.

**侧栏做成 HUD**：工作区文件夹名是青色标牌（大写、13px、600、0.12em 字距、淡青底板 +
1px 渐隐尾线），不再夹在两段会话中间像一条会话行；会话行一个字没动。

### Type

Latin is MiSans Latin, embedded (~166KB, Apache-2.0, three weights) so the chrome keeps its HUD
voice offline; Chinese falls back to your own font setting, which the recipe deliberately keeps.
Buttons and panel titles take 600 weight with 0.04em tracking, section labels 500, numerals are
tabular, and timestamps/counts switch to the mono stack.

**字体**：拉丁用内置的 MiSans Latin（约 166KB，Apache-2.0，三档字重），中文回落到你自己的
字体设置；按钮与面板标题 600 + 0.04em，section 标签 500，数字等宽，时间戳/计数走等宽字体。

## Four palettes

| Palette | id | Look | Pick it when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Solid** | `solid` | Opaque panels, crisp borders | You want a flat, high-contrast room |

![Solid, dark, on the official UI](docs/shots/preview-solid-dark.jpg)
| **Glass** | `glass` | Translucent frosted surfaces, hairline edges | You want depth without colour |
| **Volume** | `volume` | Glass volume + state glow + text plates | You want the lit, sculpted read |
| **Neon** | `neon` | Scene light field + edge glow + text plates + running scan | You want the battle-room look (default in dsh-fly) |

Every palette has a light and a dark half. The choice persists in the profile's patch layer
(field `skin`), so it survives restarts and profile switches.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile=<profile> add @dsh-fly/dsh-plugin-fly-skins
```

Or add it from **Settings → Plugins** in the harness UI, then **restart** the app — the engine
caches client bundles in-process, so a page refresh is not enough.

Once installed, the palette picker appears as its own row in **Settings → General**:

![The Skin row in Settings → General (official UI)](docs/shots/official-neon-dark-settings.jpg)

It works standalone: install the skin without the Fly workbench and you get the official UI in
Fly colours; install the workbench without the skin and you get the official look plus the
workbench.

## Neon scanline and typography (0.2.0, refined through 0.2.4)

The neon dark half carries a slow **bottom-to-top scanline**: a **2px** laser in the Todo task-list
panel's cyan-green, `rgba(53, 211, 224, 0.78)` (the T10 ring; `#35d3e0`), with a 48px tail that
trails below the line, painted on the centre column's background — i.e. *behind* messages and
cards, so it never washes over text. It sweeps upward for about 16 seconds, holds offscreen at
both ends, and restarts invisibly. The layer is mounted **only while a turn is running**: the rule
is chained to the upstream `[data-chat-running]` row that React mounts for the active turn and
unmounts when the model stops. Idle conversations and the home therefore stay still — the scan is a
"working" signal, not a screensaver. The light half does not scan (a moving line on a white field
reads as dirt), and the layer is removed entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` and on
screens at or below 768px.

**霓虹深色半区新增一条自下而上的扫描线**：2px 激光，颜色取 Todo 任务列表卡 T10 边框的 `rgba(53,211,224,.78)`（#35d3e0，青光绿），+ 48px 柔尾迹（拖在线下方），画在中列背景、消息与卡片的**下面**；
约 16 秒扫完一程，两端在屏外静默后重播。**只在该会话 running 时挂载**：规则挂在上游
`[data-chat-running]` 的运行状态行上，模型一停这行就卸载，线也一起消失；空闲会话和首页不扫。
浅色半区不扫（白底上会显脏），`prefers-reduced-motion` 与 ≤768px 小屏自动关闭。

The Latin chrome now uses **MiSans Latin** (three weights, about 166 KB, embedded in the client
bundle, Apache-2.0; see `LICENSES/`). Buttons and panel titles take weight 600 and 0.04em tracking,
section labels weight 500, and numbers are tabular. Chinese text keeps the user's own font setting —
the full MiSans CJK family is about 45 MB of sharded woff2, which a desktop security tool should not
download or carry. The family is scoped to neon; solid / glass / volume keep their exact shipped
type and pixels.

**拉丁字形换成内置的 MiSans Latin**（三字重，约 166KB，随客户端包内嵌，Apache-2.0）；中文继续用
用户自己的字体设置。字重、字距与 tabular 数字只作用于霓虹，其余三套配色保持原样。
