plugins.description: Balance and per-session spend HUD for DeepSeek Harness, with budget alerts, peak-hour warnings and opt-in official price sync.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# dsh-balance-hud

An always-on HUD in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH (DeepSeek Harness)** Web GUI that shows your
DeepSeek **account balance** and the **cost of the current session**.

[简体中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Design notes](docs/DESIGN.md) · [设计说明](docs/DESIGN.zh-CN.md) · [LICENSE](LICENSE)

![The two states of the HUD: a collapsed corner badge and the expanded detail panel](assets/preview-en.png)

> **About these images:** they are not photographs of a live DSH window. They are renders of the
> plugin's own layout and colours, driven by its real style values and real figures — a capture tool
> for the running GUI was not available when they were made. Treat them as a faithful layout
> reference, not as evidence of a running install. Pull requests replacing them with genuine
> screenshots are welcome.

- **Account balance** — recharge balance + bonus balance, read through the same service the
  *Settings → Account & balance* page uses (`ctx.deepseekAccount.getBalance()`).
- **Two cost figures** — a token-based *estimate* from the official price table, and an *actual*
  figure accumulated from real balance decreases (external reductions excluded).
- **External balance changes, both ways** — a top-up raises the balance, and a lapsed bonus grant is
  reclaimed by the platform; money moving in or out externally never touches the spending counter.
- **Per session** — the tracker is keyed by session id; refreshing the page or switching sessions
  never damages or clobbers another session's record, because the read → modify → write round trip
  is lossless.
- **No credentials, and no outbound network unless you opt in** — the plugin never touches your API
  key. It reaches the network only after you turn price syncing on (see
  [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)); until then it makes zero external requests.
- **Two halves, one relay** — a browser half renders the HUD; a Host half exposes read-only loopback
  HTTP routes (balance, bonus signal, price sync, model list), so the browser itself never talks to
  anything but loopback.
- **Configurable, and budgeted** — a preference row in *Settings → General* sets the model, the poll
  intervals, the budgets and the warnings; the card gains a coloured edge as spending approaches a
  budget, and the panel counts down to the next peak/off-peak switch.

```bash
# Windows — double-click tools\install.cmd, or:
tools\install.cmd

# macOS / Linux:
sh tools/install.sh
```

Both launchers find Node for you — including **the runtime DSH already ships**, which is not on
`PATH`. If your machine has no Node at all, they say so and tell you what to do, instead of failing
with `node: command not found`. Install into a different profile with `--profile <dir>`, preview with
`--dry-run`, undo with `--uninstall`.

Prefer to run it yourself? The plain form assumes Node is on `PATH`:

```bash
node tools/install.mjs    # install into ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop, then restart DSH
node tools/smoke.mjs      # offline smoke suite (83 assertions), no DSH install needed
```

**Then restart DSH.** Adding a plugin changes the profile's bundle list, which is not hot-reloaded;
a page refresh alone will not pick it up.

## The HUD

```text
                                                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                                                        │  Balance             ¥43.42  │
                                                        │  Session est.         ¥0.59  │
                                                        └──────────────────────────────┘
```

Hovering the card expands a detail panel: balance rows (recharge / bonus / total), the three priced
components of the estimate, the actual figure, token counts, and — with parallel sessions — the
apportionment rows (`Session share`, `Other sessions`, `Tracked sessions`, `Account total`). The
panel uses 4 decimals; the card uses 2. The interface ships in **Chinese and English** and follows
DSH's language by default; the English names below are what each row means.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Balance | Total account balance (recharge + bonus), 2 decimals |
| Session est. | Estimate for the current session; 2 decimals on the card, 4 in the panel; `—` when the session has no token usage yet |
| Actual charged | Accumulated real spending for this session (single session; becomes `Session share` when parallel) |

Amounts below the smallest displayed unit render as `<¥0.01` on the card and `<¥0.0001` in the
panel, so real spending is never rounded down to a flat zero.

## Interaction

- **Hover** the card and the detail panel expands; move away and it closes.
- The card and the panel are separate elements with an intentional **8 px gap** between them, and the
  pointer must be able to cross that gap without the panel closing. The hover decision is attached to
  the card and the panel themselves — each has its own enter/leave handler — never to the enclosing
  positioning container. A **140 ms** pending-close timer carries the card's `mouseleave` across the
  gap so the panel's `mouseenter` cancels it.
- Leaving the **left** edge of the card *or* the **left** edge of the panel closes the panel. This is
  deliberate: the container reserves extra space above and to the sides, so hanging the close
  behaviour on the container box would keep the panel open over dead space.
- **Click** the card to fold it down to a small corner badge showing 2 cells — label and balance;
  click again to restore it.
- **Keyboard:** the card is a `role="button"` with `tabIndex=0` and toggles the fold on `Enter` and
  `Space`. The panel is a `role="dialog"`.
- The panel header carries a **Refresh** button that immediately shows a busy label and then an
  `Updated at HH:MM:SS` timestamp, plus the manual *I just topped up* button, which shows a querying
  state while it works.
- **There are deliberately no `title` attributes anywhere in the HUD.** A native browser tooltip
  appears as an opaque black box about a second after hover and covers the panel, so the summary
  lives in `aria-label` instead — asserted by the smoke suite as a regression guard.

## Settings

The plugin contributes **one preference row** — `余额与花费 HUD` — to the DSH slot
`settings.general.item`, which DSH declares as *"one preference row inside the General section — the
additive seat for a single setting that needs no page of its own"* (a whole page is
`settings.section`; the same slot carries DSH's own Language, link-opening and performance-usage
rows). Find it at **Settings → General → 余额与花费 HUD**. It does **not** take over a whole settings
page.

| Setting | Values | Default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Model (`计价模型`) | `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro` | `deepseek-flash` | Price table used for the estimate and the apportionment weights |
| Price auto-sync interval (`自动同步价格`) | off / 6 h / 24 h / 3 d / 7 d | off | Auto-sync cadence for the official price table; nothing runs until you pick one (see [Prices and syncing](#prices-and-syncing)) |
| Foreground poll interval (`前台刷新间隔`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 60 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is visible |
| Hidden interval (`后台（页面隐藏）`) | 30 / 60 / 120 / 300 s | 300 s | Balance poll cadence while the page is hidden |
| Peak-warning lead time (`峰前提醒`) | 5 / 10 / 15 / 30 min | 10 min | How early the peak/off-peak warning appears |
| Session budget (`本会话预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for this session's estimated spend |
| Daily budget (`每日预算（元）`) | CNY, `0` = unset | 0 | Budget for the Beijing-day confirmed spend |
| Show account total row (`显示账户级合计`) | on / off | on | `Account total` row in the panel when parallel sessions exist |
| Peak warnings (`峰时提醒`) | on / off | on | The peak/off-peak warning line in the panel |
| System notification on budget breach (`预算超限发系统通知`) | on / off | off | Optional `Notification` when a budget level is first reached |

The shipped row is labelled in Chinese; the English names above are what each control means.

**Persistence.** The row writes the `localStorage` key `dsh-balance-hud:settings:v1` — deliberately
**separate** from the accounti

plugins.description: Agent 体检诊所 —— 用可复核证据诊断 Agent 使用体验问题
plugins.readme_text:
# agent-clinic · Agent 体检诊所

**装为 Skill**（一行命令，无需克隆、无需选位置、无需回答任何提问）：

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/main/install.sh | bash
```

**装为 DSH 插件**（侧边栏 → **插件** → **添加插件**，粘贴下面这行）：

```bash
https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic.git
```

> 装成插件后有侧边栏「🩺 体检」入口和全页面板。**装完必须完全退出并重启 Harness**——插件只在启动时装载。

> **你的 Agent 体检诊所。** 只读扫描本地 Agent 会话，用**可逐条复核的证据**诊断真实发生的使用体验问题（token 浪费、死循环、跨会话失忆、资产闲置），并为每个问题开出可执行的处方。

[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.15-blue)]()
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)]()
[![smoke](https://img.shields.io/badge/smoke-345%2F345-brightgreen)]()
[![CI](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/1687210989/agent-clinic/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> `smoke N/N` 是**本地自检的通过数**（由 smoke 自己在跑完后核对，数字对不上就以退出码 1 结束）——
> 想知道 CI 此刻是红是绿，看旁边那枚 **CI** 徽章（它就是 GitHub Actions 的实况，改不了）。

---

## 它解决什么问题

大多数 Agent 使用分析工具只给你一堆统计数字，你看完也不知道该干什么。

agent-clinic 的做法不同：**它给证据，也给处方。**

- 不只说"你有死循环"，而是说"10 月 8 日这个会话，`list_agents` 用同样的参数失败了 4 次，在 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd#L101-L108`"——一条命令你就能自己复核。
- 不只给建议，而是给**可执行的动作**：能整段粘进 profile 的 YAML 片段、斜杠命令、已核实插件的安装入口，或明确说没有插件能解。
- **读你的真实配置**再开口：处方会说"你现在 `maxInlineTokens=12500`（随附默认，profile 未覆盖）→ 建议 6000"，而不是"建议调低一点"。当前值已经不弱于建议时，这条处方会被撤掉 —— **而且会写出来**（报告里的「已评估但未给出的处方」段会列出被撤的原因和当前值，你才能复核这个判断，不会以为"根本没有这条建议"）。
- **宁可承认做不到，也不假装有数据**：从未实现的维度一律列在报告里并写明原因。第二轮评估用原始日志证伪了旧的"数据源缺失"说法后，E3/N3/N4 从"不可实现"变成**已实现**；K1/K2 曾如实写成"隐私取舍下的方案未定"，2026-10-15 定案（写入本地加盐指纹快照）后也已实现 —— 现在报告里"尚未实现的维度"是**空的**，而这一节会保留并显示"没有"。
- **检索插件目录做针对性推荐**：按「能力标签 + 关键词」匹配你的问题，并说明**为什么推荐它**（例如"能力标签 token-saving 对上 C1；你的问题描述里出现了 token、消耗"）。目录有三个来源并逐一标出：**人工核实 / npm registry 同步 / GitHub 核实**（经 `gh-proxy.com` 中继 GitHub API，按 star 数与最近更新检索；API 不通时退回人工种子清单 + `git ls-remote`）。**已经装过的插件不再推荐**，**官方内置包单独标注**（通常已随 dsh-base 挂载）。热度（star / 下载量）如实展示，只用于同分排序、不参与对症打分。
- **面板里一切皆可折叠**：问题卡点开能看到证据与**挂在它下面的处方**；处方卡点开才展开分步操作、片段、风险与出处。
- **同类型合并**：同一指标在多个会话命中（或同一种模式出现多次）只会显示**一张卡**并标出「N 处」，展开后每一处仍保留自己的会话、结论与证据定位 —— 不重复展示，也不丢信息。

> **不做的事**：不主动推送、不代你安装、不改你的配置、不诊断代码质量、不把任何对话内容发到外部。

---

## 诊断维度

**22 项已实现**

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 严重度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | token 消耗过快 | 会话**单位请求** output 超**其余主会话**基线 2 倍（基线逐会话排除自身；且总量 ≥2 万） | 高 |
| C2 | 上下文膨胀 | 末轮/首轮 input 增长 >10x 且 cacheRead <30% | 高 |
| C3 | 长会话疲劳 | 单会话消息数 >200 | 中 |
| C5 | 压缩可观测性 | 单会话压缩 ≥3 次，给出 **DSH 实测**释放 token（非估算） | 中 |
| C6 | 工具面成本 | 工具 schema >20000 字符（每请求重发）+ 窗口内 0 调用的工具 ≥5 个 | 中 |
| C7 | 上下文注入量 | 上下文被注入 ≥20 次且 ≥100000 字符 | 低 |
| E1 | 死循环 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 同错误，≥3 次 | 高 |
| E2 | 反复失败 | 会话工具错误率 >30% | 中 |
| E3 | 工具结果过大 | 单条工具结果 >8192 字符，会话内 ≥5 条 | 中 |
| E4 | 计划执行脱节 | 写计划后又大量调用工具，但 0 条完成 | 中 |
| E5 | 冗余重复调用 | 同工具 + 同参数 + 无错误，≥3 次 | 中 |
| N1 | 环境命令反复失败 | 命令类调用失败 ≥3 次 | 中 |
| N2 | 高风险操作 | 命令执行类工具命中 `rm -rf` / `--force` / `reset --hard` 等 | 高 |
| N3 | 权限审批摩擦 | 审批请求 ≥5 次（给出等待时长，以及**被拒 / 结果无法识别 / 无对应决定记录**三者分列） | 中 |
| N4 | API 重试频繁 | 模型请求重试 ≥3 次（给出失败码与累计退避） | 中 |
| A2 | skill 闲置 | 已装 skill 在 ≥30 天**日历窗口**内 0 次触发 | 中 |
| A3 | 高频手动序列 | **非通用工具**的两步序列 ≥5 次（去镜像、跨会话合并） | 低 |
| A4 | 子代理开销 | `delegationDepth>0` 会话 token 占比 >40% | 中 |
| A5 | 辅助 LLM 开销 | 辅助模型调用（联网检索 / 会话标题）≥20 次，给出 maxTokens 上界 | 中 |

> **C5/C6/C7/A5 是第三轮新增的"实测数据源"**（依据 `agent-clinic-待优化报告-DSH单平台.md`）：
> C1/C2 是**推断**浪费，而 DSH 自己就把**实测值**写进了日志 ——
> 压缩释放了多少 token（`shadowedTokenCount`）、工具 schema 多大、上下文注入多少、
> 辅助请求跑了几次。这四项**零隐私代价**（只记数字），
> 本机实测：压缩释放 **638,171** token、工具 schema **29,779** 字符/请求、
> 注入 **158,393** 字符、辅助调用 **96** 次。定义与阈值见 [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md)。

**0 项排期中、0 项尚未实现** —— 最后两项（A1、K1/K2）都于 2026-10-15 实现：

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 | MCP 闲置 | profile patch 里已配置 MCP 服务器，但观察窗口（≥30 天）内工具名 `mcp__<serverName>__*` **0 次调用** | 配置驱动；窗口不足只报"还差多久"，证据指向**配置行号**（`show` 可展开） |
| K1 | 跨会话失忆 | 同一用户文本指纹出现在 **≥3 个**不同会话 | 需要加盐哈希快照 `~/.agent-clinic/text-fingerprints.json`（正文不落盘，`fingerprints --clear` 可删） |
| K2 | 已解决重新排查 | 同一指纹在 ≥2 个会话出现，较晚那次之后有失败/重试，而最早那次之后没有 | **软信号**：只给"低"+措辞"疑似" |

| ID | 名称 | 判定 | 隐私代价 |
|---|---|---|---|
| K1 | 跨会话失忆 | 同一用户文本指纹出现在 **≥3 个**不同会话（两次可能是正常追问） | 需要把**加盐哈希**写入本地快照 `~/.agent-clinic/text-fingerprints.json`（正文不落盘）；`agent-clinic fingerprints --clear` 可删、`AGENT_CLINIC_NO_FINGERPRINT_STORE=1` 可关 |
| K2 | 已解决重新排查 | 同一指纹在 ≥2 个会话出现，较晚那次之后有失败/重试，而最早那次之后没有（**软信号，只给"低"+措辞"疑似"**） | 同上 |

> K1/K2 曾长期挂在"尚未实现"里，理由写的是"隐私取舍、方案未定"。2026-10-15 你选了
> **写入本地快照**这一档，于是它们从"方案未定"变成已实现 —— 代价与边界见
> [docs/diagnostics.md](docs/diagnostics.md) 的实现状态一节。

> E3 / N3 / N4 曾经也被列在上面这张表里，理由是"DSH 数据源缺失"。
> 第二轮评估（[docs/evaluation-2026-10-14.md](docs/evaluation-2026-10-14.md)）拿原始日志逐条证伪：
> 数据一直都在，是适配层没抽 —— 现已全部实现（只补长度/编号/结论，不落正文）。

> **未检测到异常 ≠ 已确认无异常。** 样本不足时（如 A2 的 30 天窗口），
> 报告会写「样本不足，无法判定」，而不是混在「未检测到异常」里。

---

## 当前状态

| 能力 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| DSH 会话解析（多帧 zstd） | ✅ 可用 |
| 统一事件模型 | ✅ 可用 |
| 聚合统计 | ✅ 可用 |
| 证据层 `show` | ✅ 可用 |
| **诊断指标 22 项** | ✅ **可用**（见上表） |
| **处方层（可执行：配置片段 / 命令 / 插件 / 设置 / 行为）** | ✅ **可用**（读本机真实配置，给出「当前值 → 建议值」；被撤掉的处方会写明原因） |
| **体检报告 `report`** | ✅ **可用** |

plugins.description: Read-only CSV/XLSX change review for DeepSeek Harness: align business keys, inspect values and formulas, and export review comments.
plugins.readme_text:
# SheetDiff

Review spreadsheet changes before trusting them.

SheetDiff compares two CSV or XLSX files by a business key, not by row position. It produces a local HTML report where you can inspect values, types, formulas and stored formula results, then leave comments for a follow-up with your agent.

It is an independent DeepSeek Harness plugin. It also has a small CLI. It does not edit workbooks, calculate formulas, upload data, or require an API key.

![Local review report showing a formula change and an exported comment](docs/review-demo.jpg)

## Try it locally

Requires Node.js 22.19 or newer. Clone the repository and try the synthetic demo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff.git
cd dsh-sheet-diff
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm test
npm run demo
```

The demo writes two **synthetic** workbooks and a `report.html` to a new directory under `artifacts/`. Open the printed report path in a browser. The expected result is three added rows and four changed cells: two amounts, one formula with a changed stored result, and one number changed to text. Reordering rows and columns adds no changes.

For your own files:

```sh
node src/cli.js before.xlsx after.xlsx --key OrderID --out review-001
node src/cli.js examples/before.csv examples/after.csv --key OrderID --out review-csv
```

`--out` must name a new directory. Use repeated `--key` flags for a composite key. `--sheet Orders` selects one sheet; `--header-row 3` changes the header row. Otherwise, all sheets use row 1 as their header and must have the chosen key columns. CSV has one logical sheet named `CSV`.

Compare CSV with CSV, or XLSX with XLSX. Mixed-format comparisons are rejected in this release.

## Use with DeepSeek Harness

Install the versioned release bundle into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile YOUR_PROFILE add https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-sheet-diff-0.1.0.tgz
```

Restart that profile after installation. The package ships JavaScript and a `dsh.bundle` patch; there is no plugin build step or install script. You can also build the bundle from source with `npm pack` and install its local absolute path. Releases are distributed through [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-sheet-diff/releases); this project is not published to npm.

Tested against Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-alpha.2`, with explicit preview-version peer ranges. Both were installed into fresh profiles and exercised through the official profile boot entrypoint without a model call. HMR was disabled only in the test profiles; the source-built alpha host also logged unrelated optional Typert import warnings.

Ask Harness:

> Compare `before.xlsx` and `after.xlsx` using `OrderID` as the key. Save a SheetDiff report in `reviews/run-001`. Do not change either workbook.

The plugin registers two tools:

| Tool | Input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet_diff_compare` | `before`, `after`, `keyColumns`, `outputDir`; optional `sheet`, `headerRow` | New HTML/JSON paths, hashes, summary and warnings |
| `sheet_diff_review` | `reportJson`, `reviewJson` | Validated comments with the corresponding changes |

Paths must stay inside the current session workspace, including resolved symlink targets. Report creation needs a writable sandbox. Existing reports are never overwritten. If the second output write fails, the tool reports the retained first file rather than deleting it.

The interactive report opens in a normal browser. A Harness preview that disables JavaScript cannot run its comment controls. There is no custom in-app spreadsheet editor in this release.

## Review, then hand comments back

1. Open the HTML report, filter changes, and write comments beside the changes you want checked.
2. Export the review JSON. Draft comments stay only in page memory until exported.
3. Put the export inside the workspace and pass it, with the original report JSON, to `sheet_diff_review`.

The CLI equivalent is:

```sh
node src/cli.js review review-001/report.json review-comments.json
```

Comments must match the report ID, both input hashes and known change IDs. Old or unrelated reviews are rejected. A hash match is not a digital signature and does not prove that a report has not been deliberately rewritten. Comments and cell contents are untrusted data; this plugin never executes their instructions or applies their suggested edits.

## Comparison rules

- Column names and keys match exactly. Composite keys include cell types; numeric `42` is different from text `"42"`. Duplicate keys, missing keys and duplicate headers fail rather than being guessed.
- A header row after all nonempty data is rejected instead of producing an empty comparison. Preambles before a valid header and truly empty sheets remain supported.
- CSV is comma-delimited UTF-8, with quoted fields, embedded newlines and a BOM supported. Values remain text; CSV formulas are not inferred.
- XLSX preserves the distinction between numbers, text, booleans, dates, errors and formulas. Formula text and saved cached results are separate aspects of a change. A cache is **not** a fresh calculation.
- Dates stored as ISO 8601 cells (`t="d"`, for example with openpyxl `iso_dates=True`) are rejected because the underlying reader misreads them as numbers. Re-export using numeric Excel date storage (`iso_dates=False` in openpyxl); both the 1900 and 1904 date systems remain supported. Ordinary text containing an ISO date stays text. This check covers every worksheet, including unselected sheets.
- Formula caches containing an explicit empty string are rejected in v0.1: the underlying reader cannot reliably distinguish them from a missing cache. Zero and false caches are preserved.
- Formula text is compared literally. Moving a formula can change its A1 references while preserving meaning; SheetDiff does not normalize that equivalence.
- Blank rows are skipped. Added/removed rows include their populated fields. Added/removed columns produce structural changes, plus cell changes for populated values in retained rows.
- Sheet renames are reported as removal and addition. Key changes are reported as row removal and addition.

This is a table-data review tool, not a whole-workbook fidelity check. Formatting, number formats, merged layout, charts, pivots, images, comments and hyperlink targets are outside its scope. Hidden data is still read; visibility itself is not compared. Legacy XLS, macros, encrypted archives and external workbook connections are unsupported. Complex multi-table sheets may need to be exported to separate tables first.

## Limits and privacy

Inputs are capped at 20 MiB each, XLSX expanded contents at 64 MiB and 8 MiB per ZIP part, and comparisons at 10,000 change records or 24 MiB of serialized changes. The parser also caps serialized cells/rows at 100,000 and checks expanded merge, column and validation ranges before parsing. Exceeding a limit fails the comparison; a shortened report is never presented as complete.

Reports include changed cell data, source filenames and hashes. Treat HTML, report JSON and review JSON as sensitive as the workbooks. Sharing is manual. The page has no remote resources, analytics or automatic persistence. When used inside an AI host, tool results and imported comments may be sent to that host's configured model as part of its normal operation.

## Development

```sh
npm test
npm run smoke:host
npm pack --dry-run
```

`smoke:host` loads the shipped patch using a real Cordis loader and dispatches both tools through the real tool runtime, filesystem provider and sandbox policy. It also checks source bytes, overwrite rejection and plugin disposal. It uses a fresh temporary workspace; it does not change an existing Harness profile. The test is separate from a full CLI installation and does not use a live model.

## 中文简介

AI 改完表格后，先看清楚改了什么，再决定是否采用。SheetDiff 按订单号、账户号等业务主键对齐记录，避免把行列重排当成大量修改；数值、类型、公式和保存的计算结果分开显示。你可以在本地报告中逐条评论，导出后交回 Harness 继续处理。

首版只读 CSV/XLSX，不上传表格、不重算公式、不自动改文件。它不是表格编辑器，也不承诺检测格式、图表或所有 Excel 功能的变化。

MIT licensed. Bug reports are most useful with a small anonymized example and the expected comparison result. Please do not post confidential workbooks.

plugins.description: Use your Zed AI subscription (Pro / Student) from DeepSeek Harness: registers the zed-agent route with Claude + GPT models, an editable Models-page card and a model chooser.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-zed-provider

Run your **Zed AI subscription** (Zed Pro / Student — the monthly prompt credits)
inside DeepSeek Harness. The bundle registers one LLM provider route,
`zed-agent`, whose turns are minted and streamed through Zed Cloud
(`https://cloud.zed.dev`) exactly as the Zed editor does it.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zed-provider
```

## Link your Zed account

Type `/zed-login` in the Harness composer. The command opens Zed's native-app
sign-in page, waits for the loopback callback, and stores the resulting grant in
the Harness credential store (`llm-zed/zed-agent`). Later requests reuse it, and
the short-lived gateway token is minted automatically and refreshed on demand.

Credentials are resolved in this order, so any one of them is enough:

1. `config.credentials` — a literal `"<userId> <accessToken>"` (or JSON) value.
2. `config.apiKeyEnv` (default `ZED_CREDENTIALS`) — resolved through the
   credential seam. The Models settings page shows this as the Zed card's key
   field, so a credential pasted there works without `/zed-login`.
3. The `llm-zed/zed-agent` grant record written by `/zed-login`.
4. The Zed editor's own local keyring entry, on macOS (`zed.dev`) and Linux
   (`secret-tool`), imported once into the grant record — sign in inside Zed and
   this plugin picks it up by itself.

`apiKeyEnv` is spelled that way because the Models page reads exactly that field
name; its value is a credential *reference*, and what it holds is the
`"<userId> <accessToken>"` pair Zed issues.

## Settings UI

Settings → **Models** → the **Zed** card carries this bundle's own editor
(`lib/client.js`, a client-module half registered on the page's
`settings.models.provider-card` seat for the `llm-zed` namespace):

- credential status, from the card's credential join plus a live
  `credentials/describe`;
- a credential field that stores `"<userId> <accessToken>"` under the reference
  `apiKeyEnv` names (read live from the settings document, default
  `ZED_CREDENTIALS`), with **Remove** to unset it;
- a refusal instead of a silent no-op when that reference is supplied by a
  read-only source such as an environment variable.

It also carries the **model chooser**: the Host registers
`llm.registerModelDiscovery` for this namespace, the page reads it through
`llm/discoverModels`, and the tick boxes write `visibleModels` through
`settings/mutate`. That field is volatile, so a tick changes the picker on the
next catalog read without a reload; an empty or complete selection unsets it,
meaning "offer every model this plugin can run".

`baseUrl` stays a composition-only field in `cordis.patch.yml`.

The client fiber hard-injects only `slots`, `locale` and `remote`, and picks the
credential remote up through `ctx.inject(['remote.credentials'], …)`. That is
deliberate: the web boot asserts that every client entry activated, so a root
client plugin that waits on a service the settings UI keeps private (such as
`settingsScope`) takes the whole GUI boot down with
`<package>: pending (waiting for service: …)`.

## Models

`listModels` reads `GET /models` with your credential and advertises the models
Zed reports for the backends this plugin implements — **Claude** (Anthropic
Messages) and **GPT** (OpenAI Responses). Zed's Gemini and Grok entries are
filtered out rather than offered broken; selecting one anyway fails fast with
`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`.

Each model carries Zed's own context window, output cap, and — when
`supports_thinking` — the effort levels `off` / `low` / `high` / `max`, mapped
onto Anthropic extended thinking budgets.

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZED_CREDENTIALS` | Credential reference holding `"<userId> <accessToken>"`. |
| `credentials` | absent | Literal credential value; highest priority, composition-time. |
| `baseUrl` | `https://cloud.zed.dev` | Zed Cloud endpoint. |
| `visibleModels` | all supported | Narrow the catalog to these model ids. |

## Quota

Zed owns the accounting: no plan or no credits left answers HTTP 402, which
surfaces as a `QUOTA` failure naming https://zed.dev/account. The plugin does
not invent percentages or limits.

## Development

`pnpm install` (which runs the `prepare` hook), then `pnpm check` —
typecheck, build, tests. Sources are TypeScript under `src/`; `lib/` is build
output and is git-ignored, because the `prepare`/`prepack` hooks rebuild it
wherever the package is consumed and the published tarball carries the built
copy through the `files` allowlist.

A profile can install this bundle as a `link:` to a working copy, in which case
that copy's `lib/` is what the Host imports: rebuild after changing `src/`, or
the Host keeps running the previous build.

`node --test test/*.test.mjs` covers the pieces that fail silently in
production: the NDJSON → `StreamChunk` translation for both backends
(`src/frames.ts` framing, `src/parse.ts` Anthropic events, `src/responses.ts`
Responses events), the RSA sign-in handshake (`src/signin.ts`), the request
projections (`src/anthropic.ts`, `src/responses.ts`), and the card's slot
registration, credential and model-selection wiring (`src/client.ts`, loaded
under a stubbed module loader in `test/client.test.mjs`). The tests import the
built `lib/`, because that is what the Harness actually runs. Only
`src/index.ts` touches the Harness runtime.

Two install-time facts worth knowing: the Host half is re-imported only by a
profile restart (ESM caches by URL), and the client half is composed from the
Loader's entries at Host boot, so adding or removing `exports["./client"]` takes
a restart too — after that it is served per request under a content hash, so
client-side edits reach the browser on the next load.

plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-key-rotate) **关键词**：密钥轮换 · 密钥管理 · 证书轮换 · 证书过期 · 密钥过期 · 密码周期 · 密钥复用 **Keywords**: key rotation · secret rotation · certificate rotation · key management · cryptoperiod **密钥轮换** —— 查密钥与证书多久没换了、有没有轮换制度、有没有跨环境复用。 ## 不装它会怎样 你的 `id_rsa` 是两年前配的，一直没动。制度文档也许写了「密钥每年轮换」。 **但事实上它就是没换过。** 等保测评会问「鉴别信息多久更换一次」，客户尽调会问「密钥管理流程」—— 你拿不出证据，因为**文件时间戳就摆在那里**。 ## 它查什么 | 级别 | 内容 | |---|---| | 🔴 高 | 密钥/证书文件超过一年未更新（按 mtime）| | 🟡 中 | 文档里找不到轮换策略 | | 🟡 中 | 同一密钥在多个环境配置里被引用 | ## 为什么这是可判定的 ``` 密钥文件 mtime → 距今多少天 → 对比阈值（默认 365 天） ``` 制度写在纸上，**时间戳不会说谎**。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate # 或纯 CLI npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-key-rotate ``` ## 用法 ```bash dsh-key-rotate --demo # 看检出效果 dsh-key-rotate --list-rules # 列出规则和依据 dsh-key-rotate --html r.html ``` ![dsh-key-rotate 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/report.png) ![dsh-key-rotate 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/demo.png) ![dsh-key-rotate 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-key-rotate/rules.png) ## 边界 - **年龄 ≠ 未轮换** —— 密钥可能在 plugins.description: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直连本地模型：兼容 OpenAI 协议（llama.cpp / LM Studio / vLLM / Ollama 的 /v1）与 Ollama 原生 API。无需登录、不消耗账号 token。
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-local-model **让 DeepSeek Harness 直连本地模型 —— 不用登录账号，也不消耗云端 token。** [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-local-model?color=blue)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-local-model) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-local-model)](./LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/dsh-local-model)](./package.json) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.0--rc.2-6c5ce7)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) > A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that connects the > harness to **local models** through any OpenAI-compatible endpoint or Ollama's native API. > No account sign-in, no cloud token consumption. · [English](#english) section below. --- ## 目录 - [这个插件做什么](#这个插件做什么) - [支持的本地后端](#支持的本地后端) - [安装](#安装) - [快速开始](#快速开始) - [配置项](#配置项) - [常见问题](#常见问题) - [工作原理](#工作原理) - [开发与发布](#开发与发布) - [License](#license) ## 这个插件做什么 DeepSeek Harness 默认走 DeepSeek 云端模型。本插件注册一个自定义 LLM 适配器（provider 路由 `local`）， 把 Harness 的模型请求**直接转发到你本机的推理服务**： - 🚫 **零账号依赖** —— 完全不访问 `api.deepseek.com` 或任何账号接口，不读取账号凭据，因此不产生任何云端计费。 - 🔌 **双传输协议** —— OpenAI 兼容协议 + Ollama 原生协议，两者都支持。 - 🧰 **完整工具调用** —— 正确转换 Harness 的工具调用/工具结果历史，Agent 的 bash、文件、子代理等工具都能正常用。 - 🩹 **文本工具调用兜底** —— 部分本地模型（如 `qwen2.5-coder`）会把工具调用写成纯文本 JSON，插件会自动识别并转成真正的工具调用。 - 🔍 **模型自动发现** —— 自动从本地端点拉取模型列表（Ollama `/api/tags`、OpenAI `/v1/models`）。 - ⚡ **热更新** —— 所有配置字段都是 volatile，改完无需重启。 - 🖥️ **可视化界面** —— 自带浏览器端 UI：在「设置 → 模型」的 **Local Model** 卡片里可直接 **测试连接**并列出本机可用模型；插件配置也在图形界面里完成，无需手改配置文件。 ## 支持的本地后端 | 后端 | `api` | `baseURL` | | --- | --- | --- | | **Ollama（原生，推荐）** | `ollama` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434` | | **Ollama（OpenAI 端点）** | `openai` | `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` | | **LM Studio** | `openai` | `http://localhost:1234/v1` | | **llama.cpp server** | `openai` | `http://localhost:8080/v1` | | **vLLM / SGLang** | `openai` | `http://localhost:8000/v1` | | **LocalAI / text-generation-webui** | `openai` | `<你的端点>/v1` | > **优先推荐直接使用本地模型**：只要后端提供 OpenAI 兼容端点，就用 `openai` 模式直连； > 用 Ollama 且想要原生 `thinking`/reasoning 支持时，用 `ollama` 模式。 ## 安装 ### 方式 A：命令行安装（推荐） ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` > 其中 `web` 是 profile 名；桌面版通常为 `desktop`，请按你的 profile 调整。 ### 方式 B：在 Harness 界面里安装 打开 **设置 → 插件市场**（或 **插件** 页），搜索 `dsh-local-model`，点击一键安装。 大多数插件安装后刷新页面即可生效，无需重启。 ### 方式 C：从 GitHub 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:/dsh-local-model ``` ### 方式 D：手动安装（无需发布） ```bash # 1. 克隆到 profile 之外任意目录 git clone https://github.com/songzhiyin/dsh-local-model.git # 2. 在 profile 里把它作为本地 link 安装 cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add link:/绝对路径/dsh-local-model # 3. 编辑 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json， # 在 dsh.profile.bundles 里加入 "dsh-local-model" # 4. 重启 Harness（或在插件页刷新） ``` ## 快速开始 以 Ollama 为例： ```bash # 1. 启动 Ollama 并拉取一个带 tools 能力的模型 ollama serve ollama pull qwen2.5-coder:14b # 2. 安装插件（见上一节） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` 然后在 Harness 里： 1. **设置 → 模型** → 找到 **Local Model** provider，确认端点（默认 `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`）； 2. 打开任意会话，在**模型选择器**里把 provider 切到 **Local Model**，选一个模型； 3. 直接开始对话即可 —— 全程本地推理。 > 💡 跑 Agent 工具调用建议选**原生支持 function calling** 的模型（如 `qwen3-coder`、`llama3.1`、`devstral`）； > 若模型只会把工具调用写成文本（如部分 `qwen2.5-coder` 版本），插件内置的兜底也会把它转成真正的工具调用。 ## 配置项 在 **插件页 → dsh-local-model → 配置**，或 **设置 → 模型 → Local Model** 中设置： | 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `api` | `"openai" \| "ollama"` | `"openai"` | 传输协议 | | `baseURL` | string | `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1` | 本地端点根地址；留空按 `api` 自动选择 | | `apiKey` | string | `""` | 本地服务需要鉴权时填写（如 LM Studio 的 key） | | `defaultModel` | string | `""` | 端点无法枚举模型时的兜底模型名 | | `contextWindow` | integer | `8192` | 默认上下文窗口（token） | | `maxTokens` | integer | `2048` | 默认单次最大输出 token 数 | | `temperature` | number | `0.7` | 默认采样温度（0–2） | | `streamIdleTimeoutMs` | number | `300000` | 流式读取空闲超时（毫秒） | | `models` | array | `[]` | 静态模型清单，用于端点不支持列表查询时手动声明 | `models` 示例： ```json [ { "id": "qwen2.5-coder:14b", "name": "Qwen2.5-Coder 14B", "contextWindow": 32768, "maxTokens": 4096 } ] ``` ## 可视化界面 插件包含一个浏览器端半身（`lib/client.js`），它向「设置 → 模型」页的 provider 卡片扩展槽位 `settings.models.provider-card`（keyed，key = `dsh-local-model`）注册一张卡片： ``` ┌─ 本地模型连接测试 ─────────────────────────────────┐ │ provider: local · 名称: Local Model · 已配置: 是 │ │ 协议 [ openai（OpenAI 兼容） ▾ ] │ │ 端点 [ http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 ] [ 测试连接 ] │ │ ✅ 连接成功，发现 4 个模型 │ │ (qwen3-coder:30b) (llama3.1:8b) … │ └────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` - 切换 `openai` / `ollama` 协议会自动填入对应的默认端点； - 「测试连接」分别请求 `/models` 或 `/api/tags`，直接显示可用模型列表； - 失败时给出可操作的提示（服务未启动 / 地址错误 / CORS 跨域）。 > 该卡片只做连通性验证；**api / baseURL / apiKey 等配置仍由上方「编辑」按钮的配置表单负责**（由插件 > 的 `Config` schema 自动渲染）。 客户端半身是**手写的 Lazy-CJS bundle**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`）， 只依赖平台模块表里的 `react`，不需要任何打包步骤、也不需要 `dsh.client.external`。 ## 常见问题 **Q：模型列表是空的？** 确认本地服务已启动且 `baseURL` 正确。若端点不支持 `/models`（或 `/api/tags`），请在 `models` 里手动声明。 **Q：报 `AUTH` 错误？** 说明本地服务需要鉴权，把 key 填进 `apiKey`。 **Q：模型把工具调用当纯文本吐出来（`{"name":"skill","arguments":{...}}`）？** 这是该模型的工具调用能力问题，不是插件问题。插件已内置**文本工具调用兜底**：会识别 `{...}` JSON、 `...`、` ```json {...} ``` ` 三种写法，并在工具名匹配时自动转成真正的工具调用。 如果仍不稳定，建议换用原生支持 function calling 的模型。 **Q：reasoning / 思考内容怎么显示？** `openai` 模式读取 `reasoning_content`，`ollama` 模式读取 `thinking`，都会映射为 Harness 的 reasoning 块。 **Q：长对话被截断？** 多数本地服务有自己的上下文上限（Ollama 默认 `num_ctx=4096`）。可以用环境变量放宽，例如 `OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=32768 ollama serve`，或改用长上下文模型（如 `devstral`）。 **Q：「测试连接」报 `Failed to fetch`，但命令行 `curl` 明明能通？** 这是 **`localhost` 的 IPv6 陷阱**：在部分环境下 `localhost` 会先解析到 IPv6 `::1`， 而 Ollama 等本地服务通常只监听 IPv4 `127.0.0.1`，于是浏览器直连失败。 本插件已内置两道防护： 1. **探测默认走宿主进程**（`ctx.remote.llm.discoverModels()`）——由 Node 侧发起请求， 完全绕开浏览器的 CORS / IPv6 / Electron 网络策略； 2. 默认地址一律用 **`127.0.0.1`** 而不是 `localhost`，并对回环地址做 `localhost ⇄ 127.0.0.1` 的自动兜底重试。 如果你在配置里手写了 `localhost`，建议改成 `127.0.0.1`。 ## 工作原理 插件通过 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter(["local"], adapter)` 注册一个 `LlmAdapter`，把 Harness 的 `GenerateOptions` 翻译成目标协议的请求，再把流式响应翻译回 Harness 的 `StreamChunk` （`block-start` / `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` / `tool-call-delta` / `block-end` / `usage` / `finish`）。 - 不访问任何 DeepSeek 云端端点； - 不读取账号凭据，因此不产生云端 token 消耗； - 文件引用与图片由 Harness 运行时自动投影为文本句柄（文本模型），适配器只需处理文本与工具调用。 ## 开发与发布 ```bash git clone https://github.com/songzhiyin/dsh-local-model.git cd dsh-local-model # 本地 link 到你的 DSH profile 做开发（改代码即时生效） cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop pnpm add link:/绝对路径/dsh-local-model ``` 发布到 npm： ```bash npm publish # publishConfig.access 已设为 public ``` 上架插件市场（可选，让更多人发现）： 向 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 仓库提交一个 PR， 加入一条注册表条目（`name` / `owner` / `url` / `category` / `description` / `npm` / `install` / `added`）， 市场与官网会自动收录。 ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) --- ## English **Connect DeepSeek Harness to local models — no account sign-in, no cloud token usage.** `dsh-local-model` registers a `local` LLM adapter that routes every model call to your own machine: - **Zero account dependency** — never touches `api.deepseek.com` or any account endpoint. - **Two transports** — OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions`, and Ollama's native `/api/chat` (NDJSON, with `thinking` support). - **Full tool calling** — converts Harness tool-call / tool-result history correctly, plus a fallback that recovers tool calls some local models emit as plain-text JSON. - **Model discovery** — pulls the model list from `GET /models` or `GET /api/tags`. - **Visual configuration** — configure it from the Harness **Plugins** page or **Settings → Models**; no config file editing. ### Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` Or search for `dsh-local-model` in **Settings → Plugin Market** inside Harness. ### Quick start (Ollama) ```bash ollama serve ollama pull qwen3-coder # any tool-capable model works dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-local-model ``` Then, inside Harness: **Settings → Models** confirms the **Local Model** provider (default endpoint `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`), and you pick it from the session's model selector.

收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-least-privilege) **关键词**：最小权限 · 权限过宽 · 权限管理 · 容器 root · IAM · CORS · 访问控制 · 权限最小化 · 特权容器 privileged: true ``` 当时是为了让容器能访问某个设备，后来那个需求没了，**但这行留下了**。 哪天应用出了个漏洞，攻击者进到容器里 —— 而因为 `privileged`， 他拿到的几乎是**宿主机**。 **权限过宽是入侵的放大器**，而且它**没有任何症状** —— 系统照常跑， 直到出事那天你才发现那把钥匙能开所有的门。 ## 它查什么 | 级别 | 内容 | |---|---| | 🔴 高 | 容器跑 root / `--privileged` · IAM `Action: *` | | 🟡 中 | CORS 允许所有来源 · 令牌申请 admin/全量 scope | ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege # 或纯 CLI npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-least-privilege ``` ## 用法 ```bash dsh-least-privilege --demo dsh-least-privilege --list-rules dsh-least-privilege --html r.html ``` ![dsh-least-privilege plugins.description: 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）设置页里创建/编辑 agent 预设的可视化工作台：分段提示词 + 能力开关 + 内置模板。A visual agent-preset workbench for DSH.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-preset-workbench

> 在 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）设置页里，创建与编辑 Agent 预设的可视化工作台——不用写 YAML，不用求创造模式代劳。
> A visual workbench on the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) Settings page for creating and editing agent presets — no YAML, no asking the "creation mode" to do it for you.

---

**[中文](#中文) · [English](#english)**

---

## 中文

## 简介

预设是 DSH 新会话的“开局配置包”：选定哪个预设，会话里的 AI 就是什么人设、什么能力。本插件把预设的编辑变成设置页里的一页可视化工具：

- **分段提示词**：每段独立标题与内容，勾选框控制这段是否进入系统提示词（不勾 = 文字保留但不给 AI 看）
- **能力开关**：15 项可选工具能力，勾选即写入组合文件、取消即移除，每次切换自动做挂载校验
- **会话里直接换预设**：输入框上方一个胶囊，换预设后排到下一次自动压缩后生效；可设一直显示 / 悬浮才显示 / 不显示
- **内置模板**：随插件自带“鲸鱼娘”“梁神模式”“空提示词”三套预设，任何机器安装即用
- **四页结构**：查看 / 新建 / 预设是什么？ / 对话中切换预设
- **安全边界**：系统预设只读；绝不覆盖本机已有预设；高权限能力带环境预检

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 分段提示词编辑 | 每段：启用勾选 / 标题 / 内容，可增删段落 |
| **来源徽章** | 每个预设标注 📦 内置模板 / 📦·✏️ 已改动 / 👤 自定义 / 官方预设，一眼分清“随插件发布的模板”和“你自己创作的” |
| 新建预设 | 选模板后就地展开它的段落与能力开关，改完直接“另存为新预设”——模板本体不动，不必先复制再回头编辑 |
| 会话内切换 | 输入框上方的预设胶囊；已开始的会话排队到下一次自动压缩后生效，胶囊显示「当前 › 目标」，菜单里 ✓ 表示生效中、行尾「下次压缩后」表示待生效 |
| 胶囊显示方式 | 「对话中切换预设」页可选：一直显示 / 鼠标悬浮才出现 / 不显示（偏好存在本机浏览器） |
| 能力开关 | 15 项能力：勾选写入、取消移除、自动校验；含“预留接线（disabled）”模式。`command-compact`（/compact 命令）可关；人设与自动压缩仍锁定 |
| 打开目录 | 一键在资源管理器中打开该预设文件夹 |
| 校验挂载 | 模拟会话加载，报告组合错误 |
| 删除预设 | 两击确认防误删；仅限用户预设 |

### 来源徽章怎么看

| 徽章 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| 📦 **内置模板** | id 与插件 `templates/` 里的模板同名，且内容与模板**逐字节一致**——这些内容已随插件公开 |
| 📦 **内置模板 · ✏️ 已改动** | 名字是模板，但内容有你自己的东西——**不要假定它和模板一样可以公开** |
| 👤 **自定义** | 不在内置模板之列，是你自己创作的预设 |
| **官方预设** | 由 DSH 官方或第三方插件声明，磁盘上没有目录，本工作台只能查看 |

**判定规则**：只比对一个方向——模板里的每个文件，在你的目录里是否都存在且内容相同。多出来的文件会被忽略，因为 `sections.json` 是预设唯一的段落清单（没有自动发现机制）：你真正用到的内容要么改动了模板文件，要么改动了 `sections.json`，两种都会被判为「已改动」；而未被引用的多余文件不会进入预设渲染，据此报警只会产生误报。

## 安装

```bash
# 从本地目录安装
dsh plugin add --profile web <本插件目录的绝对路径>

# 或从 GitHub 仓库安装
dsh plugin add --profile web github:<你的用户名>/dsh-preset-workbench
```

安装后**重启 dsh**，打开 **设置 → 预设工作台** 即可使用。包内含 `templates/`（鲸鱼娘、梁神、空提示词三套内置模板），所以 `npm install dsh-preset-workbench` 或 `dsh plugin add dsh-preset-workbench` 安装后开箱即用。

## 使用

1. 打开设置 → 预设工作台
2. 下拉框选择一个用户预设（鲸鱼娘 / 梁神 / 空提示词 / 你自己建的）
3. 编辑各段提示词 → 点「💾 保存全部」→ **下次新开的会话**生效
4. 新建自己的预设：填 id（英文小写）与显示名 → 从模板创建 → 改内容 → 保存
5. 给预设加能力：展开「🧰 能力开关」打勾，每次切换自动校验

## 能力开关

15 项可分三档：

| 档位 | 能力 |
| --- | --- |
| 🟢 安全 | 联网搜索+抓取、标准文件工具、AGENTS.md 工作区指令、技能库、提问确认、任务清单、后台任务、长期目标、规划模式 |
| 🟡 中等 | 子代理+工作流（含 Ralph 迭代代理） |
| 🔴 高危（带预检） | PPT/代码模式演示（需宿主 codeRuntime，否则安全拒绝）、插件改制工具 cordis_* |
| 🔌 预留接线 | Codex、Claude Code 产品子代理（写入官方同款 disabled 行，启用需另装捆绑）、一次性 bash/pwsh |

地基能力（命令 shell、文件编辑器、长对话压缩）永远在，不设开关、不受勾选影响。

## 内置模板

| 模板 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `cetacea`（鲸鱼娘） | 极简角色扮演模板：持久 shell + 文件编辑器 + 压缩 + 分段人设（自带分段装载器） |
| `liangshen`（梁神模式） | 全功能预设：文件/搜索/技能/目标/规划/压缩/子代理/workflow/Ralph/联网等 |
| `bare`（空提示词） | 裸模模板：没有系统提示词、也没有工具（装配阶段清空工具表）；人设分段初始为空，加一段就有提示词 |

模板随插件打包发布，安装即用；创建时复制到新 id 名下，**不影响本机已有同名预设**。

## 工作原理

- 预设 = `.agent-presets/<id>` 下的一个文件夹（组合文件 + 提示词分段 + 元数据）
- 本插件 = 设置页新页 + 一个 loopback HTTP 桥（`/api/preset-workbench`）
- 能力开关 = 在组合文件里插入/移除带标记的工具行；每次切换后自动跑挂载校验
- 模板复制 = 插件内 `templates/` 只读素材 → 复制到新 id，重写显示名；id 被占用即拒绝，绝不覆盖
- 只改用户预设；官方内置预设（standard/code/minimal/cordis）一律只读

## 常见问题

- **会覆盖我已有的同名预设吗？** 不会。创建时检查 id，冲突则拒绝并提示“预设 id 已被占用”。
- **能改官方系统预设吗？** 不能，所有写操作仅限用户预设。
- **改动什么时候生效？** 保存后对**之后新开的会话**生效，当前会话不变。



## 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

---

## English

## Intro

Presets are DSH's "starting config pack" for new sessions: choosing a preset defines who the session's AI is and what it can do. This plugin turns preset editing into one visual page inside Settings:

- **Sectioned prompts**: each section has its own title/content; the checkbox decides whether it enters the system prompt (unchecked = text kept but hidden from the AI)
- **Capability toggles**: 15 optional tool capabilities — check to write the rows into the composition, uncheck to remove, auto-validated on every toggle
- **Switch preset mid-conversation**: a chip above the composer; a switch queues until the next automatic compaction. Choose always visible / on hover / hidden
- **Built-in templates**: ships with three presets ("鲸鱼娘 / Whale Girl", "梁神模式 / Liangshen Mode", "空提示词 / Bare"), ready on any machine after install
- **Four tabs**: View / New / What is a preset? / Switch preset mid-conversation
- **Safety boundaries**: system presets are read-only; existing local presets are never overwritten; high-power capabilities carry environment pre-checks

## Features

| Feature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Sectioned prompt editor | Per-section: enabled checkbox / title / content; add & remove sections |
| **Provenance badge** | Every preset is labelled 📦 built-in template / 📦·✏️ modified / 👤 custom / official, so "ships with the plugin" and "you wrote it" are never confused |
| Create presets | Pick a template and edit its sections and capabilities in place, then "Save as new preset" — the template itself is never modified, and there is no copy-then-edit round trip |
| Switch mid-conversation | Preset chip above the composer; a running session queues the switch until its next automatic compaction, the chip shows "current › target", and the menu marks ✓ for the active preset and "next compaction" for the pending one |
| Chip visibility | On the "Switch preset mid-conversation" page: always visible / on hover / hidden (preference stored in this browser) |
| Capability toggles | 15 capabilities, write-on-check / remove-on-uncheck, auto mount validation, plus "wired but disabled" mode |
| Open directory | One click to reveal the preset folder in the file explorer |
| Validate mount | Simulates session loading and reports composition errors |
| Delete preset | Double-click confirm (anti-mistake); user presets only |

### Reading the provenance badge

| Badge | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 📦 **Built-in template** | The id matches a template in the plugin's `templates/`, and the content matches it **byte for byte** — that content is already public with the plugin |
| 📦 **Built-in template · ✏️ modified** | The name is a template's, but the content contains your own additions — **do not assume it is as public as the template** |
| 👤 **Custom** | Not one of the built-in templates; a preset you authored |
| **Official preset** | Declared by DSH or a third-party plugin with no directory on disk; view-only here |

**How "modified" is decided**: only one direction is compared — for every file in the shipped template, does your directory contain it with identical content? Extra files are ignored, because `sections.json` is the preset's only section manifest (there is no auto-discovery): anything you actually use either changes a template file or changes `sections.json`, and both are detected, while unreferenced leftovers never reach the rendered preset and would only cause false alarms.

## Install

```bash
# local directory
dsh plugin add --profile web /absolute/path/to/this/plugin

# or from GitHub
dsh plugin add --profile web github:<your-username>/dsh-preset-workbench
```

**Restart dsh** after installing, then open **Settings → 预设工作台 (Preset Workbench)**. The package ships `templates/` (Whale Girl, Liangshen & Bare built-in templates), so `npm install dsh-preset-workbench` or `dsh plugin add dsh-preset-workbench` works out of the box.

## Usage

1. Open Settings → Preset Workbench
2. Pick a user preset from the dropdown (Whale Girl / Liangshen / Bare / yours)
3. Edit prompt sections → click「💾 Save All」→ takes effect on **new** sessions
4. Create your own: fill in an id (lowercase english) + display name → create from template → edit → save
5. Add capabilities: open「🧰 Capability Toggles」and check any item — each toggle auto-validates

## Capabilities

15 items in three risk tiers:

| Tier | Items |
| --- | --- |
| 🟢 Safe | Web search + fetch, standard file tools, AGENTS.md, skills, ask-user confirmations, todo, background jobs, long-term goals, plan mode |
| 🟡 Medium | Subagents + workflows (incl. Ralph iterative agent) |
| 🔴 High (pre-checked) | PPT/code-mode presentation (requires host codeRuntime, otherwise safely refused), cordis_* plugin tooling |
| 🔌 Wired-but-disabled | Codex & Claude Code product subagents (official-style `disabled` rows; enable needs bundles), one-shot bash/pwsh |

Base capabilities (shell, file editor, co

plugins.description: Apple Xcode MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness — bridges xcrun mcpbridge into native mcp__xcode__* tools. Configuration-only bundle: no code, no dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-xcode-mcp

**English** | [中文](https://github.com/OrrHsiao/dsh-xcode-mcp/blob/main/README-zh.md)

**Apple Xcode MCP bridge for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com).**

Xcode 27 ships a *headless MCP tool service*. `/usr/bin/xcrun mcpbridge` is the
STDIO bridge to it. This bundle wires that bridge into the MCP client already
shipped with DeepSeek Harness, so every Xcode tool reaches the model as an
ordinary native tool named `mcp__xcode__<ToolName>`.

On Xcode 27.0 that is **54 tools**: project and scheme inspection, builds,
tests, SwiftUI Preview rendering, simulator launch and interaction
(tap / type / swipe), screenshots, the accessibility hierarchy, OSLog, and
Swift package, localization and instrumentation helpers.

## Why a bundle

Hand-wiring `xcrun mcpbridge` means editing the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and
remembering the transport fields, the tool-call timeout and the failure policy.
This package carries that configuration instead, so the connection becomes one
installable thing that is named, versioned, listed in the Plugins page and
removable like any other plugin.

## What actually gets installed

**No JavaScript runs.** A configuration-only bundle is a manifest plus a patch —
8 files, about 4 kB unpacked, no `dependencies`, no `scripts`, no build step:

```
package.json  cordis.patch.yml  icon.svg
locale/en.json  locale/zh.json  README.md  README-zh.md  LICENSE
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, the plugin that does the talking, ships with dsh
itself and is deliberately not a dependency of this package. There is nothing to
audit here beyond the ~40 lines of YAML under [Configure](#configure).

## Requirements

- **macOS**, **Xcode 27 or later**. `mcpbridge` does not exist in earlier
  versions.
- The headless service enabled and running:

  ```sh
  xcrun mcp-server status     # expect: Permission: enabled / mcp-server: running
  sudo xcrun mcp-server enable
  xcrun mcp-server start
  ```

- For the project-scoped tools, a project open in Xcode, plus permission for the
  folders you build in:

  ```sh
  sudo xcrun mcp-server allow-folder /path/to/your/projects
  ```

On first connection Xcode shows an agent-authorization prompt. A **signed**
client such as DeepSeek Harness is remembered permanently; an unsigned client's
grant expires after about 24 hours.

## Install

From the **Plugins** page in the sidebar, enter the package name:

```
dsh-xcode-mcp
```

Installing enables the bundle; it usually activates through HMR. If the
`mcp__xcode__*` tools do not appear, restart the profile so the new bundle layer
is composed.

An absolute path to a checkout works the same way, for a pre-publish install.

## Verify

Ask for something that needs Xcode, or check the tool list for `mcp__xcode__*`.
A good first call is `mcp__xcode__XcodeListWorkspaces`:

```
* workspaceIdentifier: workspace-xxxxxxxxxx, workspacePath: /path/to/App.xcodeproj
```

Then `mcp__xcode__XcodeListSchemes` with that identifier lists the project's
schemes. Both were verified against Xcode 27.0 (27A266a).

## Upgrading

**DSH does not update installed plugins automatically.** Its own Plugins page
says so, and re-installing over an existing copy is refused with *"this plugin is
already installed"* — the uninstall is what makes the upgrade possible.

So the Plugins-page route is: **uninstall, then install again.**

From a shell, the same upgrade without the uninstall step:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> update dsh-xcode-mcp
```

One thing to expect either way: the plugin manager installs through pnpm, whose
[`minimumReleaseAge`](https://pnpm.io/supply-chain-security) defaults to `1440`
minutes. **A release less than a day old will not install**, and the command
reports `Already up to date` even though a newer version exists. That is
supply-chain protection, not a failure — wait a day, or lower the setting in the
profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` if you know the release is yours.

Because this bundle is configuration only, an upgrade replaces a handful of
declaration files. It runs no code before or after.

## Configure

The row is `mcp-xcode`; its `config` is the full
[`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client)
schema, so any field documented there works. To change one, override the row in
the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — a matching override replaces the whole
`config`, so restate every field you still want:

```yaml
- id: mcp-xcode
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: xcode
    transport: stdio
    command: /usr/bin/xcrun
    args: ['mcpbridge']
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 900000   # default is 60 s; builds need more
    failOnStartupError: false   # Xcode closed must not block harness startup
```

To point at a specific Xcode instead of the one `xcode-select` names, add `env`
with `MCP_XCODE_PID`.

### A note on the 54 tools

Every tool's JSON Schema is offered to the model each turn. If that is more
context than you want, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` has no include/exclude
filter — the alternative is a bridge that implements one.

## Remove

Through the Plugins page, or by removing the bundle from `dsh.profile.bundles`
and uninstalling the package. Disabling the bundle stops the `mcpbridge`
subprocess with it.

## License

MIT

## 🎯 静止中 团队面板（会话页头「智能体团队」浮层）成员行左侧的图标位：


四个非运行状态的预览：静止 / 倒立 / 待命 / 完成——后两个是任务圆点的料，目前版本对成员行不生效

## 📦 安装 ### CLI 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ohjingjing-team ``` ### 网页版/桌面版插件管理安装 插件管理页面，右上角「添加插件」→ 填入插件名 `dsh-ohjingjing-team` 或仓库名 ```sh https://github.com/SpookyWaste/dsh-ohjingjing-team ``` 装完刷新 Web GUI，打开一次团队面板即可看到效果；标题栏跑道在会话头部自己出现，不需要额外开关。 **插件管理页里一行一个开关**，默认都开，可以单独关掉，每行显示它自己的名字与一行说明： | 组件 | 条目名 | 做什么 | |---|---|---| | 智能体团队皮肤 | `dsh-ohjingjing-team/skin` | 团队成员行的图标换成哦鲸鲸 | | 标题栏跑道 | `dsh-ohjingjing-team/runners` | 会话头部标签行右侧的跑道 | | 子代理列表 | `dsh-ohjingjing-team/catalog` | 「N 个子智能体」下拉行里的圆点 | | 插件包本身 | `dsh-ohjingjing-team` | 三块组件共用的样式表与跑道运行时 | #### 依赖 | 项 | 值 | |---|---| | DSH | `≥0.2.0-rc.2` | | 官方智能体团队组件@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile | 仅组件1需要，保持开启 | ## 🎛 可调参数 外观参数是 `:root` 上的自定义属性，改它们不需要重新构建（写进用户样式或浏览器覆盖即可）： | 变量 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `--oj-max-size` | `40px` | **皮肤**尺寸上限，防止在极端字号下图标失控。 | | `--oj-runner-size` | `26px` | **跑道**里鲸鲸的边长（26px 时脚正好压在那条分隔线上）。 | | `--oj-runners-gap` | `26px` | **跑道**初次出现时相邻两只的槽位间距（满员时按轨道长度自动收窄）。 | | `--oj-lap-duration` | `60.2s` | **跑道**一圈的时长（60.2s = 86 个走帧循环，步点与走帧同相位；改大改小会按比例改变地面速度）。 | | `--oj-max-subagents` | `20` | **跑道**最多画多少个**子代理**（lead 之外；DSH 会把历史子代理留在总数里，所以取最新的这些）。 | | `--oj-catalog-size` | `26px` | **子代理列表**里图标位的边长（官方只有 14×17；放大后行内文字右移 12px，行高不变）。 | | `--oj-duration` | `0.7s` | **走帧一圈**的时长，步数多的动画自动按比例拉长（三块组件共用）。 | ## 📜 版本
版本历史（点击展开） - **0.4.1** —— 跑道改成**一条共用轨道**：lead 永远在、跟着最新的 20 个子代理，跑完一圈回起点重生（无 offset）、停下就地站住、按剧本周期性切换动作；新增**子代理列表**组件（下拉行的圆点换成鲸鲸）；`--oj-cruise-scale` 与 `--oj-min-segment` 被 `--oj-lap-duration` 取代。 - **0.4.0** —— 新增**标题栏跑道**组件：会话头部标签行右侧画上子代理，动作与成员行同位次同玩法、位移与动画同步折返；两块组件可分别开关。 - **0.3.0** —— 运行中从「一套七帧跑动」变成**四种**动画。 - **0.2.2** —— 修复帧边缘的**邻帧残留**。 - **0.2.1** —— 修复跑动动画**少播一帧**：关键帧的时间刻度与位置刻度被写成同一套，导致最后一帧的时间区间长度为零。 - **0.2.0** —— 失败态换成**倒立**姿态；运行态从两帧往返改为**七帧循环**。 - **0.1.2** —— 修复失败态素材被裁。 - **0.1.1** —— 修复高 DPI 屏图标发糊，并修复 `error` 状态回落为 `idle`；图标边长默认 28px → 31px（用满两行文字高度，成员卡仍为 51px）。 - **0.1.0** —— 首个版本。
## 🙏 素材来源与许可 「哦鲸鲸」（ohjingjing）为社区常用名，本名「深深」，形象为 CC BY-NC-SA 授权 - 原鲸鱼娘人设[ZipZipPipe](https://space.bilibili.com/4168597)。 - 「哦鲸鲸」（深深）形象[这个刀子真甜](https://space.bilibili.com/23315338)。 - 本仓库代码以 MIT 授权（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。

plugins.readme_text:
# 使用情况 · dsh-key-usage **DeepSeek Harness 的侧边栏用量面板** —— 按通道看 Token、缓存命中率、成本，以及余额与订阅窗口。 [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-key-usage?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-key-usage) [![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-web%20%7C%20desktop-4d9fff?style=flat-square)](#兼容与运行要求) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22-339933?style=flat-square)](#兼容与运行要求) [![topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0e7490?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://img.shields.io/badge/listed-dsh--plugin.org-4d9fff?style=flat-square)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/xyl886/dsh-key-usage) [安装](#安装) · [界面预览](#界面预览) · [数据与权限](#数据权限与联网) · [功能](#功能) · [成本与价目](#成本与价目) · [常见问题](#常见问题) · [更新记录](./docs/CHANGELOG.md) · [开发](#开发)
--- 侧边栏「使用情况」：**总览（通道清单 + 活跃热力图）、使用明细、项目用量、按模型、会话用量**（余额 / 窗口与单价表在总览的通道弹窗里）。数据全部来自你自己的机器，**默认不联网**；界面**中英双语**（跟随宿主语言设置），字号跟随宿主通用设置。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-key-usage dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-key-usage ``` ## 界面预览


总览 —— 每通道一行（今日 / 近 30 天 / 余额或窗口 / 30 天成本），下方是近 9 个月活跃热力图


使用明细 —— 十张统计卡（每张带上期值与环比角标）、通道下拉、**自定义范围为日历弹层**、占比条（悬停一个 tip 列全）、按天 / 按小时图表


项目用量 —— 按工作目录聚合，含会话数与归档标记；支持搜索、按通道筛选与排序


按模型 —— 按通道 + 模型聚合，成本带「官方价 / 聚合 / 模型官方价」来源角标


会话用量 —— 按会话聚合、按日期分组，支持搜索与四种排序；没有人类提问的会话不显示


会话详情 —— 首条提问全文、四类 tokens 与命中率、逐模型占比、一天里的分布；有子代理时列出子会话


通道详情弹窗（总览里点通道行）—— 官方余额或订阅窗口占用、¥ / $ 折算、该通道近 30 天模型单价表

## 数据、权限与联网 **读什么** | 读取对象 | 用途 | | --- | --- | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage/usage-ledger.json` | 用量台账（天 × 通道 × 模型，含官方成本） | | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-usage/provider-snapshots.json` | 余额 / 窗口的**回落值** | | `$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.yml` | 通道清单（只做文本提取，**不执行**其中的 `!!js`；取不到回退 `cordis.patch.yml`） | | 宿主 `sessionPersistence` 服务 | 项目 / 会话 / 单会话详情 / 按小时（只开只读句柄，不自行解压会话文件） | | 宿主 `credentials` 服务 / 进程环境变量 | 查余额时的 API Key（只用于拼 `Authorization`） | | 随包 `data/litellm-model-prices.json`、`$DSH_HOME/dsh-key-usage/model-prices.json`、`fx-rate.json`、`plugin.log` | 聚合价目、汇率缓存与系统日志 | **写什么**（只有四处，都在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-key-usage/`）： - `snapshot.json` —— 统一快照：5 个 Tab 的数据（含明细），每 5 分钟本地重建一次、**打开页面时若超过 10 秒就重算一次**，点「刷新」时整体重算； - `model-prices.json` —— 点「刷新价目」成功后写入的聚合价目副本（校验不过不覆盖旧文件）； - `fx-rate.json` —— 汇率缓存（成功才写，12 小时内直接复用）； - `plugin.log` —— 系统日志（JSONL，追加写，超 512 KB 只留后半段）：刷新价目 / 汇率 / 余额查询失败的**原因**、端点请求失败、快照问题都在这里，刷新页面后仍可查。 同目录的 `quota-snapshots.json` 是历史遗留文件：**只读一次当种子，插件不再写它**。这四个文件都不含任何密钥（日志里只有上游 URL、HTTP 状态这类排查信息）；宿主的 `provider-snapshots.json` 与 profile 配置一律只读。**不读凭据文件、不改宿主配置、所有端点仅接受回环请求** —— 完整约束见 [`AGENTS.md`](./AGENTS.md)。 **会联网的三个动作，都要你触发**： | 动作 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **打开插件页** / 打开总览的通道详情弹窗 | 按通道查官方余额 / 窗口接口：**打开页面时若余额数据超过 60 秒就后台补查一次**（不阻塞首屏，几秒后自动刷新出来），其余时候读缓存；6 秒超时、64 KiB 上限、结果缓存 60 秒（点「刷新」强制重查），失败回落本机快照，原因写进系统日志 | | 点「刷新价目」 | `POST /dsh-key-usage/pricing/refresh`：先 `raw.githubusercontent.com`、失败再试 jsDelivr 镜像；服务端 20 秒预算、响应上限 12 MiB，校验不过**不覆盖**已有文件；界面最多等 30 秒 | | 打开页面 / 切换显示币种 / 点「刷新汇率」 | `GET /dsh-key-usage/fx`：主 `open.er-api.com`、备 `api.frankfurter.app`；6 秒超时、64 KiB 上限、12 小时 TTL 内不联网；失败回落缓存，再失败用默认 7.1 并在界面明示 | **不做开机拉取、不做定时轮询、不在其它端点里隐式联网**。打开页面触发的重算只走本地数据（台账 + 会话），联网的只有上面这三个动作。 **界面语言与字号**：文案全部走词典（中 / 英），语言**只跟宿主设置**（设置 → 通用 → 语言），插件内不加语言开关；字号按宿主注入的 `--dsh-content-font-size` 缩放，**通用设置里改字号，插件整页跟着变**。 ## 功能 **总览** - **通道清单** —— 每通道一行：类型、今日与近 30 天调用量、余额或订阅窗口占用、30 天成本（带来源角标）； - **点通道行弹出该通道详情**：官方余额（总余额 / 赠送 / 充值）或订阅窗口占用（5 小时 / 本周 / 本月 + 重置时间）、查询时间与「实时查询未成功 · 查看系统日志」、该通道近 30 天**模型单价表**（含「官方价 / 聚合 / 模型官方价」来源与「· 部分」）；弹窗里可切换 ¥ / $ 显示与刷新汇率、刷新价目（原来的「余额与配额」Tab 已并入这里）；失败原因（含未配置 Key）进系统日志，不占卡片版面； - **活跃热力图** —— 近 9 个月按日 Tokens，五档深浅递进，格子按可见区间的**活跃日五分位**分档（p20 / p40 / p60 / p80）；横向滚动时星期列固定在左侧。 **使用明细** - 今日 / 周 / 月 / 总计 / 自定义范围 + **通道下拉**（在「自定义」右侧），全页联动；自定义范围用**日历弹层**选起止（选完自动关闭，可清除） - **十张统计卡**：调用次数、Tokens、输入、输出、缓存读、缓存命中率、日均 Tokens、通道数、使用天数、成本； - 每张卡带**上期值（缩小淡化）与环比角标**：命中率按百分点（`pp`）记，成本上升用提示色；没有可比基数或持平时不显示角标，「总计」范围整组不显示； - **通道占比**：条下方一次列全每段（色块 / 名称 / 占比 / Tokens），悬停条上任意位置弹**一个** tip 列出全部段； - 按天 / 按小时图表（单日范围自动切 24 小时）：**悬停时浮层钉在图表右上角**，同时高亮该列并画一条竖向指示线，柱子不会被盖住；浮层里是当日调用数、四类 tokens、命中率、成本与模型构成。 **项目用量 · 按模型 · 会话用量** - 分别按工作目录、通道 + 模型、单个会话聚合，支持搜索、按通道筛选与排序；会话按日期分组，可切换显示已归档会话，**没有人类提问的会话不再显示**； - **名字与数量对齐侧边栏**：会话名取宿主会话投影（`storages/session_projcache/sessions/.json` 的 `record.rows.title.val`），子代理判定同样以投影的 `subagent.val.identity` 为准（被 seed 续接的会话算独立会话）；项目行以宿主工作区为骨架、名字用工作区名，不在工作区里的历史目录合并成一行「未归入工作区」； - **会话详情抽屉**：首条真实提问全文、工作区、通道、时长、四类 tokens 与命中率、成本与来源角标、逐模型占比，有结算样本时给 24 小时迷你图； - 会话列表可按成本 / 命中率 / 调用数排序，可展开看模型构成；首屏 50 条 + 「加载更多」；点行内工作目录跳到「项目用量」并只看该项目。 **导出** - 上面四处都能把**当前筛选后**的数据导出为 CSV 或 JSON（CSV 带 UTF-8 BOM）。 **系统日志** - 页头右侧的日志图标：弹窗列出**时间 / 级别 / 来源 / 内容**，可刷新（重读磁盘）、复制、导出 `.txt`、清空； - **落盘**：写到 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-key-usage/plugin.log`（JSONL，超 512 KB 只留后半段），刷新页面后还能查上次为什么失败； - 记录**刷新价目 / 汇率 / 余额查询失败的原因**（含上游地址与 HTTP 状态）、端点请求失败、快照问题与「读取不完整」、导出被浏览器拦截、i18n 缺词；同一问题合并成一条并标 `×N`（点消息展开详情，失败条目可直接点「重试」）； - 页面本身不再摊开这些原因：失败只留一行**「结论 · 查看系统日志」**，点它直接打开日志窗。 ## 成本与价目 **取值优先级（两层）**：`官方账单`（台账记录的厂商账单，不会被覆盖）→ `通道内价目`（插件**内置的厂商官方价目**；本通道没收录时，按 **LiteLLM 聚合价**的**通道别名**命中）→ `同模型官方价目`（本通道没有价目时，聚合价里该模型名**全库唯一**命中的那一条；同一厂商的 `x` 与 `vendor/x` 同价双键算唯一，同名跨多个厂商时用内置价目里该模型的厂商兜底再查一次）；两层都没命中就显示 `—`，**不猜一个数字**。 | 角标 | 含义 | | --- | --- | | **官方** | 台账记录的厂商账单金额 | | **官方价** | 按插件**内置的厂商官方价目**算出（随包发布、自动生效） | | **聚合** | 按随包的 **LiteLLM 聚合价目**、经该通道的别名命中算出（第三方维护、美元计价） | | **模型官方价** | 本通道没有价目，但聚合价里这个模型名**全库唯一**（同一厂商的 `x` 与 `vendor/x` 同价双键也算）—— 就用它的价；跨厂商的候选会按内置价目里该模型的厂商兜底再查一次（多半就是该模型厂商自己的官方价） | > **不再有「估算」**：以前内置价目与聚合价都没收录时，插件会拿台账反推一个均价凑出金额（角标「估算」）—— 那不是账单，2026-10-16 把这层整层删掉了；定不下来就是 `—`（没有角标）。 > 「**· 部分**」是口径提示、不是错误：该条聚合价目缺一档缓存价，缺的那档按**未命中价**代；两档都缺的条目按「不支持缓存计价」处理，不标「部分」。 **内置价目**（19 条；随包发布的 `data/pricing-catalog.yml`，**不要改它**，升级会覆盖）： | 通道 | 模型 | 币种 | 来源 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `deepseek-official` | deepseek-flash · deepseek-v4.1-flash · deepseek-v4-flash · deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp · deepseek-v4-pro | CNY | [api-docs.deepseek.com](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing) | | `moonshotai` | kimi-k3 · kimi-k2.7-code · kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed · kimi-k2.6 | CNY | [platform.kimi.com](https://platform.kimi.com/docs/pricing/chat) | | `zai` | glm-5.3 · glm-5.3-flash · glm-5.3-flashx · glm-5.2 · glm-5 | USD | [docs.z.ai](https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing) | | `openrouter` | deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash · anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5 · anthropic/claude-opus-5.5 · openai/gpt-6.1-sol · openai/gpt-6-astra | USD | [openrouter.ai](https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models) | - 币种按各家定价页**原样记录**（CNY / USD 并存，显示时按汇率折算）；文档没写清的档位**留空而不是猜**（例如 Kimi K2 系列未公布缓存写入价 → 该档按 0 计）； - **错峰**：窗口按**本地时间**判定（`起止相同` = 全天，`from > to` = 跨午夜），可限定每天 / 仅工作日 / 仅周末；只有**单日范围**会用当天的 24 小时分布算错峰占比并加权，跨天按标准价（有意保守）。DeepSeek 按官方口径：**北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00 与 14:00–18:00 为高峰，其余（含周末）为空闲半价**；插件没有法定节假日日历，**节假日按高峰价算**（偏高、保守）。 **聚合价目**（[BerriAI/litellm](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) 的 [`model_prices_and_context_window.json`](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/blob/main/model_prices_and_context_window.json)，MIT，原文随包在 [`data/litellm-LICENSE.txt`](./data/litellm-LICENSE.txt)）： -
