# dsh-boot-animation

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/alice-marx/dsh-boot-animation)

Replaces the DSH startup page with a chosen or random local video, then transitions into the app, with configurable playback and fallback controls. It does not modify DSH core source; future compatibility is not guaranteed.

**Language:** English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

This is a community plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

- **Package:** [`@ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation)
- **Release:** [0.4.0](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-boot-animation/releases/tag/v0.4.0)
- **Repository:** [Alice-Marx/dsh-boot-animation](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-boot-animation)
- **Topic:** `dsh-plugin`
- **Directory category:** UI & Experience (用户界面与体验), following the [DSH Plugin Hub submission categories](https://dsh-plugin.org/submit). A category choice is not a claim of listing acceptance.

## Screenshots

Local Chromium demo host rendering the actual 0.4.0 boot and card source with sample profile data. These are not screenshots of a signed-in live DSH profile and are not a cross-platform certification.

![Startup preview](assets/screenshots/startup-preview.png)

![Settings preview](assets/screenshots/settings-preview.png)

## Install

### Web

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation@0.4.0 --save-exact
```

Host and Node requirements must already be met.

### Desktop

Open **Settings -> Plugins -> Add plugin**, paste `@ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation@0.4.0`, then quit and reopen from the tray as prompted.

For Desktop upgrades where the live install API reports the package as already installed, fully quit from the tray first and use the official Desktop bundled wrapper — not an older global `dsh` binary.

Windows default-location copyable offline command:

```powershell
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add '@ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation@0.4.0' --save-exact
```

Adjust the wrapper path if DeepSeek Harness is installed elsewhere. If you use a custom `DSH_HOME`, retain it when running this command. Do not use this exact Windows path on Linux or macOS.

### Uninstall

Web:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation
```

Desktop: use the official plugin UI. Existing custom videos are separate data; review and back them up before manual deletion. A fresh package install auto-registers the scoped bundle; do not manually insert a second bundle entry.

## Configuration

The plugin uses the host profile configuration and a plugin patch file. There is no separate `.env`, INI, or JSON settings loader.

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.yml` | Host base configuration. |
| `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` | Plugin configuration edits. The shipped patch mounts id `boot-animation` with name `@ljwei-stak/dsh-boot-animation`. |
| Profile `package.json` | Tracks dependency and `dsh.profile.bundles` via the installer. |

An [example fragment](examples/boot-animation.config.yml) is provided as a config-object reference only; it is not a standalone autoloaded config file.

Settings namespace: `boot-animation`. Prefer the existing settings UI. Preview uses current settings immediately. Reload the Web page for the next startup; on Desktop, fully quit from the tray and reopen for the next startup. Host entry upgrades also require a full process restart.

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. |
| `fadeMs` | `2000` | Schema range `300`–`5000` ms; UI presets `1000`, `1500`, `2000`, `3000`, `4000`. |
| `enterMode` | `tail` | `tail` dissolves at clip end; `end` fades after playback; `click` loops until entry. |
| `disabledClips` | `[]` | Opaque filenames disabled in the pool. |
| `sound` | `true` | Subject to browser gesture policy. |
| `clickToEnter` | `false` | When enabled, the first pointer press enters immediately; otherwise a press may first unlock audio. |
| `showHint` | `true` | Display entry hint. |

## Media

Imported videos are copied to `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/data/dsh-boot-animation/videos`. The original selected file is untouched. Legacy bundled assets under `assets/videos` may be replaced by package upgrades; UI import is preferred.

In the UI, open **Settings -> Plugins -> 启动动画** to import a video up to 256 MiB, set one clip as startup or enable several for random selection, preview current effects, and remove custom clips after confirmation.

## Compatibility

- **DSH:** minimum `>=0.2.0-rc.2`; integration verified against Windows Desktop runtime `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`.
- **Node:** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`; ESM.
- **Runtime dependency:** `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `^3.18.4` (declared as a dependency, not a peer dependency).
- **Browsers:** Chromium, Chrome, and Edge targeted; Firefox is unverified.
- **Platforms:** macOS and Linux script paths exist but were not independently tested in this acceptance.
- **Codecs:** browser-supported codecs are required. H.264/AAC MP4 is preferred. MP4, WebM, M4V, and MOV containers do not guarantee codec decoding.

## Permissions and trust

This Node plugin runs with host OS privileges; there is no per-plugin sandbox.

- **Reads:** shipped scripts and videos.
- **Writes/removes:** imported video copies in the profile data directory.
- **Optimize:** explicitly rewrites a bundled MP4 using Node APIs, with `originals/` backups and `.faststart-work/` scratch space. The runtime does not execute shell commands or `ffmpeg`.
- **Credentials/network:** no model or provider API keys, telemetry, or remote services are used in the plugin runtime. Browser HTTP calls are same-origin. `npm` and GitHub network access are required by the installer and are distinct from runtime behavior.

### HTTP boundary

Custom import, read, and delete routes enforce DSH `connection.requestRejection` authentication and path checks. Bundled clip manifest/video and Optimize routes do not enforce that same hook themselves. Do not assume every route is authenticated.

Use only in a trusted local environment. Remote or reverse-proxy operators must enforce access control for the entire `/plugins/dsh-boot-animation/` prefix. Imported media is not published to GitHub or npm. Videos are served `no-store`, so repeated loads transfer clip data again.

## License

Code is under [MIT](LICENSE). The `LICENSE` declares the bundled MP4 work under the same MIT terms. User-imported media retains its own rights; installing the plugin does not relicense it.

## Reference repositories

- Original code / upstream: [`lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation`](https://github.com/lxj5820/dsh-boot-animation)
- Official DSH host: [`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
- Current maintained distribution: [`Alice-Marx/dsh-boot-animation`](https://github.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-boot-animation)

No endorsement by the upstream or host projects is implied.

## Developer notes

Validation commands present in this repository:

```bash
node build-client.mjs      # only if client source changes
node verify/verify-entry.mjs
node verify/verify-degraded.mjs
node verify/verify-options.mjs
node verify/verify-custom-clips.mjs
```

The 0.4.0 release passed 243 checks; this does not imply every Desktop release or operating system was fully end-to-end tested.

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), [MANUAL.md](MANUAL.md), and [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) for development and setup detail. Archived historical notes are kept at [docs/DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md) and are non-authoritative.

## Directory submission

A [ready-to-copy submission draft](docs/PLUGIN_SUBMISSION.md) follows the hub template. The badge confirms the plugin is listed in the community directory; it does not imply official endorsement or a quality guarantee.

plugins.description: 列出并删除 DSH 已归档会话：默认移入回收站可恢复，带二次确认与日志归属校验。
plugins.readme_text:
## dsh-delete-archived-session
一个 DSH 插件：**列出并删除已归档的会话**。
DSH 本身只有「归档」和「取消归档」两个操作。**归档只是把会话藏起来，日志永远留在磁盘上**，官方没有任何办法把那块空间收回来。
### 安全设计

删会话就是把聊天记录销毁掉，所以这个插件刻意做得很保守。

1.只删已归档的。

2.必须明确确认。

3.必须先证明归属。

4.不跑出根目录。

5.默认可以恢复。

6.顺手清掉归档记录。

7.DSH不崩。

### 安装

这是一个标准的 DSH 插件包：`package.json` 里声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 负责插入一行。

**方法一（推荐）**：在对话里说一句「把这个插件装上」，让 AI 调用插件管理器安装。

**方法二**：自己手动加。在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖并登记 bundle：

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-delete-archived-session": "file:./dsh-delete-archived-session" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["dsh-delete-archived-session"] } }
}
```

装好后需要重启 DSH 才生效。

### 配置

插件**不导入 Node 标准库以外的任何东西**——它注册的是朴素的工具/命令描述对象，也不接受 schemastery 的 `Config`。这样做是为了不管 profile 怎么提升 DSH 自身的依赖，它都能挂载成功。

配置因此走环境变量：

| 环境变量 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_DELETE_ARCHIVED_SESSIONS_ROOT` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | 要操作的会话根目录 |
| `DSH_DELETE_ARCHIVED_SESSIONS_TRASH` | `<根目录>/../.deleted-sessions` | 删除时移入的回收站 |
| `DSH_DELETE_ARCHIVED_SESSIONS_PERMANENT` | 不设（允许永久删除） | 设为 `0`、`false` 或 `no` 则禁止永久删除，强制走可恢复路径 |

`$DSH_HOME` 的读取方式和 DSH 本身一致：先看 `$DSH_HOME`，没有就用 `~/.dsh`。

plugins.description: Sidebar auxiliary chat for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): right-column panel hosting temporary auxiliary sessions that one-way mirror the main session's context and are deleted when closed · DSH 侧边栏辅助会话插件
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 辅助会话 · Auxiliary Chat

> [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 插件：在主对话旁边开一列"草稿会话"。随手问、随手关，主对话分毫不动。

## 它解决什么问题

有些问题值得问模型，但不值得写进主对话的历史：这段代码为什么这么写、帮我把这版文案润色一下、这个报错到底什么意思……问完就过去了，不需要在主对话里留下痕迹。

开一个辅助会话就行。它带着主会话的上下文开工，回答只留在自己那一列；用完了关掉，它连同会话记录一起消失——主对话从头到尾干干净净。

## 怎么用

### 打开

四种方式，任选一种：

| 方式 | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| 右侧栏入口 | 打开右侧边栏，点「辅助会话」 |
| 标签栏 | 右侧栏标签行的 `+`，选择「辅助会话」 |
| 快捷键 | `⌘⌥S`（Windows / Linux 为 `Ctrl+Alt+S`） |
| 命令 | 在主输入框输入 `/side` |

### 提问

辅助会话有自己的输入框，直接问就好。它已经继承了主会话的内容、工作目录、模型与权限预设；你还可以在面板里单独给它换模型、换权限，怎么改都不会影响主会话。

### 把结论带回主对话

点顶部的「复制结论到主会话」，内容会作为**草稿**填进主输入框，由你确认之后再发送。插件不会替你在主会话里发任何消息。

### 拖文件

拖进辅助面板，文件只进辅助会话；拖到主对话，只进主会话。按你放手的位置决定，不会两头都进。

### 开多条

每条辅助会话是独立标签，自动编号区分。收起右栏、切换标签都只是隐藏，不会误删。

### 关闭

点标签上的关闭，它立刻消失：不弹确认框，也不问风险提示。会话日志、缓存与登记信息一并清除，不留痕迹。

## 特性

- **并排分栏**——主对话在左、辅助会话在右，同时可见，不用来回切页面。
- **继承上下文，页面保持干净**——创建那一刻，把主会话已提交的内容一次性交给辅助会话的模型；辅助会话自己的聊天页从空白开始，没有重复的历史气泡。内容过长时自动取最近的部分（默认 10 万字符预算）。顶栏保持简洁，只有真出现镜像异常或主会话已归档时才提示。
- **能力完整**——与主会话相同的工具能力，共享同一工作目录，产出的文件留在工作区。
- **状态一眼可见**——后台回复时标签显示运行指示；回复完成而你没在看时标记未读，看到即清除。
- **严格单向，绝不串门**——不会主动往主会话发消息，也不会把辅助会话的内容混进主对话。
- **关闭即清除**——辅助会话自身的痕迹（日志、缓存、登记）全部删除；工作区里由它产出的**文件保留**。
- **刷新不丢**——页面刷新后自动重连原来的会话；如果宿主已经回收了它，面板会明确告诉你，并提供一键新建。

## 安装

需要 Node ≥ 22，以及已安装的 DeepSeek Harness。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Vincent-chk/dsh-plugin-auxiliary-chat.git
cd dsh-plugin-auxiliary-chat
npm install --no-audit --no-fund

node scripts/build.mjs                              # 构建 host + client 两侧
node scripts/smoke.mjs                              # 契约自检
node scripts/install-profile.mjs                    # 干跑：只打印将要做的改动
node scripts/install-profile.mjs --apply --no-pnpm  # 写入 desktop profile（先备份）
```

装好后重启 DeepSeek Harness 并刷新页面。

卸载：`node scripts/install-profile.mjs --uninstall --apply --no-pnpm`

> desktop profile 由 Electron 载体专属管理，`dsh plugin --profile desktop add` 会被 CLI 拒绝；安装脚本做的是同一件事（写 `dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`），并会先备份、使用目录链接、不改动 lockfile。

## 配置

| 配置 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideFromSidebar` | `true` | 辅助会话创建后不出现在左侧会话列表与搜索中 |
| `mirrorHistory` | `true` | 是否把主会话内容交给辅助会话（对话记录、系统提示词、动态上下文）；关掉则只继承工作目录、模型路由、权限预设 |
| `mirrorMaxChars` | `100000` | 继承内容的字符预算；超出时取最近的记录，连最新一条都放不下时回退为摘要 |
| `hideChannel` | `auto` | 隐藏方式：优先使用宿主提供的原生可见性接口，没有则回退到归档方式；也可强制 `archive` / `native` |

## 已知限制

- 回合运行期间，辅助会话可能短暂出现在左侧会话列表里；在「仅看归档」过滤器下也能看到——这是平台目前还没有"隐藏但可运行"接口所致。
- `/aux-init`、`/aux-end` 是插件内部命令，可能出现在 `/` 命令菜单中，误触无害。
- 上下文继承是**创建那一刻的快照**：主会话之后新增的内容不会自动补进来，关掉重开即可带上。
- 删除依赖当前 DSH 的磁盘布局；若未来版本改动布局，关闭会退化为"停止会话但不删文件"，并在日志中记录。

## 开发者

代码分两半：`src/host/`（会话登记、上下文镜像、创建与销毁、命令通道）与 `src/client/`（分栏面板、多标签、拖放路由、界面状态）；两侧共享的冻结契约在 `src/contract.ts`。

- DSH API 实证记录：[docs/VERIFIED-API.md](docs/VERIFIED-API.md)
- 浏览器 ↔ Host 命令契约：[docs/REMOTE-CONTRACT.md](docs/REMOTE-CONTRACT.md)
- 平台约束、设计取舍与验证记录：[docs/DESIGN-NOTES.md](docs/DESIGN-NOTES.md)
- 希望上游补齐的平台能力：[docs/SEAM-REQUEST.md](docs/SEAM-REQUEST.md)

构建与自检脚本都在 `scripts/`：`npm run verify`、`npm run race-check`、`npm run drop-check`、`npm run mirror-check`、`node scripts/e2e-isolated.mjs`。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: 模型选择 · 子代理路由 · 推理层级 — DSH Web GUI 的三分区模型菜单插件
plugins.readme_text:
[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md)
# dsh-models
## 实际效果 / Actual UI **推理层级 / Reasoning Effort**
**子代理路由 / Subagent Routing**
**主模型选择 / Main Model Picker**
## In one line The model menu for the dsh web GUI — pick the model, its effort, and your subagents' model, all from the composer's model seat. ## What it is A renamed, maintained fork of [ttmouse/dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker) (v1.18.0 baseline). The upstream picker replaces the composer's model seat with a search-first popup; this fork keeps that and adds the pieces a multi-model daily driver needs. A **three-zone trigger button** splits three concerns into three popups: | Zone | Click | Popup content | |------|-------|---------------| | **Left** (model name) | Opens the model picker | Search box (auto-focused), provider column, model list with price badges and `dim` discovery rows | | **Middle** (subagent icon) | Opens the subagent picker | Per-session model override for subagents (depth ≥ 1) | | **Right** (effort) | Opens the effort picker | Available reasoning-effort levels | Plus a settings-page 「模型选择」 card: discovery master switch, ignore/restore for discovered models, hidden-model management — linked live with the picker. ## Fork attribution Upstream: [ttmouse/dsh-model-picker](https://github.com/ttmouse/dsh-model-picker) (MIT). This repo renames the package to `dsh-models` and maintains the enhanced build (subagent routing, `dim` bridge, settings card, zh/en locale, custom background color, theme readability fixes). Routes (`/api/model-picker/…`) and `dsh.modelPicker.*` storage keys keep their upstream names so existing preferences migrate seamlessly. ## Install Requires harness ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1 (verified on 0.2.0-rc.2; also running on 0.2.1-alpha.3). ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/dsh-models/main/install.sh | sh # restart dsh web ``` Manual equivalent: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-models.git # restart dsh web ``` > The npm package named `dsh-models` is an unrelated third-party placeholder — > install only via the script or the git command above. ## Compatibility | dsh-models | Harness | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | 0.1.4 | **0.2.1-alpha.3 (current, running)** | Virtualized model list + dim refresh throttle; seat and route surfaces unchanged. | | 0.1.0 | 0.2.0-rc.2 (measured) | Code-identical to the enhanced build running in production; client resolves against the official 0.2.0 slot roster. | Requires Node.js ≥ 22.19 (the floor the picker is developed and tested on). What was actually checked on 0.2.0-rc.2 (this code, pre-rename build): - **Surfaces still resolve**: `conversation.input.model`, `web-ui.plugin.item`; every icon used exists in the official browser roster. - **Seats that died upstream are avoided**: the alpha.2-removed `settings.plugin.item` seat is not used; the settings card renders as a plain section (no `locale` field — a localized seat entry renders invisible). - **Server settings channel is dead on current hosts** (`scope.set()` resolves false), so card preferences live in `localStorage` (`dsh.modelPicker.*` + cross-tab event) instead of `webUiSettings`. ## Configuration No host-side config knobs yet — the bundle entry carries no `config` block. User preferences (discovery switch, ignored/discovered models, hidden models, background color, per-session subagent routes) are managed from the settings-page card and the picker itself. ## The `dim` bridge (optional) When a `dim` CLI is present (`dim` on `PATH` or `~/.local/bin/dim`), the host merges its catalog into the model facts: price badges, `maxOut`/`released` facts, and discovery rows for models `dim` knows that the dsh directory does not (capped at 30 per provider, newest first). Without `dim` the picker works exactly like upstream — the bridge degrades to directory-only facts. ## Tests & performance - **`npm test`** — two pure-Node suites: `scripts/host-route.mjs` drives the real route handlers (facts cache, subagent route, error guards), `scripts/interaction.mjs` renders the picker in jsdom and drives open/search/favorite/effort/virtual-window — 92 checks total. They SKIP cleanly when the harness peer deps are absent, so the suite stays green on any machine. - **Non-blocking cold start** — a cold `/api/model-picker/models` cache answers a fast 503 while the catalog refresh runs in the background (measured: first response ~3 ms, warm 200 within ~3 s); the client retries that 503 with backoff, so price badges appear as soon as the facts land. Warm caches are served stale-while-revalidate. - **Virtualized list** — the popup mounts only the rows around the viewport (~13 of 310 live) and pads the remainder with two spacer divs, so total height, the scrollbar and every offset stay exact; the section label of the group the list stands in is pinned by a synthetic twin once its real header leaves the window. Measured live in the running web GUI: **open 58.7 → 23.5 ms median, 310 → 13 rows mounted, 5506 → 1170 DOM nodes**; in the real- browser bench, cumulative React render across a full interaction session **243 → 65 ms**. Row heights follow whether a row shows its description line (38/50 px), so the scroll math never re-lays-out. The host's `dim` refresh went 60 s → 10 min — a model catalog that turns over in days no longer costs ~1.5 s of CPU per minute. Full details in the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md).

plugins.description: View and manage DeepSeek Harness agent modes in Web Settings: toggle plugins, edit system prompts, create modes from templates.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-modes · Mode Manager English | [中文](https://github.com/xiaohai-78/dsh-modes/blob/main/README.zh.md) Mode manager for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh). It adds a **Modes** page to the Web interface's Settings, where you switch what each agent mode can do, edit each mode's system prompt and the tool descriptions the model reads, manage skills per mode (saved versions, new skills, and imports from Codex, Claude Code, or a folder), create your own modes from templates, and merge built-in updates in one click after a dsh upgrade. ## What it does - **Understand each mode at a glance**: every mode gets a card that lists what it can do (run commands, read and write files, browse the web, use subagents, and so on), so you can compare modes without opening them. - **Switch capabilities, not plugins**: 15 capabilities, one switch each. For example, turn off "Run commands" or make files read-only, without facing dozens of plugin names. - **Edit the prompt**: edit each mode's system prompt with a preview and a version history. You can also let a saved prompt reach sessions that are already running, or let the model change the prompt in chat; every save asks you first. - **Edit tool descriptions**: rewrite the description of any tool the model sees, for several modes at once, and restore the built-in text of one tool, one mode, or everything with one click. The tools' own definitions are never changed. - **Create your own modes**: start from four templates (Develop, Write, Chat, Read-only research), or copy any existing mode. - **Control skills per mode**: turn a skill on or off in each mode or in all of them, pin a mode to a saved version of a skill, and keep a history of versions you can view, restore, or delete. Switching and pinning never move skill files. - **Create and import skills**: write a new skill in the page, or copy skills in from Codex, Claude Code, or any folder, several at once. When an imported skill's source changes, the page says so and imports it again in one click. - **Update the plugin itself**: the page tells you when a newer version of this plugin exists and can install it with DSH's own installer, after you confirm. - **Keep up with dsh upgrades**: when dsh updates its built-in modes, merge the changes in one click and keep yours. When a plugin fails to load, turn off just the failing plugins in one click. ## Install You need the dsh Web interface (`dsh web`). See [Compatibility](#compatibility) for supported versions. ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-modes ``` If you run dsh from source, run `pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-modes` in the source folder instead. After installing, restart `dsh web` and open **Settings → Modes**. ## Quick start 1. Open **Settings → Modes** and look at the built-in modes: the small labels on each card are what it can do. 2. Click **New mode** at the top right, pick **Read-only research**, and click **Create**. 3. The new card opens on the **Capabilities** tab: **Run commands** is off, and **Files** is on with **Allow file changes** off. 4. Click **New session with it** on the card and ask it to change a file. This mode has no tool to write files, edit files, or run commands, so it can only read and search. 5. Go back to the card's **Prompt** tab, change a sentence, and save. New sessions use it right away; to apply it to sessions that are already running, turn on **Live prompt** below. ## Features ### The mode list Each mode is one card: - **Header**: the name and description, with **Default** and **Custom** labels. - **Capability labels**: what the mode can do, for example "Commands · Files (read-only) · Web". - **Status line**: plugins on, open sessions, changes made, and whether the prompt is live. - **Buttons**: **New session with it** opens a new session in this mode. The **⋯** menu holds the other actions: Make default, Duplicate, View configuration (YAML), Edit details, Restore built-in, and Delete. - **Notices**: when something needs your attention, the card shows one notice with a button to fix it, for example "The built-in mode was updated", "plugins cannot load", or "an unsaved prompt draft". Click a card to open it. It has three tabs: **Capabilities**, **Prompt**, and **All plugins**. ### Capabilities | Group | Capabilities | |---|---| | What it can do | Run commands, Files (with a separate **Allow file changes** switch), Web, Subagents and workflows, Extend itself (plugin management, plugin market, plugin API lookup) | | How it works | Plan mode, To-do list, Session goals, Skills, Ask you, Deliverables, Reminders | | Context | Workspace instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and similar), Time awareness, Context compaction | - **Turning a capability on** restores it as the built-in mode has it. Plugins that switch by environment (such as Bash and PowerShell) go back to **Auto**, and plugins the built-in mode keeps off (such as the Codex subagent) stay off. - **Turning a capability off** switches off every plugin it includes. - A capability with only some of its plugins on is marked **Partly on**. - Capabilities the mode has no plugins for are hidden; for example, dsh before 0.2.1 has no Reminders. ### Prompt - **System prompt**: edit this mode's system prompt. Insert variables such as `{{model}}` with a click, and the editor checks them as you type. **Preview full system prompt** shows everything the model receives. - **Advanced settings**: a closing prompt (added after tool guidance and workspace rules), "use only the opening text as the complete prompt", and "include runtime context". - **Save**: click **Save** or press ⌘/Ctrl + Enter. Everything above takes effect only after you save. - **History**: every save records a version (up to 30), labeled by where it was made: Settings, in chat, or elsewhere. You can load any version back into the editor. - **Import and export**: `.md` files. - **Restore built-in prompt**: asks before it replaces your prompt. - **Nothing gets lost**: unsaved edits stay in the browser as a draft, even after a page refresh. If the prompt changes elsewhere while you edit, saving is refused and you choose between loading the latest version and overwriting it with yours. The **In chat** section has two switches that **save as soon as you click them**. They apply to sessions created afterwards: - **Live prompt**: after you save the prompt, running sessions use it from their next step. - **Allow prompt changes in chat**: you can tell the model "change your prompt to …". The model reads or changes this mode's prompt with the `mode_prompt` tool, and **asks for your approval before every save**. ### Tool descriptions Open **Settings → Modes → Tool descriptions**. It rewrites the description of a tool: the text that tells the model what the tool does and when to use it. The tool's own definition is never changed, so the built-in text always comes back. - **Pick the mode**: the **Mode** menu at the top is shared with the Skills view, and the page remembers the choice in this browser. Pick one mode to edit it alone, or **All modes** to see a list of modes and tick the ones an edit applies to (all are ticked at first). With nothing ticked, the list shows the tools of every editable mode and editing is off. Code mode (PTC) and modes declared by other plugins are listed with the reason and cannot be picked; if the mode picked in the Skills view cannot be used here, the page says so and shows all modes. **Edit tool descriptions** in a mode card's menu opens this view for that mode. - **Batch edits**: edit one tool for several modes at once, or edit several tools and save them together with **Save all**. Drafts stay until you save or discard them, also while you visit another view. Under each tool you see its built-in text, its state in every ticked mode, and earlier versions you can load back. - **

# dsh-unreal-engine-skills

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Unofficial [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) port of Epic Games'
[Unreal Engine Skills for Claude Code](https://github.com/EpicGames/unreal-engine-skills-for-claude-code-plugin)
(MIT, upstream 3.1.1). One bundle gives an agent three things:

- **Three runtime skills.** `unreal-mcp` (discover and call Editor toolsets), `create-toolset`
  (author AI-callable C++/Python toolsets) and `unreal-skill` (author UE Agent Skills inside the
  editor), registered from [`skills/`](skills/).
- **The Unreal MCP connection.** A `unreal-mcp` row using `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` connects to
  the editor's `ModelContextProtocol` server (default `http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp`). The port and URL
  path are editable on the Harness Plugins page and take effect on save, without restarting.
- **Unreal project context.** When a session's working directory is inside an Unreal project, a
  short UE-specific context note is added to the system prompt (the directory is detected by
  walking upward for a `.uproject` or `GenerateProjectFiles.*`).

Current version: **1.0.9**. See [Status and verification boundary](#status-and-verification-boundary)
for what has and has not been verified.

## Install

Requires DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh` in
[`package.json`](package.json)).

### From GitHub

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:liuli-zsl/dsh-unreal-engine-skills
```

For `dsh web`, use the `web` profile. On the official Desktop app, prefer the app's **Plugins**
page and enter the GitHub source there. Command-line management of `desktop` requires the command
installed by Desktop, an initialized profile, and fully quitting the app first; the npm CLI cannot
manage that profile. See the [official CLI reference](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/cli/README.md).
The bundle patch adds two loader rows: `unreal-engine-skills` (this package) and `unreal-mcp`
(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`).

### From the plugin market

This plugin is [listed in the community catalog](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/liuli-zsl/dsh-unreal-engine-skills/) used by `dshmarket`; [market PR #8355](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/8355) merged on 2026-10-20 (UTC).

The catalog's npm-version index for Harness 0.2.1+ **Plugins → Discover** is narrower than its full GitHub catalog: its generator requires an npm package, an exact version and its publish time. This plugin's catalog record has no npm package or version, and it is absent from that index as checked on 2026-10-21. It remains GitHub-only with `private: true`. This is a limit of that catalog's generator, not a requirement of every Discover index. See [`docs/publishing.md`](docs/publishing.md).

### From a local checkout (development)

Point the Harness plugin manager's `install_bundle` at this directory, or add the directory with
`dsh plugin add`. When installed as a link to this checkout, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
here first: the host-side dependency (`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`) must be present in this
repository's `node_modules`, otherwise the plugin row silently stays inactive and none of the
skills, context injection or port form work.

## Editor setup (once per project)

Your engine build must actually contain the `ModelContextProtocol` and `AllToolsets` plugins.
This package does not install them, and does not claim support for every UE5 release. The exact
engine version/branch and Windows/Linux behavior have not yet been recorded as verified.

1. Enable the `ModelContextProtocol` and `AllToolsets` plugins in the project's `.uproject`.
   Without `AllToolsets` the server starts but exposes no tools.
2. Start the MCP server when the editor runs: either set `bAutoStartServer=True` under
   `[/Script/ModelContextProtocolEngine.ModelContextProtocolSettings]` in
   `<Project>/Saved/Config/<Platform>Editor/EditorPerProjectUserSettings.ini`, or run
   `ModelContextProtocol.StartServer [port]` in the editor console.
3. The default port is `8000`.

## Port configuration

- **Plugins page form (recommended).** Port and URL path are volatile config of the
  `unreal-engine-skills` row. Saving goes through Harness settings (`settings.mutate` →
  `configEditor.edit`); the host half then synchronizes the `unreal-mcp` row's `url` to
  `http://127.0.0.1:<port><path>` and the MCP client reconnects, without a restart. The sync runs
  both for a settings save (the Loader announces committed volatile changes) and after a plugin
  reload, and writes only when the url actually changes. It preserves current explicit settings
  (including headers, timeouts and reconnect policy), with bundle defaults for fields that have not
  been overridden (`failOnStartupError`, 300 s tool timeout, ~1 h backoff reconnect budget). On a
  Harness build that does not announce volatile updates, a saved endpoint takes effect on the next
  reload or restart.
- **Valid input.** Port must be an integer from 1 to 65535. The path must start with `/`, contain
  no spaces, backslashes, query or fragment, and use percent encoding for characters outside the
  RFC 3986 path set (for example `/mcp%20endpoint`). Both the form and host schema validate it.
- **Environment variable.** `UNREAL_MCP_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9999/mcp` set before starting
  Harness. It is process-wide (restart required) and always takes precedence over the form.
- **Custom transport guard.** If you change the `unreal-mcp` row to a stdio proxy
  (`transport: stdio` with `command`/`args`), the port sync leaves that row untouched.
- **Patch entry caveat.** In a profile patch, an entry with the same `id` *replaces* the row's
  config instead of merging. A hand-written patch must repeat `serverName` / `transport` / `url`;
  writing only `url` fails schema validation and the plugin will not activate. Prefer the form or
  the environment variable.
- The sync relies on the HMR transaction around `configEditor.edit()`: it escapes the nested
  transaction check with `hmr.executing.exit()` and runs on the HMR queue
  (`HMR transactions cannot be nested` is a design constraint, not a defect).

## Verify

With the editor running, ask the agent to call `mcp__unreal-mcp__list_toolsets` (or "list all actors
in the current level"). On the Plugins page the `unreal-mcp` row should be running, and the editor
output log should show the MCP server startup message.

## Security

The bundle gives an agent broad live access to a running editor, including
`ProgrammaticToolset.execute_tool_script` (arbitrary Python inside the editor process). Treat it
like "letting an assistant run arbitrary code". Commit or shelve before long MCP sessions and
review the diff afterwards. The upstream
[README](https://github.com/EpicGames/unreal-engine-skills-for-claude-code-plugin#security) has the
full threat model.

## Status and verification boundary

Version 1.0.9 changes only licensing and release documentation. The existing automated Node tests cover schema validation, preservation of custom MCP settings,
environment-variable precedence, transport protection, HMR transaction escape, skill registration,
project context, and the volatile-settings sync path. Browser tests evaluate the actual bundle
against shared-primitives contract shims; they do not render the real Harness UI.

Earlier releases were checked online against DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2: schema visibility, port
sync, client bundle delivery and slot registration. Those historical results are recorded in
[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) and are not a fresh acceptance of 1.0.9.

Live verification of 1.0.6 confirmed the form, the invalid-value blocking and the settings write,
but found that a saved endpoint did not reach the MCP row until a restart; 1.0.7 fixed that and the
save flow was re-checked live on 2026-10-21: a 9999 → 8000 save updated `unreal-mcp.url` in the same
process, with no restart and no write loop. Still required for 1.0.9: a clean-profile install and a
successful read-only tool call against a running editor. The sync depends on DSH internals
(`configEditor`, the HMR queue, `hmr.e

plugins.description: LeetCode Hot 100 learning plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): lessons, sandboxed judge, AI tutor, spaced review, and an AI agent that adds LeetCode problems from a plain description. 力扣热题 100 学习插件。

# DeepSeek Harness LeetCode **Learn algorithms inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): lessons, all of LeetCode Hot 100, a sandboxed judge, and an AI tutor.** English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%20%E2%86%92%200.2.x-4D6BFE) ![Hot 100](https://img.shields.io/badge/LeetCode%20Hot%20100-100%2F100-FFA116) ![Desktop & Web](https://img.shields.io/badge/Desktop%20%26%20Web-supported-2EA043) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey)
## Why - **All of LeetCode Hot 100**, plus 8 more classics — each with an original summary, three progressive hints, and an explained solution. Statements stay on LeetCode; every problem links to the official page. - **A real judge on your machine.** Code runs in Docker with no network. Hidden boundary, random, and large cases catch wrong and slow solutions — including design classes, in-place edits, and linked-list/tree node problems. - **Lessons before problems.** 16 topics, from hashing to dynamic programming, each with a worked example you can trace step by step. Then the tutor writes a short check about the lesson, reviews your answers, and decides when you're ready for the practice problem. - **Add problems by just describing them.** "3 medium BFS problems I haven't done" — an AI agent finds them on LeetCode, writes the tests, and adds them only if they pass validation. ## A closer look


Hot 100 — LeetCode's own grouping, with your progress per group

Solve — editor, Run and Submit, hidden tests Submissions — runtime, memory, and every past attempt


Your record — solved by difficulty, a yearly calendar, streaks, and recent passes

Learn — worked examples you can trace Hints — direction, key idea, outline, solution


Tutor check — questions written for the lesson, answers reviewed by the tutor (real DeepSeek output)

Also included: an AI tutor chat, spaced-repetition reviews with fresh validated variants, progress by concept, and optional daily reminder email. ## Quick start 1. **Install Docker Desktop.** Learn then guides the rest: it can start Docker and download the runner images with one click, or run `docker pull python:3.13-alpine node:24-alpine` yourself. 2. **Install the plugin** from `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode`: - **Desktop:** Plugins → install from GitHub. - **Web:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode dsh web ``` 3. **Open Learn** in the sidebar. Explanations default to Chinese; switch to English in Learn → Settings. Needs DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer, below 0.3 (tested on 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.1-alpha.3). A default model (for example, signed in to DeepSeek) is optional: it powers the tutor, tutor-written lesson checks, AI feedback, and Add problems. Running, judging, written hints, and the lessons' built-in check questions work without one.
Install from the command line on Desktop Quit Desktop completely, then run its bundled CLI and reopen Desktop: ```sh "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode ``` The repository ships prebuilt files in `lib/`, so installing runs no build script. Pin a commit for reproducible installs: `github:kapelame/deepseek-harness-leetcode#`.
## How judging works Every verdict comes from test execution only. Your code runs in a Docker container with no network, a read-only filesystem, and memory, CPU, and process limits; expected answers never enter the container. Each suite combines official example inputs with hidden boundary, random, and large cases, built from a reference solution and checked against an independent brute-force solution. A pass means **"passed local tests"**, not LeetCode acceptance. The optional AI judge adds feedback but can never change the verdict. ## Add problems Practice → **Add problems**. Describe what you want and pick how many (1–5). Progress streams live, and you can stop at any time; problems already added stay. - The agent follows the bundled skill [`skills/learn-problem-author/SKILL.md`](skills/learn-problem-author/SKILL.md), which is visible only to the finder agent, never in your normal Sessions. - Number, title, difficulty, tags, signature, and examples always come from LeetCode's metadata, never from the model. Paid-only problems and problems that need a judge Learn does not provide are skipped. - Each problem must pass the same validation as the built-in ones before it is added. - In our live tests with DeepSeek, a run took 70–300 seconds and added every problem requested.
## Privacy - Your code runs only inside offline Docker containers. - With a default model, Submit (unless `agents.judge: false`), hints, tutor chat, reflections, and variant generation send the problem summary and your code to that model through DSH. Lesson checks send the lesson and your answers. Add problems sends your description and LeetCode metadata, never your code. Each run appears in your Session history. - Add problems queries LeetCode's public GraphQL API for problem metadata only: no login, no statements, paced requests with a per-run budget. - Nothing else leaves your machine, except reminder email if you configure SMTP.
Configuration The plugin adds two rows to your profile: `learn` (the service) and `learn-ui` (the Remote API and UI). Override settings in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. A patch replaces the row's whole `config`, so keep `dataRoot`: ```yaml - id: learn config: dataRoot: !!js dshHomePath('learn') defaultLocale: en reviewDailyLimit: 3 agents: judge: false # deterministic judging only, no AI feedback variantGeneration: true finder: enabled: true maxProblems: 5 # problems per Add problems run maxSubmissionsPerProblem: 3 maxLeetcodeRequests: 40 # LeetCode requests per run requestIntervalMs: 1000 email: transport: capture # 'smtp' sends only with liveSendingAuthorized: true ``` Data lives in `learn/` under your DSH home (`~/.dsh` by default); Settings can export it as JSON or reset it. Real email needs `email.transport: smtp`, `email.liveSendingAuthorized: true`, `email.smtp.host`/`port`/`user`, and the SMTP password stored as the DSH credential named by `email.smtp.passwordRef` (default `DSH_LEARN_S

# dsh-export-plugin · 会话导出 Markdown + PDF 在 dsh 会话行"更多"菜单里,于"归档会话"下方注入两项: - **导出 Markdown** —— 与 PDF 同一套**极简问答对**（只有用户输入 + 该轮最后一条助手可见回复）转成 `.md` 下载。 - **导出 PDF** —— 只取**用户输入 + 该轮最后一条助手可见回复**(文字与图片),排成干净的问答对,A4 排版后经系统打印对话框"另存为 PDF"。 ## 设计 复用官方 `dsh-session-log-export` 包的 `/api/session.export` route(返回 ZIP,内含 canonical JSONL log + `media/.` 图片),前端 fetch 拿 ZIP → 浏览器原生 `DecompressionStream('deflate-raw')` 解压 → 迷你 ZIP 解析器找根 `session*.jsonl`(PDF 再解 `media/*`)→ 按 V4 event type 转换 → `.md` 下载,或渲染打印专用 HTML 到隐藏 `iframe srcdoc` 并调 `contentWindow.print()`。 **纯前端注入,零 npm 依赖,不读 zstd**(官方已用 persistence read handle 把 log 解好放进 ZIP),不碰 persistence。PDF 走 `window.print` 而不是 jsPDF/pdfMake:零依赖、中文用系统字体、图片与 CSS 排版交给浏览器。 ## PDF 导出范围 | 事件 / 内容 | 是否导出 | |---|---| | `user/message` 且 `source.kind === 'user'`(真实用户输入,含图片) | ✅ | | `agent/inbox/spliced` 里 role=user 的插入消息 | ✅ 与上一条是**同一个 message id**,按 id 去重只出一次 | | `runtime-context` / `time-context` / `skill-catalog` / 工作区指令等**系统注入** | ❌ 它们也走 `user/message`,按 `source.kind` 滤掉 | | `assistant/message` 的 `text` block | ✅ 但**每轮只留最后一条** | | `assistant/message` 的 `image` block | ✅ | | 同一轮里工具调用前后的**过渡说明文本** | ❌ 被该轮最后一条覆盖 | | `thinking` / `reasoning` block(思考过程) | ❌ | | `tool_use` / `tool_result` / `tool/call` / `tool/result` | ❌ | | `system/message` / `developer/message` | ❌ | | `assistant/attempt`(半途草稿、流式分片) | ❌ | | 子代理会话(`includeDescendants=false`) | ❌ | | 未知/其它事件类型 | ❌ | 即 PDF 是一份干净的"我问了什么 / 最终答了什么"记录,不含模型内部过程。配对规则:以 `turn/end` 作为一轮的边界,把该轮的用户输入与**最后一条**助手可见回复排成一组;日志末尾再收尾 flush 一次,所以被打断 / 未正常结束的回合也不会丢内容。用户消息里的图片会内嵌到 PDF(缺图时输出 `[图片未随会话导出]` 占位)。 > **为什么必须"按 id 去重 + 按 source.kind 过滤"**(来自真实会话日志的教训): > 同一条用户输入在 `agent/inbox/spliced` 与 `user/message` 里**各记一次、共用同一个 message id**, > 不去重就会每句提问出现两遍;而 `runtime-context`、`time-context`、`skill-catalog`、工作区指令 > (如 CLAUDE.md,实测上万字符)也是 `user/message`,不按 `source.kind === 'user'` 过滤就会**冒充用户提问** > 混进 PDF。两者叠加曾是 PDF 里"重复提问 + 莫名其妙的成段内容"的直接原因。 ## 导出的 Markdown 结构 Markdown 与 PDF **共用同一套"极简问答对"**（同一份 `jsonlToBlocks` 输出），只有标题、角色、正文和图片占位： ``` # Session - Created: - Workspace: ## 👤 用户 <用户消息> ## 🤖 助手 <助手回复（保留 Markdown 代码块与列表）> ## 👤 用户 …（每轮如此） ``` 不再包含工具调用 / 工具结果 / 系统提示词 / 思考过程 / 上下文注入 / 未知事件的 JSON dump。图片位置输出 `[图片]` 占位（Markdown 不做 base64 内嵌，避免文件膨胀）。 实测（同一会话 `session-5494db1e`）：**旧导出 146,662 字节 → 新导出 3,208 字节**（约 2.2%）。 > 需要**完整会话日志**（含工具调用、系统提示词）时，用会话菜单里官方 `dsh-session-log-export` 提供的导出项，它仍会给出完整的 ZIP/日志。 ## 菜单挂载的真实 DOM 官方菜单行由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 的 `MenuItemButton` 渲染(类名是 CSS module 哈希): ```html
``` 注入做法:按文本 `归档会话` / `取消归档` 找到 `[role="menuitem"]`,再取它的外层 `div.itemWrap`,**克隆整个 `itemWrap`**(不是只克隆 button——`.itemWrap` 是 `position:relative` 的整行单元,只克隆 button 会让两个 button 挤在同一个包裹层里),然后改 `itemLabel` 文字、替换 svg 图标、移除 `shortcut`、绑定 click,依次插到原行后面(Markdown 在前、PDF 在后)。 ## 文件 - `index.js` — apply 注入,通过 `webServer.tapIndex` 把 HTML 注入 `` 前 - `inject.mjs` — 导出 `exportInjectHtml` 字符串,含 CSS + JS IIFE(两个导出项 + ZIP 解析 + MD/PDF 两条转换链) - `cordis.patch.yml` — 插件 bundle 声明 - `package.json` — 包配置 - `test-inject.mjs` — 回归测试(见下) ## 安装 ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add D:\dsh-code\export-plugin ``` 插件以**目录链接**安装(profile 的 `dsh-export-plugin` → `link:D:/dsh-code/export-plugin`),改 `inject.mjs` / `index.js` 后**只需重启 dsh**(`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`),不必重新 add;改 `package.json` 结构字段需重新 add。 > `inject.mjs` 的注入串在服务启动时随模块加载定格,重启前改动不会生效。 ## 自测(改完 inject.mjs 先跑这个) ```bash node test-inject.mjs ``` 它做六件事: 1. 断言外层模板字面量里**没有残留的单反斜杠** `\n` / `\.` / `\d`; 2. 提取内联 `

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: shows the current session's spend, priced by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-session-spend

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that shows what the current
session has cost so far, split by DeepSeek's peak and off-peak rate windows.

![The cost pill and its breakdown panel](docs/screenshot.png)

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

## What it shows

A pill in the composer dock, beside the shipped token-usage pill:

```
   [shipped] 11 turns 191 steps · 226 tok/s   51.5M tok · 99.5% cached        (¥) ¥2.75
```

Click it for the breakdown. A session that stayed inside one window shows a single block:

```
(¥) Cost                                          ¥1.09
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Off-peak · 110 requests
Uncached input                          187K tok · ¥0.187
Cache read                            20.77M tok · ¥0.415
Output                                  121K tok · ¥0.482
```

A session spanning both windows splits into two blocks, each with its own subtotal:

```
(¥) Cost                                          ¥3.30
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Peak · 3 requests
Uncached input                         1.00M tok · ¥2.00
Output                                  100K tok · ¥0.800
Subtotal                                          ¥2.80
Off-peak · 7 requests
Cache read                             5.00M tok · ¥0.100
Output                                  100K tok · ¥0.400
Subtotal                                          ¥0.500
```

The figure is the **whole session**, not the loaded window: paging, compaction, and
resuming a session do not change it, and a retried model request is not billed twice.

## Install

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/dtxovo/dsh-plugin-session-spend
cd dsh-plugin-session-spend
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

The script does two things: copies the package to `<profile>\plugins\session-cost\`, and
appends the mount entry to `<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` (skipped when it is already there).
Then **refresh the DSH page (Ctrl+R)**.

The profile directory is resolved in this order: the `-ProfileDir` argument, then
`$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, then `~\.dsh\profiles\desktop`.

`-ExecutionPolicy Bypass` is needed because Windows blocks unsigned `.ps1` files by
default. On a machine whose execution policy already allows local scripts, `.\install.ps1`
works as-is. On macOS or Linux, do the same two steps by hand under PowerShell 7.

### Upgrading an existing install

Re-running `install.ps1` overwrites the files in place, which is enough for a normal version
bump. **A release that renames the package is the exception**: DSH caches a plugin's resolved
package name at load time, while the client bundle registers under the new one, so the browser
half fails to load even though every file on disk is correct. The script detects that case and
warns — restart DSH, then run it again. Reloading the page is not enough, because the stale
name lives in the host process.

## Configure

Edit the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and save — the patch layer is watched, so no restart
is needed. Refresh the page afterwards so the browser picks up the new rates.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-cost-v2
      name: ./plugins/session-cost/host.js
      config:
        currency: "¥"     # display symbol
        per: 1000000      # the four rates below are per this many tokens
        input: 1          # uncached input     <- off-peak rate
        cacheRead: 0.02   # cache read         <- off-peak rate
        cacheWrite: 0     # cache write (DeepSeek does not bill this separately)
        output: 4         # output             <- off-peak rate
        holidays: []      # Beijing dates, e.g. ["2026-10-01", "2026-10-02"]
        # peak:           # omit to default to off-peak x 2
        #   input: 2
        #   cacheRead: 0.04
        #   cacheWrite: 0
        #   output: 8
```

The built-in defaults are **DeepSeek `deepseek-flash` off-peak list prices** in CNY per
million tokens, taken from the official pricing page on 2026-10-15:

| | Off-peak | Peak |
|---|---|---|
| Input (cache hit) | ¥0.02 | ¥0.04 |
| Input (cache miss) | ¥1 | ¥2 |
| Output | ¥4 | ¥8 |

**Check them against your own bill.** A third-party gateway does not bill these numbers,
and this table covers only `deepseek-flash`.

## Limitations

- **Holidays are yours to fill in.** `holidays` defaults to empty. China's public holidays
  are announced yearly and cannot be derived, so top the list up each year. Weekends that
  are worked as make-up days stay off-peak: the published rule only looks at Monday-Friday
  plus the holiday list.
- **One rate table, not one per model.** Switching models mid-session is not detected; every
  token is priced with the same rates.
- **Reasoning tokens are not added on top.** `reasoningTokens` is a subset of what output is
  billed for, so adding it would double-count.
- **An estimate, not an invoice.** Token cost only — no minimum spend, tiered pricing,
  currency conversion, or granted credit.
- **The peak window is fixed** at Beijing time Monday-Friday 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00.

The design behind the numbers, and the DSH internals this plugin had to work around, are in
[docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md](docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md).

## Development

```powershell
node .\check.mjs         # 44 assertions on the client half, against ./client.js
node .\check-host.mjs "<profile>\plugins\session-cost\host.js"   # 33 assertions on the host half
```

`check.mjs` needs nothing but Node: it renders the client half through a small React
stand-in that covers exactly the API surface the component uses.

`check-host.mjs` imports the host half, which resolves `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` and `zod`
from its own location — both are supplied by DeepSeek Harness. Point it at an installed copy
(the normal case), or install those two packages first. Run it with no argument and it says
so instead of failing silently.

## Releasing

Publishing happens in CI, never from a laptop: [`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](.github/workflows/publish.yml)
publishes on a `v*` tag through npm **Trusted Publishing** (OIDC), so this repository holds no
`NPM_TOKEN` and no long-lived write credential — nothing to leak and nothing to rotate.
Provenance attestations are attached automatically for a public package in a public repository.

1. Bump `version` in `package.json` and commit.
2. `git tag v0.1.0 && git push origin v0.1.0`.

The tag-driven run needs a Trusted Publisher configured once on npmjs.com: the package's
Settings → Trusted Publisher → GitHub Actions, with user `dtxovo`, repository
`dsh-plugin-session-spend`, and workflow `publish.yml`.

## License

MIT © 2026 dtxovo

plugins.description: DSH 插件：DeepSeek 峰谷价格自动调度
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-peak-scheduler（峰谷价格自动调度）

自动判定 DeepSeek 模型的**峰价 / 谷价时段**，并把「要不要等到谷价再跑」这件事做成一键选择：

1. **自动查询峰谷时段** —— 规则取自官方文档，节假日日历联网获取（带本地缓存与降级）；
2. 输入框加一个 **「峰谷调度」** 按钮，点开弹窗让你选 **立即执行** 或 **推迟到谷价**；
3. 选推迟的提示词不会立刻跑，而是建成一个**等待任务**（耐久存储、到点自动投递回本会话），
   左侧侧边栏出现带数量的 **「等待任务」** 入口；
4. 等待中的任务随时可以 **立即开始**（或取消）。

## 安装

需要可用的 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 环境。

> 📌 **先确认你的 profile 名**：它是 `~/.dsh/profiles/` 下的**目录名**（DSH 桌面版通常是
> `desktop`，Web 版通常是 `web`，可以 `ls ~/.dsh/profiles/` 看一眼）。
> **下面三处出现的 profile 名必须是同一个值** —— 本文统一以 `desktop` 举例，照抄时请先换成你自己的。

**① 安装插件**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:yizhiyizhi0128/dsh-peak-scheduler
```

**② 在这个 profile 里登记 bundle**

编辑 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`，把 `dsh-peak-scheduler` 加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```jsonc
"dsh": {
  "profile": {
    "bundles": [
      "dsh-peak-scheduler"                          // ← 新增这一行
    ]
  }
}
```

**③ 安装依赖并重启 DSH**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop install
```

新 bundle 要在启动时进 boot graph，所以**必须重启 DSH** 才会生效。

> ⚠️ 本插件的「等待任务」落在**官方 `schedule` 服务**里，所以 profile 的 bundles
> 必须同时包含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle`（它只能在 bundles 里按名插入，
> **不要**写进 `dependencies`）。详见下文「启用官方 schedule bundle」一节。

**离线安装 / 自行构建**：见文末「如何启用」。

## 峰谷规则（唯一的判定依据）

来源：DeepSeek 官方 API 文档「模型 & 价格」（中英两版互校，两版说的是同一件事）。

> 北京时间周一至周五（不含中国法定节假日）**09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00** 为**高峰时段**；
> 其余时段，包括周末及中国法定节假日全天，均为**空闲时段**。
> 空闲时段价格为高峰时段价格的**一半**。
> （官方补充公告：**调休上班的周末**、中国法定节假日全天均按空闲时段计费。）

英文版对照（同一口径，可自校验）：

> Peak hours are **01:00 - 04:00 and 06:00 - 10:00 UTC**, Monday through Friday,
> excluding Chinese public holidays. All other hours are off-peak…
> Off-peak rates are **half** of the peak rates.

09:00 +0800 = 01:00 UTC、18:00 +0800 = 10:00 UTC，两版完全对得上。

| | 峰价 | 谷价 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 时段（北京时间） | 周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00 | 其余全部 |
| 区间语义 | `[09:00, 12:00)`、`[14:00, 18:00)` —— **左闭右开** | — |
| 周末 | 不算峰价 | ✅ 全天谷价 |
| 法定节假日 | 不算峰价 | ✅ 全天谷价 |
| **调休补班的周末** | **不算峰价** | ✅ 仍然全天谷价 |
| 价格 | 标准价 | 峰价的 50% |

### 关于「调休补班日」——查证过程与结论

2026 年有 6 个调休补班日（如 10-10 周六上班、09-20 周日上班）。官方文档只说
"excluding Chinese public holidays"，**没有提补班日算不算峰价**，所以这是一个真实的歧义点，
不能靠猜。查证结果：

- 国务院 2026 年放假安排：国庆 10-01 至 10-07 放假调休，**09-20（周日）、10-10（周六）上班**；
- DeepSeek 同日发布的 API 峰谷时间说明：**「调休上班的周末、中国法定节假日全天均按空闲时段计费」**。

**结论：周末无论是否调休都是谷价，补班不改变这一点。**
所以本插件只需要「放假日」集合（`isOffDay: true`），**刻意不把补班日当峰价日** ——
`lib/holidays.js` 的注释里写明了这个判断依据，测试里也专门钉了这条
（`test/holidays.test.mjs` 断言 2026-10-10 / 09-20 / 02-28 不在放假日集合内，且它们确实是周末）。

## 按钮与入口位置

| 位置 | 槽位 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 输入框工具行 **「峰谷调度」** | `conversation.input.right`（`order: 20`） | 紧邻发送区；`dsh-send-mode` 是 10，本插件排其后 |
| 侧边栏 **「等待任务」**（带数量角标） | `sidebar.footer.action`（`order: 10`） | 落在设置/账号行上方，与「本地记忆」同一区域 |

侧边栏入口每 20 秒轮询一次 `/tasks`；点开是**自带的等待任务面板**（列表 + 立即开始 + 取消），
与官方 `ui-schedule` 的「自动化任务」页各管各的展示，但**共用同一批任务数据**
（都是 `schedule` 服务里的记录，不存在两份真相）。

## 一个已修的真实故障：`The scheduled time must be strictly in the future.`

**触发条件**：当前**已经处于谷价**时点「推迟到谷价」。

**根因**：官方 schedule 对绝对时点 `at` 的要求是「**严格**未来的绝对时点」，
而"当前已是谷价"时 `nextOffPeak.at` 就等于**此刻**。把它当 `at` 交过去必然被
`not_future` 拒绝 —— 首版就是这么写的。

**修法**：改用 `after_seconds`（官方定义：**正安全整数秒数的延迟**）。
延迟语义天然相对现在、必然在未来，不受"采样时刻 vs 排队时刻"的竞态影响，
也省掉了自己拼本地日期时间对象那一层时区换算。另加两道保险：

- `deferDelaySeconds()` 保证返回值**恒 ≥ 2 秒**（`MIN_LEAD_SECONDS`）；
- 创建成功后核对返回的 `scheduledAt` 是否真在未来，**不是就撤销该任务并如实报错**，
  绝不留一个永远不会触发的任务。

**顺带修了文案**：已在谷价时"推迟"没有意义（再等也不会更便宜），
该选项改为 **「立即执行（已是谷价，无需等待）」**，说明写清"约几秒后自动执行、
仍可在侧边栏取消"。

**回归测试**：`test/host.test.mjs` 第 8 节把"延迟恒为正、目标严格在未来"钉死
（含"目标=此刻"、"目标已过去"、"只差 1 毫秒"、"算不出目标"等 case）；
`test/client.test.mjs` 第 12 节覆盖谷价态下的文案与创建流程。

**注意：修完必须重启宿主才生效。** 插件模块被宿主进程缓存，
重启前仍在跑修前的代码（实测：改完文件、路由已活，`/defer` 依旧报同一个错）。
重启后用这条命令复验当前这个"已在谷价"的场景：

```powershell
$body = @{ sessionId = "<本会话 id>"; prompt = "自检" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-peak-scheduler/defer -Method Post `
  -ContentType "application/json; charset=utf-8" `
  -Body ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body))
# → { ok: true, task: { ..., afterSeconds: 2 }, target: { alreadyOffPeak: true, ... } }
```

## 第二个已修的真实故障：跑完的任务一直挂在「等待中」

**现象**：任务已经到点、提示词也投递进会话了，但侧边栏角标永远显示 1，点开是个已完成的任务。

**根因**：官方 schedule 的**一次性任务在投递完成后会保留为 `inactive`**（设计如此，
文档原文："一次性任务在持久收件箱投递后仍以未运行状态保存"）。
我的筛选只判断了「这条任务是不是本插件建的」，没判断「它是否还在等待」，
于是已投递的任务被一直算作等待中。

**修法**：

- `partitionTasks()` 把目录条目分成 **等待中**（`isPeakTask && status !== 'inactive'`）与
  **已投递**（`isPeakTask && status === 'inactive'`）两组，只把前者算进角标；
  官方自建提醒单独归入 `otherTasks`，不伪装成峰谷任务；
- `/tasks` 支持 `sessionId` 过滤（侧边栏是全局视角，不传）；
- `/run-now` 改用 `catalog` 查任务 —— 官方 `list` **只返回活动任务**，
  用 `list` 查已投递的任务会报"找不到"；现在对已投递的任务返回 **409 + 明确说明**
  （"该任务已经执行过了，未重复发送"），不会重复投递；
- 已投递/已消失任务的本地元数据会被清理，`meta.json` 不会无限增长。

**回归测试**：`test/host.test.mjs` 第 9 节，覆盖全局/限定会话/未知会话/无元数据/空目录
等情形，并断言"等待中的每一行都同时满足「是本插件建的」+「status !== inactive」"。

## 交互流程

```
输入框里写好提示词
   └─ 点「峰谷调度」
        ├─ 弹窗显示：当前是峰/谷、当前时段、距下次切换多久、判定依据、日历可用性
        ├─ [立即执行]          → 调用 DSH 自己的 inputActions.submit()（不绕开发送通道）
        └─ [推迟到谷价时段自动执行]（已在谷价时显示为「立即执行（已是谷价，无需等待）」）
             ├─ POST /dsh-peak-scheduler/defer { sessionId, prompt }
             ├─ 宿主算出到谷价的秒数（恒 ≥ 2），用 schedule.create(after_seconds) 建一次性任务
             ├─ 成功后才清空输入框（失败保留草稿并报错）
             └─ 侧边栏「等待任务」角标 +1
                   └─ 可随时「立即开始」→ POST /run-now
                        ├─ sessionController.prompt() 把提示词投递进原会话
                        └─ 投递成功后再删等待任务（避免"没执行又被删了"）
```

到谷价时点时，由**官方 schedule 服务**自动把提示词作为后续消息投递回原会话
（宿主重启后任务仍在；冷会话会被唤醒）。

## 文件

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | 包声明（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层，插入 loader 条目 `id: peak-scheduler` |
| `index.js` | 宿主半边：HTTP 路由 + 调 schedule/sessionController |
| `lib/peak.js` | **峰谷判定纯逻辑**（无 IO、可单测：边界、跨日、跨周末、跨年） |
| `lib/holidays.js` | 节假日日历：联网获取 + 本地缓存 + 降级 |
| `src/client.js` | 浏览器半边（输入框按钮 + 弹窗 + 侧边栏入口与面板） |
| `lib/client.js` | esbuild 构建产物 |
| `build.mjs` | 构建脚本 |
| `test/peak.test.mjs` | 峰谷判定 85 项 |
| `test/holidays.test.mjs` | 真实联网校验日历 30 项 |
| `test/host.test.mjs` | 宿主响应组装与元数据 47 项 |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 客户端交互 55 项 |
| `test/bundle.check.mjs` | 产物 + 安装态自检 |

## 依赖：官方 schedule bundle（已启用）

等待任务的**耐久存储与到点投递**没有自己重写，而是复用官方能力：

> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle` —— 官方可选实验 bundle，
> 提供 `Schedule` 服务、自动化任务页、以及投递所需的 Session controller 挂载。
> 它默认**不在**随发行版的 Web 组合里，需要在 profile 启用。

本机已在 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的两处登记：

```jsonc
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
  "dsh-peak-scheduler",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle"   // ← 新增
] } }
```

> **踩过的坑**：不要把它写进 `dependencies`。它不是 npm 上发布的包，
> 写进 dependencies 会让 `pnpm install` 去 registry 拉取并失败
> （`Failed to fetch metadata from https://registry.npmjs.org/...`）。
> 它只能通过 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 按 bundle 名插入。

## 如何启用

```powershell
# 在仓库根目录执行；Node 用任意 >= 22 的版本即可
cd <本仓库目录>

npm install --save-dev esbuild   # 仅构建需要（build.mjs 会从本地 node_modules 解析）
node build.mjs                   # 产出 lib/client.js

# 测试（全部离线，holidays 那条会联网取日历）
node test/peak.test.mjs          # 85 checks
node test/holidays.test.mjs      # 30 checks（需联网）
node test/host.test.mjs          # 81 checks
node test/client.test.mjs        # 65 checks
node test/bundle.check.mjs       # 构建产物 + 安装态自检
                                 #   （未装 DSH 时第 4、5 节会显示 SKIP，不是失败）

npm pack                         # 产出 dsh-peak-scheduler-<版本>.tgz
Copy-Item dsh-peak-scheduler-*.tgz "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\vendor\" -Force

# profile 登记（见上一节两处）+ 安装依赖
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles\desktop"   # profile 名按你的实际情况改
pnpm install
```

> 测试脚本通过 `DSH_HOME` / `DSH_PROFILE` 环境变量定位 DSH 安装位置，
> 默认 `~/.dsh` + `desktop`，不写死任何人的机器路径。

然后**重启承载 GUI 的进程**（新增插件条目要在 boot 时进 boot graph）并硬刷新页面。

## 如何验证

**A. 宿主路由（重启后可用）**

```powershell
Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-peak-scheduler/health
# → { ok: true, schedule: true, sessionController: true }

Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:19387/dsh-peak-scheduler/status
# → { tier, isPeak, nowLabel, window, next, nextOffPeak, calendar, rule, ... }
```

**B. 界面**

1. 输入框工具行出现 **「峰谷调度」**；写一句话点开弹窗，应看到当前时段、
   距切换的倒计时、以及「判定依据」一行；
2. 选 **立即执行** → 等同按 Enter 发送；
3. 选 **推迟到谷价** → 输入框被清空，侧边栏「等待任务」出现角标；
4. 点侧边栏入口 → 面板列出该任务与计划执

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-upgrade 🚀

> 专为 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 打造的一站式版本检测、多通道平滑升级与服务守护插件。

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-upgrade.svg?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-upgrade)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-upgrade.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-upgrade)
[![npmmirror](https://img.shields.io/badge/npmmirror-synced-orange.svg)](https://npmmirror.com/package/dsh-upgrade)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.1.0-emerald.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-Web%20GUI-blue.svg)](#)

---

## ✨ 核心特性

- 🎯 **精准多源版本比对**：自动对比本地当前安装的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 与远端最新版本（优先使用国内 npmmirror 镜像源加速，自动降级至官方 npmjs 源）。
- 🏷️ **多通道智能分流**：
  - **稳定版通道 (Latest)**：推荐日常使用，有稳定新版本时提示蓝色徽章 `[有新版本]`。
  - **尝鲜版通道 (Alpha)**：率先体验新特性（如 `0.2.1-alpha.x`），有新预览版本时提示绿色徽章 `[有尝鲜版更新]`。
  - **全部历史 / 一键回滚**：支持浏览并自由回滚到任意历史版本。
- 🛡️ **升级前自动快照备份**：每次执行升级前，自动将当前用户的 `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 打包备份至系统临时目录（`.tgz`），确保随时可安全还原。
- ⚠️ **智能插件兼容性预检与安全防护**：
  - 升级前自动分析当前安装插件的 peerDependencies 与 DSH 版本要求；
  - 弹窗内直观列出哪些插件尚未适配目标 DSH 版本及其冲突依赖；
  - **升级时自动将不兼容插件从启动列表暂时关闭**（完整保留用户配置与代码），彻底杜绝新版本服务因旧插件报错或崩溃无法启动；
  - 待插件作者发布新版本适配后，即可无缝重新开启。
- 🔄 **深度整合服务重启**：弹窗内内置 **「重启服务」** 按钮，带有安全二次确认与影响说明，一键触发后台服务重启并重新加载插件与配置。
- ⚡ **零中断心跳探测与自动重连**：重启或升级后，前端自动进行无感心跳轮询探测，服务恢复就绪后自动平滑刷新页面，无需手动干预。
- 🎨 **无缝现代深色 UI**：完美融入 DSH 侧边栏底部工具栏（`sidebar.footer.action`），自带呼吸感提示圆点与状态胶囊。

---

## 📸 界面预览

| 稳定版通道（支持重装与重启） | 尝鲜版通道（检测 Alpha 预览） |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![稳定版通道](screenshots/modal_with_restart_btn.png) | ![尝鲜版通道](screenshots/modal_fixed_alpha.png) |

| 插件兼容性预检与自动防护 | 二次确认安全面板 |
| :---: | :---: |
| ![兼容性预警](screenshots/crop_modal_polished.png) | ![二次确认](screenshots/modal_restart_confirm.png) |

---

## 📦 安装与使用

本插件已公开发布至 **npm 全球注册表** 与 **国内 npmmirror 镜像源**，支持通过 DSH Web 界面或命令行极简安装。

### 方式一：在 DSH Web 界面中添加（推荐，最简便）

1. 打开 DeepSeek Harness 网页端（如 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）。
2. 点击左侧边栏底部的 **设置 ➔ 插件管理 ➔ 添加插件**。
3. 在包名输入框中直接填入 npm 包名：
   ```text
   dsh-upgrade
   ```
4. 点击 **安装**，安装成功后重启后台服务即可生效！

---

### 方式二：通过 CLI 命令行安装

在终端执行官方 DSH 插件添加命令：

```bash
# 从 npm 官方或国内镜像源直接安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-upgrade

# 或者直接从 GitHub 仓库源安装
dsh plugin --profile web add github:wonaren/dsh-upgrade
```

#### 生效与重启服务
安装完成后，执行 launchctl 命令重启后台服务（或直接在插件内点击重启）：

```bash
launchctl kickstart -k gui/$(id -u)/com.deepseek.dsh.web
```

---

## 📁 目录结构

```text
dsh-upgrade/
├── package.json        # 插件元数据与 DSH bundle 声明 (已发布至 npm)
├── cordis.patch.yml    # Cordis 补丁层配置
├── LICENSE             # MIT 开源协议
├── README.md           # 插件说明文档
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js        # Host 端服务：版本查询、npm 升级与服务重启执行器
│   └── client.js       # Client 端 UI：React 弹窗、侧边栏入口与心跳重连
└── screenshots/        # 实机效果预览截图
```

---

## 🔗 相关链接

- **npm Package**: [https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-upgrade](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-upgrade)
- **npmmirror 镜像**: [https://npmmirror.com/package/dsh-upgrade](https://npmmirror.com/package/dsh-upgrade)
- **GitHub 源码仓库**: [https://github.com/wonaren/dsh-upgrade](https://github.com/wonaren/dsh-upgrade)

---

## 📄 开源协议

本项目基于 [MIT 协议](LICENSE) 开源。

[金融行业专项](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-industry-finance) · [地方数据条例](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-local-regulation) **编排与交付**（3）｜ [一键体检](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-guard-suite) · [改前改后复核](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-fix-verify) · [合规可交付文档](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-compliance-doc) 都在 DSH 插件市场（dsh-plugin.org）、npm 和 deepwhale.org.cn/guard.html 上。 ---

# dsh-plugin-cdp > DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 CDP 驱动一个受控 Chrome 实例，附带「弹窗收集规则 + 文本可视化 + 无停机热替换」能力。 [English](#english) | 中文 --- ## 它解决什么问题 基于**浏览器扩展**的自动化通道驱动不了部分网站： | 问题 | 表现 | | --- | --- | | 受控标签页被清空 | 目标站点会让被控制的标签页变空白 | | 必须借用用户标签页 | 借来的标签页同样会变空白 | | 成功弹窗不可信 | 页面报告了成功对话框，但操作并未真正生效 | 本插件因此**自带一个受控 Chrome 实例**、直接说 CDP 协议，并强制「可验证的操作流程」。 **零运行时依赖** —— 只用 Node 内置的 `fetch` 与 `WebSocket`（要求 Node ≥ 22）。 --- ## 兼容性 | 项目 | 要求 | | --- | --- | | DeepSeek Harness | **`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`**（即 `engines.dsh`，由 DSH 的兼容性判定直接校验）；**已验证 0.2.1-rc.2** | | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` | `^0.1.5-rc.3 \|\| ^0.2.0-rc.1 \|\| ^0.2.1-rc.2`（peer，由宿主提供） | | `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `^3.18.2`（peer，由宿主提供） | | `@deepseek-ai/cordis` | `^4.0.2`（peer，由宿主提供） | | Node | ≥ 22（宿主自带 Node 24，无需另装） | > **`engines.dsh` 是 DSH 真正会校验的字段。** DSH 的 `evaluatePluginCompatibility()` > 在插件安装/启动时读取它；一旦声明，它**单独决定**兼容性（`peerDependencies` 不再参与判定）。 > 本插件声明 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0`：覆盖已验证的 0.2.x，并用 `<0.3.0-0` > 挡住 0.3 的预发布版本（`<0.3.0` 在 `includePrerelease` 下会误放行 `0.3.0-rc.1`）。 > **注意**：DSH 升级后，请确认 profile 里的 `@deepseek-ai` 包也已拉齐到同版本。 > 应用更新**不会**自动刷新 profile 的依赖树。详见 [UPDATES.md](./UPDATES.md)。 各版本的封装产物、SHA256 与「该用哪个版本」见 **[RELEASES.md](./RELEASES.md)**。 自查一条命令（在**仓库目录**执行；单元测试文件不随 npm 包分发）： ```sh node run-all-tests.mjs ``` --- ## 安装 ```sh npm i dsh-plugin-cdp ``` 或在 DSH 的插件配置里加入： ```yaml - id: cdp name: "dsh-plugin-cdp" config: port: 9222 ``` --- ## 三个核心能力 ### 1. 弹窗收集规则，插件本身不携带任何规则 首次使用时插件返回一份问卷，由 DSH 内置的 `ask_user_question` 弹窗询问，一屏收齐： **岗位方向 · 工作地点 · 薪资下限 · 投递平台 · 浏览器 · 排除规则** 答案落盘后不再重复询问。 **设计红线**：所有规则字段默认为空，问卷的规则类问题**不生成选项**、不标 `(Recommended)`。一旦预置选项，就等于把某个人的规则当成新用户的默认答案。插件提供的是**能力**，不是**内容**。 ### 2. 纯文本可视化，零依赖 不依赖浏览器、不依赖图表库，用 Unicode 字符画图： ``` ── 薪资分布（月薪 · 按 salaryMin 分桶，n=80；日薪 1 单未计入） ─── <7k │████░░░░░░░░░░░░░│ 7 7-9k │██████████░░░░░░░│ 19 9-12k │█████████████████│ 34 12-15k │██████░░░░░░░░░░░│ 12 ≥20k │█░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│ 2 薪资未明 │█░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│ 2 ── 投递时间线 ────────────────────────── ▂▁▁▁█ （5 天，49 单） 峰值 44 单 ``` 含薪资直方图、地点条形图、平台占比、判定构成、投递火花线、等宽明细表。中文按双宽计算，表格列不会错位。 ### 3. 运行器热替换：改规则不用停 采用 **先起新的、再退旧的**，而不是原地重启： ``` 1. 用户改规则 → 写新快照，规则指纹变化 2. 起新一代进程，与老一代并存 3. 等新一代写出心跳，证明它真的活着 4. 老一代退位 ``` **为什么不是原地重启**：那必须先杀掉老进程，于是总有一段「没有任何进程在跑」的真空期。 **为什么重叠期安全**：两代共享同一份 **append-only** 的完成记录。已完成的事两边都读得到（不会重复做），新增记录只是追加（不会互相覆盖）。重叠本身就是「不断档」的实现手段。 **失败回滚**：新一代若在就绪窗口内没写出心跳，**保留老一代继续运行**，绝不在新规则起不来时把任务停掉。 --- ## 工具一览（15 个） | 工具 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `cdp_status` | 受控 Chrome 的状态、端口、标签页 | | `cdp_navigate` | 导航并等待加载 | | `cdp_eval` | 在标签页里执行 JS 并返回 JSON | | `cdp_read` | 读取标签页 URL / 标题 / 可见文本 | | `cdp_screenshot` | 截图到本地文件 | | `cdp_new_tab` / `cdp_use_tab` | 新建 / 切换受控标签页 | | `cdp_apply_verified` | **带校验的操作**：等详情面板稳定且薪资与卡片一致才点击，且拒绝重复操作 | | `cdp_prefs` | 读取 / 写入偏好（含弹窗问卷） | | `cdp_browser_info` | 如实报告使用的浏览器与可执行文件是否存在 | | `cdp_jobs_report` | 岗位 / 薪资 / 地点文本可视化报告 | | `cdp_jobs_data` | 原始 JSON | | `cdp_runner_status` | 运行器状态，含「规则改了但还没生效」提示 | | `cdp_runner_reload` | 同步规则并热替换 | | `cdp_runner_stop` | 停止运行器 | --- ## `cdp_apply_verified` 为什么存在 一次「点错岗位」的操作长这样：点击列表卡片 → 右侧详情面板其实还没切换 → 此时点「申请」→ **申请到了上一个岗位**。 这个工具强制三道闸门： 1. 等详情面板标题**连续 3 次读数稳定** 2. 面板薪资必须与卡片薪资**逐字相同** 3. 按钮文案若已是「继续沟通 / 已投递」则**直接拒绝** 任何一条不过就返回 `ok: false` 并说明原因，绝不「看起来成功」。 > ⚠️ 成功对话框**不等于**操作已记录。请始终到站点自己的记录页复核。 --- ## 配置 ```yaml - id: cdp config: chromePath: "" # 留空则自动探测 userDataDir: "你的独立浏览器目录" port: 9222 windowSize: "1500,950" defaultTimeoutMs: 120000 # 单条 CDP 命令超时 loadEventMs: 8000 # 等待页面加载事件的上限 settleMs: 600 # 导航后额外稳定等待 prefsPath: "偏好落盘路径" stateDir: "运行器状态目录" ``` > **注意**：受控实例使用**独立的用户目录**，不复用你日常浏览器的配置，因此需要在该实例里单独登录一次目标站点。 --- ## 开发与测试 ```sh node --test lib/jobs.test.mjs # 27 项 node --test lib/report.test.mjs # 28 项 node lib/plugin.test.mjs # 62 项 node lib/supervisor.test.mjs # 44 项 node lib/selftest.mjs # 插件加载自检 ``` 自检覆盖三类**只有宿主才会拒绝**的错误，本地跑 `execute()` 是测不出来的： 1. `output.schema` 漏声明返回字段 2. 返回值含 `undefined`（不是合法 JSON） 3. 输出未通过 `validateJsonSchemaValue` --- ## 已知限制 1. **输出字段必须与 `output.schema` 逐一对应** —— `additionalProperties: false`，多一个字段就会在宿主里被拒 2. **运行器默认是心跳模式** —— 未配置命令时不执行任何实际操作，这是有意为之：先证明链路通 3. **热替换依赖 append-only 状态** —— 若把共享状态改成「整份重写」，重叠期就会互相丢更新，那时「先起后杀」不再安全 4. **受控浏览器需要单独登录** —— 独立用户目录意味着不复用日常登录态 --- ## License MIT --- ## English A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing Chrome DevTools Protocol automation with a **self-managed Chrome instance**, plus: - **Popup-driven rule collection** — the plugin ships **no rules**; it asks the user once via DSH's built-in `ask_user_question` and stores the answers. - **Zero-dependency text dashboards** — Unicode bar charts, sparklines and monospace tables for job / salary / location data (CJK double-width aware, so columns never misalign). - **Zero-downtime hot-swap** — when rules change, a new worker generation starts and proves it is alive **before** the old one retires. The two generations share **append-only** state, so overlap is safe and there is no gap with nothing running. If the new generation fails to start, the old one is kept. 15 tools total. Zero runtime dependencies (Node ≥ 22 built-in `fetch` + `WebSocket`). > ⚠️ A success dialog does **not** prove an action was recorded. Always verify on the site's own record page.

plugins.description: DSH 插件：在界面里拨一个开关，用手机浏览器继续当前会话（内嵌反向代理 + Cloudflare 隧道 + 微信推送）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-phone-access

在 **DSH 界面里拨一个开关**，手机浏览器就能接着当前会话用 —— **同一个进程、同一个会话**，两端消息实时同步。

```
┌─────────┐   临时隧道      ┌──────────────┐         ┌─────────────┐
│  手机   │ ─────────────▶ │  本地代理    │ ──────▶ │  DSH 本体   │
│ 浏览器  │  trycloudflare  │ （插件内起） │ loopback│ （你正在用）│
└─────────┘                 └──────────────┘         └─────────────┘
```

## 它解决什么问题

想从外面访问家里的 DSH，通常卡在三件事上：

1. **绑不了 `0.0.0.0`** —— DSH 出于安全只允许 `127.0.0.1` / `0.0.0.0`，而后者会把「能执行任意命令的界面」暴露给整个局域网。
2. **`/api` 的 Host 信任栅栏** —— 只放行 loopback 或配置里声明过的域名，而隧道域名每次都是随机的，无法预先声明。
3. **主连接是 WebSocket** —— 普通反向代理不处理升级握手，界面会一直停在「重新连接中」。

本插件的做法：在本地起一个**只监听 `127.0.0.1`** 的微型反向代理，把转发给 DSH 的 `Host` 改写成 loopback（栅栏于是放行），剥掉 `Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-*`（避免被判为跨站），并**原样透传 WebSocket 升级**。DSH 始终只监听本机，不开任何入站端口。

## 界面

开关长在鲸鱼娘插件上（如果装了 [`dsh-whale-widget`](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget)）：

- 点鲸鱼娘的 ☰ 设置菜单 → 多一行 **「手机访问」**，带拨动开关和一个小齿轮；
- **点击后开关立刻到位并保持**，鲸鱼开始**转圈**表示加载；
- **彻底开好之后**鲸鱼身后亮起**圆形绿色呼吸光晕**；
- 点那一行右边的 **⚙** 打开**推送设置**（见下）；
- 没装鲸鱼插件时，回退成自带的小鲸鱼图标（可拖动，**右键**打开推送设置）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-phone-access
```

装好后重启 DSH，开关即出现。

## 配置

### 推送：直接在界面里填（推荐）

点 ☰ 菜单里「手机访问」那行的 **⚙**：

```
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│ 手机访问 · 推送设置                │
│ 推送方式  [Server酱（微信服务号）▾] │
│ 密钥      [••••••••••••••••••••] │
│           已配置：SCT4••••••••lMZ │
│ 每日上限  [8                    ] │
│           [ 测试 ]  [ 保存 ]      │
│           [ 清除已存密钥 ]         │
└──────────────────────────────────┘
```

- **测试**：立刻发一条到你的微信，验证填对没有（用的是输入框里的值，**不保存也能测**）。
- 密钥存在本机 `$DSH_HOME/remote-access/config.json`，权限 `0600`。
- **界面永远不显示密钥原文** —— 已配置时只显示一串掩码（头 4 位尾 3 位）；接口也不提供任何取回原文的途径。

### 推送：写进 profile 配置（适合批量部署）

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖。**这里的值优先于界面里存的**：

```yaml
- id: phone-access
  config:
    cloudflaredPath: ''   # 已安装的 cloudflared 路径。留空则查 PATH / 常见位置，都没有才下载
    proxyPort: 19389      # 本地代理端口；被占用会自动顺延
    rebuildMinutes: 130   # 主动更换隧道的间隔（分钟）
    autoStart: false      # 载入即开启；出于安全默认 false
    pushKind: serverchan  # serverchan | wxpusher | pushplus | webhook
    pushKey: ''           # 对应渠道的密钥
    pushCapPerDay: 8      # 每日推送上限，避免触发推送服务的风控
```

### 推送渠道

微信没有个人消息接口，只能经推送服务中转：

| pushKind | 说明 | 是否需实名 |
|---|---|---|
| `serverchan` | [Server酱](https://sct.ftqq.com/)，消息进微信服务号，微信扫码即得 SendKey | 否 |
| `wxpusher` | [WxPusher](https://wxpusher.zjiecode.com/)，扫码取 SPT | 否 |
| `pushplus` | pushplus，消息进微信 | **是** |
| `webhook` | 企业微信群机器人 Webhook 地址 | 否 |

### 隧道：完全不需要注册

用的是 **Cloudflare Quick Tunnel**（`cloudflared tunnel --url …`）：

- **不需要 Cloudflare 账号、不需要域名、不需要任何凭据，也不花钱。**
- Cloudflare 免费发一条随机域名，形如 `xxx-yyy-zzz.trycloudflare.com`。
- 代价是域名每次随机、且隧道会被回收（实测几十分钟到数小时）—— 所以插件会主动重建并把新地址推送给你。
- `cloudflared` 二进制首次使用时自动从 Cloudflare 官方 Release 下载（约 50MB），**不涉及你的任何账号**。


## 顺带做的两件优化

- **静态资源缓存**：DSH 的 `/assets/*` 不带任何缓存头（无 `Cache-Control` / `ETag` / `Last-Modified`），而文件名里已含构建哈希。经隧道访问时，代理为它们补上一年强缓存 —— 否则手机每次打开都要重下约 **1.4MB**。图片/字体给一天缓存。
- **端口自动顺延**：默认端口被占用时自动换一个，不和机器上其它隧道/代理打架。

## 安全说明

请务必理解这个插件做了什么：

- **默认关闭**。只有你手动拨开，才会对外开洞。
- **DSH 仍只监听 `127.0.0.1`**。插件不改 DSH 的绑定，也不动防火墙；对外只有那一条隧道。
- **访问要过认证**。隧道后面是 DSH 自己的会话 cookie 校验；插件自己的路由同样校验 cookie（按 DSH 的规则验签），未登录一律 `401`。
- **cookie 由本机密钥签发**。签名密钥取自 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`，**永不打包、永不上传**；隧道域名变了会重新签发。派生出来的会话 cookie 通过 `/__auth` 下发并跳回首页。
- **链接即权限**。拿到完整链接的人就能进入你的会话。别发群里、别贴截图、别提交进仓库。
- **隧道是临时的**。Cloudflare 免费快速隧道会被回收（实测几十分钟到数小时），插件会主动重建并推送新地址。

**如果你不接受「机器上存在一条通往你 DSH 的公网链路」，请不要启用它。**

## 兼容性

- DSH 核心 `0.2.0-rc.x`（用到 `webserver/index-inject` 与 `webServer.register`）。
- Node 20+（用到全局 `fetch`）。
- Windows / macOS / Linux；`cloudflared` 按平台自动选择资源。

## 工作原理（给想改的人）

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 插件主体：隧道管理、内嵌反向代理、微信推送、HTTP 路由 |
| `ui/ui.js` | 界面集成：鲸鱼娘光晕/转圈/菜单行，回退图标 |

HTTP 接口（均需会话 cookie）：

```
GET  /remote-access/state         当前状态
POST /remote-access/toggle        { on: boolean }
GET  /remote-access/ui.js         界面脚本
GET  /remote-access/push-config   推送配置（**只回掩码，不回密钥原文**）
POST /remote-access/push-config   { kind, key, cap } 或 { clear: true }
POST /remote-access/push-test     用表单里尚未保存的值发一条测试
```

几点实现上的坑，写下来省得别人再踩：

1. **`webserver/index-inject` 的行里，`kind: 'script'` 的 `text` 会被当作内联 JS 代码**包进 `<script>…</script>`。直接传 `<script src=…>` 会变成嵌套 script，浏览器按内联脚本解析直接语法错误、什么都不会执行。正确做法是传一段内联 JS，由它去 `document.createElement('script')`（并兼顾 `document.body` 尚未就绪）。
2. **DSH 的主连接是 WebSocket**（`/api/remote.mux`）。代理必须处理 `upgrade` 并双向管道，否则界面永远停在「重新连接中」。
3. **`COOKIE_PREFIX` 是 `dsh-auth-`**，不是 `dsh-`。名字错了签名再对也验不过。
4. **加载中不要用 `transform: rotate()` 让元素转圈**，那会覆盖它自身的 `transform`。用 CSS 的 **`rotate` 属性**，两者可叠加。

## License

MIT

## 致谢

- 界面挂在 [dsh-whale-widget](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget)（MIT）上协同工作，但**不包含也不复制它的任何代码**。
- 隧道由 [cloudflared](https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared) 提供。

plugins.readme_text: # @deepwhale-cn/dsh-consent-guard [![dshfind 收录](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard?lang=zh)](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) **同意与撤回同意**：默认勾选、捆绑同意、没有撤回入口 —— 个保法有明确要求。 **关键词**：用户同意 · 个人信息保护法 · 个保法 · 隐私政策 · 默认勾选 · 撤回同意 · 授权同意 · 隐私合规 · 单独同意 **Keywords**: user consent · PIPL · privacy policy · pre-checked box · consent withdrawal · personal information protection law **用户同意与授权确认** —— 查默认勾选、捆绑同意、没有撤回入口。 ## 不装它会怎样 你的注册页有这么一个勾选框： ```jsx 同意隐私政策和营销推广 ``` **看起来是标准做法，实际上踩了三项：** 1. **默认勾选** —— 用户什么都没做就算同意了。《个保法》第 14 条要求「自愿、明确作出」 2. **捆绑** —— 隐私政策（必要）和营销推广（非必要）合成一个勾选框 3. **没有撤回入口** 监管认定「默认勾选」时**通常直接判违规**。而改成默认不勾选，是**成本很低的合规修复之一**。 ## 它查什么 | 级别 | 内容 | 依据 | |---|---|---| | 🔴 高 | 默认勾选 | 个保法 14 条 · GDPR Recital 32 | | 🔴 高 | 采集但无同意机制 | 个保法 13/17 条 | | 🟡 中 | 捆绑同意 | 个保法 16/17 条 | | 🟡 中 | 无撤回入口 | 个保法 15 条 | ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-consent-guard # 或纯 CLI npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-consent-guard ``` ## 用法 ```bash dsh-consent-guard --demo dsh-consent-guard --list-rules dsh-consent-guard --html r.html ``` ![dsh-consent-guard 检查报告示例](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-consent-guard/report.png) ![dsh-consent-guard 演示模式输出](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-consent-guard/demo.png) ![dsh-consent-guard 规则与依据](https://www.deepwhale.org.cn/plugin-assets/dsh-consent-guard/rules.png) ## 边界 - **只看代码，不看实际界面** —— 弹窗有没有真弹出来、用户能不能看懂，需人工验证。 - **「找不到就报」的两条是弱信号** —— 撤回入口可能在服务端或另一个仓库。报出来是提示确认。 - **不判断「必要性」** —— 某项采集是否属「提供服务所必需」是法律判断。 - 与 [dsh-bundle-cn-skills](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-bundle-cn-skills) 分工： 那个做**个保法逐条对照**（更全），这个**专做同意机制**（更深）。 本插件是一个工具。使用者必须遵守所在地区法律法规，**对使用本项目造成的任何后果自行承担责任。** --- ## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 38 个） > 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。 **国内合规**（12）｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · 内容标识](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling) **AI 与 Agent 治理**（6）｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) ·
