plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-window-control

**English** · [中文正文见下方](#中文文档)

## English

Tired of going fullscreen by hand every time you open Harness? This plugin fills the screen for
you. **Self-contained**: after install, the plugin's host half opens DSH's window channel by
itself — no extra script, no Python, and no manual file editing.

**What it does**

| Capability | Notes |
|---|---|
| Master switch | On by default. Turned off, the plugin has no effect at all (no auto-fill, no shortcut quits, all other controls hidden) and it reverts the window state it changed |
| Fullscreen / leave fullscreen | True window fullscreen (covers the taskbar), not a web-level fullscreen |
| Maximize / restore | Maximizes and restores the window |
| Minimize | Sends the window to the taskbar |
| Always on top | Keeps DSH above other windows |
| Quit DeepSeek Harness | Always shows a **native confirmation dialog** first |
| Fill the screen on launch | Three choices: **maximize (default)** / true fullscreen / off. Applies immediately, no restart |
| Quit shortcut | Four choices: **Esc (default)** / double Esc / Ctrl+Q / off |
| Leave fullscreen with Esc | On by default. In true fullscreen, Esc leaves fullscreen instead of asking to quit |

Entry point: **Settings → Window & Quit**.

**Install**

**Step 1 · Add the plugin.** Open the **in-app marketplace**, search `dsh-window-control`, install.

> `dsh plugin add …` only works where an npm-installed DSH CLI exists; the desktop app ships
> **no `dsh` command by default** and reports "'dsh' is not recognized".

> **Can't find it?** Listing takes up to a day to propagate. Refresh the market (or update the market
> itself), then quit and reopen DSH. The entry is already in the catalogue
> ([registry yml](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/blob/main/data/plugins/YunLiZeMeng__dsh-window-control.yml)),
> so a miss almost always means your market cache has not caught up - not that it is unlisted.

**Step 2 · Quit DSH completely.** Tray icon → Quit. Closing the window only hides it to the tray;
that is not a quit and the channel will not be installed.

**Step 3 · Reopen DSH (first launch).** This launch writes the window channel into `app.asar`.
Open Settings → Window & Quit and you will see the channel is not active yet - **expected, not a
failure**.

**Step 4 · Quit completely and reopen again (second launch).** Now it takes effect: the warning is
gone and every button works. No more restarts after this.

**Check it worked (optional)** - paste this line into cmd and press Enter:

```bat
"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-window-control\lib\bridge-cli.mjs" status
```

`桥状态      : 已安装 v3（含最小化 / 窗口置顶）` means it is installed. The command needs neither
PATH nor a particular cwd; two things may need editing - `dsh-primary-runtime` (check the real name
with `dir /b /ad "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes"`) and the profile name `desktop`.

> On macOS / Linux the equivalent is
> `cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-window-control && node lib/bridge-cli.mjs status`.

> ⚠️ **Why two restarts?** The DSH main process loads its code at launch, and the plugin can only
> patch the window channel while DSH is already running — so the first launch installs the channel
> and the second launch is the one that reads it. Quit DSH completely (tray icon → Quit; closing
> the window only hides it to the tray) between the two launches.

**Why it touches the host.** The DSH main process exposes no IPC channel for maximize,
minimize, always-on-top or quit — the stock `app.asar` handles none of them, and the main
window hides to the tray on close. The plugin therefore injects a small set of IPC channels
into `resources/app.asar` once (equal-length replacement, archive size unchanged, integrity
hash recomputed, backup kept as `app.asar.orig`). This is the same approach other DSH plugins
that need host behaviour take. See the Chinese section *「窗口通道是怎么装上去的」* for the
byte budget, upgrade and safety details.

**Cross-platform.** Windows (user-level install) is tested and working. On Windows under
`Program Files` the first install needs one elevated run. On macOS, modifying `app.asar` can
invalidate code signing — the plugin tells you if that happens and `restore` reverts it. On
Linux it works but with fewer path fallbacks. The archive is located by deriving the install
directory from the running DSH executable, so custom install paths are supported.

**Manual commands** (troubleshooting)

The host half does all of this by itself. If you do need the CLI, paste this line into cmd and press
Enter - it needs neither PATH nor a particular cwd:

```bat
"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-window-control\lib\bridge-cli.mjs" status
```

Swap the trailing `status` for any of:

| Subcommand | What it does |
|---|---|
| `status` | is the channel installed, which version, is the lock free, is DSH running |
| `check` | build + full self-check, no write (falls back to `app.asar.orig` when the live archive is already bridged) |
| `install` | install it (idempotent); `install --force` reverts first and redoes it |
| `restore` | put the original `app.asar` back, keeping the backup (`--force` writes even without a bridge) |
| `uninstall` | revert and drop the backup |
| `bench` | time the read/build steps |

> Only two things may need editing: `dsh-primary-runtime` (see
> `dir /b /ad "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes"`) and the profile name `desktop`.

**Uninstall.** Clean uninstall is always two steps: revert the bridge **first**, then remove the
plugin - order matters.

> Why it cannot be automatic: once the plugin is removed from the profile, its host half is no
> longer loaded, so no code runs again - there is no "next launch discovers the bridge is still
> there and reverts it" opportunity. That is a hard limit of the DSH plugin model.

**Path A · command line (recommended)**

Step 1 · Revert the bridge and clear the backup - paste this line into cmd and press Enter:

```bat
"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-window-control\lib\bridge-cli.mjs" uninstall
```

Expected:

```
  [OK] 已还原为原始 app.asar；备份已清理
桥状态      : 未安装
```

> Two things may need editing: `dsh-primary-runtime` (see `dir /b /ad "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes"`)
> and the profile name `desktop`. Under `Program Files` run an **elevated** cmd.
> With `node` on PATH you can instead `cd` into the plugin directory and run
> `node lib\bridge-cli.mjs uninstall`. On macOS / Linux that is the form to use:
> `cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-window-control && node lib/bridge-cli.mjs uninstall`.

Step 2 · Remove the plugin from the marketplace.

**Path B · no command line**

Step 1 · Append these four lines to `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: dsh-window-control
  config:
    autoInstall: false
```

Step 2 · Quit DSH completely and reopen once - the host half reverts the bridge and clears the backup.

Step 3 · Verify (optional): change the last word of the Path A command to `status`;
`桥状态      : 未安装` means the archive is stock again.

> The settings entry does **not** disappear at this point: `autoInstall` only affects the host half,
> so the renderer keeps loading and that section just shows the "channel not active" note.

Step 4 · Remove the plugin from the marketplace.

**Revert only, keep the plugin** - the same line as Path A, ending in `restore` instead:

```bat
"%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-runtimes\dsh-primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe" "%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\dsh-window-control\lib\bridge-cli.mjs" restore
```

Unlike `uninstall` it keeps the `app.asar.orig` backup (useful if you plan to reinstall later). When
the archive has no bridge it writes nothing at all and reports "nothing to do" - a normal return,
not an error.

Leaving the bridge in place and only removing the plugin also "works" - it becomes dead

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-niumali · 牛马力

DSH 界面里的常驻桌宠。右下角浮着一只小牛，点开是「牛马力 · 替你活」——
一套双打卡生活闭环：开工 / 收工打卡、专注计时、待办、手帐、旅行、探宝。

![牛马力桌宠主界面](assets/screenshots/01-pet-page.png)

## 它做了什么

- **常驻浮球**：注册在 DSH 的 `shell.overlay` 插槽上，浮在整个界面之上，可拖动、可收起，位置与展开状态记录在 `localStorage`。
- **浮窗内是完整页面**：展开后用一个 iframe 载入插件自己的 `/pet-niumali/` 页面。首次展开才挂载，之后收起只是隐藏 —— 所以专注计时不会被打断。
- **徽标显示路费**：浮球上的小徽标实时读同一份存档，显示当前路费；当天开工与收工都打过卡时变成 `✓`，外圈转绿。
- **设置页一栏**：在设置的 `settings.section` 插槽里加一栏「牛马力桌宠」，用来开关浮球与单独打开页面。
- **一条静态资源路由**：`/pet-niumali/`，直接访问就是完整页面（也可以在新标签页里打开）。

插件不带后端、不发起网络请求、不读文件、不执行命令；全部存档都在浏览器 `localStorage` 的 `niumali.v9` 键下。

## 安装

### 从 DSH 插件市场（推荐）

在 DSH 的插件市场里搜索「牛马力 / dsh-pet-niumali」安装即可，装完重启 DSH。

### 手动安装

在你所用 profile 的 `package.json` 里加一条依赖，并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-pet-niumali": "github:chenyuan1251/dsh-pet-niumali#main"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "dsh-pet-niumali"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

然后在同一目录 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

> 从源码/Git 安装时，DSH 可能提示一次构建授权；这是下载整仓源码的常规行为。

## 独立桌面宠物（可选，不需要 DSH）

想不打开 DSH 也能看见它：

```bash
cd dsh-pet-niumali
npm install
npm start          # 等价于 npx electron electron/main.mjs
```

会开一个 420×720 的透明、无边框、置顶小窗。鼠标移到顶部会浮出拖动 / 置顶 / 最小化 / 关闭控制条。
这条路径与 DSH 里的浮球互不影响，两者各自用各自的 `localStorage`。

## 目录结构

```
dsh-pet-niumali/
├── package.json              # 插件元数据（dsh.bundle / dsh.client）
├── cordis.patch.yml          # 把本插件挂进插件树
├── index.mjs                 # 服务端半边：注册 /pet-niumali/ 静态资源路由
├── client.js                 # 客户端半边：shell.overlay 浮球 + settings.section
├── web/                      # 页面本体
│   ├── index.html
│   ├── desktop-pet-bridge.js # 在 Electron 小窗里显示标题与拖拽控制
│   └── assets/               # 样式、脚本与图片
├── electron/
│   ├── main.mjs              # Electron 主进程
│   └── preload.mjs           # contextBridge 暴露的最小 API
├── assets/screenshots/       # 市场截图
└── README.md
```

## 已知限制

- 图片资源约 7 MB，首次打开那一页会慢一点；之后走强缓存。
- 页面按竖版布局设计，浮窗宽度固定 400px、高度在 420–660px 之间自适应。
- 存档在 `localStorage`，所以「浏览器里」和「Electron 独立窗口里」是两份互不相通的数据。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: unified Skills + MCP manager with hot-reload enable/disable and Git-based skill install/update.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mcp-tool

[![Listed on DSH Plugin Hub](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool)
[![version](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool?label=version&color=2ea44f)](https://github.com/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool/releases)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/artorias-zj/dsh-skill-mcp-tool?color=2ea44f)](LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.15%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-2ea44f)](package.json)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that puts **Skills and MCP servers under one roof**, reachable from both the settings menu and a main-interface sidebar entry — with **hot-reload enable/disable toggles** and **Git-based skill install/update**.

## Features

**Two entry points, one panel**

- Settings menu → "技能与 MCP" / "Skills & MCP" page.
- Main interface → a sidebar icon row that opens the same panel in the centre column.

Both render the identical component, so the four tabs (Skills / MCP / Remote sources / Backup) behave the same wherever you open them.

**The plugin updates itself from the panel**

A **version card** sits above the tab strip, styled exactly like the proxy card next to it: it shows the running version, checks the upstream repository on demand, and offers a one-click update when a newer tag — or newer commits on the default branch — exist.

- **Check** compares the installed version and the commit recorded in `pnpm-lock.yaml` against `git ls-remote` of the repository declared in `package.json`, using the same proxy as skill installs. It reports a version bump, a newer commit without a tag, "up to date", or "local-dir install, not checked".
- **Update** runs `pnpm add <the spec your profile already records>` in a **detached child process** — it does not uninstall the plugin. If it fails, the running version keeps working; on success you restart DSH to load the new code.
- It never occupies the request: the panel polls a status file, so a 30-second install does not hang the page, and the outcome survives a closed panel.

> **Why not hot-swap?** The host half is ESM cached by URL and the client bundle is cached by the browser, so an in-place replacement cannot take effect without a restart anyway. The panel says so instead of claiming success.

**Layout: the two entry points are handled separately**

The host's layout contract differs between the centre panel and the settings page, so the shell has two modes selected by `data-surface`:

- **Centre panel (opened from the sidebar icon)**: the host supplies neither padding nor a scroll container, so the plugin provides both — centred content with breathing room (up to 48px per side, shrinking responsively on narrow windows) plus its own scrolling.
- **Settings page**: the host already renders the section inside its content column (padding and scrolling included), so the plugin adds nothing on top — no doubled inset, no nested scrollbars.

**Scrolling: long skill lists stay reachable, with no visible scrollbar**

In the centre panel only the list scrolls while **the title and tabs stay pinned to the top**, so the refresh button and tab strip remain reachable even at the bottom of a long list, with breathing room after the last row.

**No visible scrollbar at all**: the wheel, trackpad, touch, and keyboard (arrow keys / PageUp / PageDown) all keep working — only the bar is no longer drawn. The horizontal insets therefore *always* equal the inner padding: symmetric left and right regardless of content length or whether scrolling is needed, with no sideways jump when a scrollbar would have appeared or disappeared. The same rules cover modals, so long forms still scroll.

`scrollbar-gutter: stable` is deliberately *not* used: it reserves scrollbar width even when the content fits (measured: `stable` 15px, `stable both-edges` 30px), leaving an empty band on a page that has nothing to scroll. All three hiding mechanisms are declared — `scrollbar-width`, `-ms-overflow-style`, and `::-webkit-scrollbar` — so no browser falls back to a native bar that would skew the insets.

**Ordering: alphabetical, always**

List order is **predictable**, so you never have to hunt through entries:

- **Skills**: grouped by source, with a fixed group order of **project → user → plugin → other** (it does not shift as skills come and go, so group headings stay put); **alphabetical by name within each group**.
- **MCP servers**: managed and external rows are each sorted alphabetically by server name.
- **Remote sources**: sorted alphabetically by repository label.
- Sorting is **case-insensitive**: `Chrome_DevTools_MCP` sorts before `REA`, instead of all uppercase names clumping at the top. Only when two names are identical in lowercase does the raw string break the tie, keeping the order stable.
- Managed rows are written to `cordis.patch.yml` in that same order, so the file and the UI never disagree.
- Ordering is applied at the single choke point every write path goes through, so add/edit/enable/disable/delete can't bypass it.

**Skills**

- Lists every skill from all four standard roots, in official rank order: project `.dsh/skills` (100) → project `.agents/skills` (200) → user `~/.dsh/skills` (400) → user `~/.agents/skills` (500).
- Handles both layouts: directory bundles (`<name>/SKILL.md`) and flat files (`<name>.md`), plus nested/categorised trees.
- **Enable/disable is a lossless rename**: `SKILL.md` ⇄ `SKILL.md.disabled` (or `<name>.md` ⇄ `<name>.md.disabled`). The official provider only recognises the exact filenames, so the skill leaves the catalog while its files and `references/`, `scripts/`, `assets/` stay fully intact. The provider's watcher picks the change up on the next catalog refresh — **no restart**.
- Malformed skills stay listed but flagged **格式不合规 / Invalid format**, so you can fix or delete them rather than being unable to see them.
- Plugin-registered skills (no file on disk) are listed read-only.
- Create, edit, and delete skills through the built-in editor; frontmatter is validated before anything touches disk.
- **Install / update from Git**: shallow-clone a repository (or a subdirectory of one), discover every valid skill inside, and copy it to the chosen root. Records the source so you can re-pull later; `git ls-remote` tells you whether an update exists.
- **Junk directories are filtered out on write**: `.git`, `.hg`, `.svn`, `node_modules`, `__pycache__`, `.venv` and friends never land in the skill directory. When the repository root *is* the skill bundle (a `SKILL.md` at the top level), the clone's `.git` would otherwise be copied wholesale — worth several MB of commit history and remote URLs. The UI lists exactly what was skipped.
- **Type `/` in a session to pick a skill**: this plugin registers the skills it manages into DSH's skill registry, so the `/` menu matches and invokes them directly. A skill marked `disable-model-invocation: true` appears *only* there (the model never sees it), and a skill shown as disabled in the UI never appears in `/`. Changes take effect immediately — no restart.

  > Why this plugin supplies its own provider: the host-level `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` row is deliberately disabled by the web app (its comment reads “presets own local discovery”), leaving each agent preset to mount its own. On some presets that provider does not actually take effect — skills on disk then appear neither in `/` nor to the model. This plugin does not depend on the preset being correct; it registers the roots it manages itself.

**Proxy: a Git proxy field above the tabs**

On many networks a direct `git clone` of a repository times out, which makes installing and updating skills impossible. A **proxy bar sits above the four tabs** — it is a prerequisite shared by every Git operation in every tab (install, update, check for updates), not a setting belonging to one of them.

- **Command-scoped, never global.** The address is injected as `git -c http.proxy=… -c https.proxy=… <subcommand>`. **Your global git config is never rewritten** — try `git config --global --get http.proxy` before and after; it is untouc

plugins.description: DSH 插件，桥接 UnrealAgentLink (UEBox)，DSH生态专属优化。
plugins.readme_text:
**English** · [简体中文](docs/readme/README_zh.md) · [繁體中文](docs/readme/README_zh-TW.md) · [日本語](docs/readme/README_ja.md) · [한국어](docs/readme/README_ko.md) · [Deutsch](docs/readme/README_de.md) · [Español](docs/readme/README_es.md) · [Français](docs/readme/README_fr.md) · [Русский](docs/readme/README_ru.md) # dsh-unreal-agentlink ### A DSH plugin that puts your Unreal Editor under your agent. **Pure bridge. The agent plans; this plugin only translates.** ``` DSH agent ──tool calls──► dsh-unreal-agentlink ◄──WebSocket── Unreal Editor (plans, decides) (this plugin: server, translator) editor dials out ``` [Installation](#installation) · [Requirements](#requirements) · [12 tools](#12-tools) · [Configuration](#configuration) · [Documentation](#documentation) npm install && npm run check
--- Your agent can already read files and run commands. This plugin gives it the editor itself: query the level, spawn actors, edit blueprints and materials, render sequences, take screenshots it can actually *see*, and roll its own work back when something goes wrong. It does **not** plan tasks. Planning belongs to DSH's native agent. This plugin is a translator with a safety layer — it turns agent intent into UnrealAgentLink commands and turns the editor's answers back into something an agent can act on. --- ## Installation Three parts: put the UnrealAgentLink C++ plugin into your UE project, install this plugin into DSH, and open the editor. That is all — **no UEBox, no token, no handshake**. ### Step 1 — install UnrealAgentLink into the UE project 1. Copy the whole `UnrealAgentLink` directory into your project's `Plugins/` (or the engine's `Plugins/` for a global install). 2. Regenerate project files, then open the project. 3. Confirm UnrealAgentLink is enabled under **Edit → Plugins**. It pulls in two engine-shipped dependencies, `IKRig` and `PythonScriptPlugin`, automatically. From then on the editor dials out on its own: `StartupModule` unconditionally calls `Init("ws://127.0.0.1:17860")` and retries every 5 seconds, so **startup order does not matter**. > Port already taken (for example by UEBox)? Give the editor a different one and match it on this side: > `UnrealEditor.exe MyProject.uproject -UALServer=ws://127.0.0.1:17861` ### Step 2 — install this plugin into DSH ```bash git clone dsh-unreal-agentlink cd dsh-unreal-agentlink npm install npm run check # typecheck (src + tests) + 189 tests + catalog + doc reconciliation, one command ``` `npm run check` must be fully green before going further — it verifies that sources and tests typecheck, the behaviour tests pass, and the 170-command catalog lines up with the C++ registry entry by entry. Then register it as a DSH bundle. `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch: ./cordis.patch.yml`, and that file does one thing: ```yaml - insert: - id: unreal-agentlink name: dsh-unreal-agentlink ``` > **Configuration layering**: a later layer **replaces** that row's `config` wholesale rather than deep-merging it. To override anything, rewrite every key you want to keep. DSH ships no command that installs a local, out-of-tree plugin, so this repository ships an installer that does the job and then defers to the real one: ```bash npm run status:dsh -- --profile web # what is registered right now (same script, npm passthrough) node scripts/install-dsh-plugin.mjs --profile web # mirror, edit the manifest, install, verify ``` It refuses to touch a manifest a running DSH still holds, and proves the layer is composed before reporting success: `dsh --profile --dump-config` must contain `# == dsh-unreal-agentlink`, except on `desktop`, which the CLI will not compose — there the layer is proven through `dsh plugin --profile desktop list`, which reads the same package graph. The declared peer ranges cover both the version this plugin is built against and the `0.2.x` line the current dsh ships from, so the peer-dependency guard does not stop a normal install; if a future runtime falls outside them, dsh prints the exact command to accept the risk — **that decision is yours, not the script's**. Two more paths, both written out: the [manual install](#manual-install-without-the-script) below, and [INSTALL-ai.md](docs/INSTALL-ai.md) — a version an AI agent can read and follow step by step. ### Step 3 — open the project and verify Open the UE project, then have the agent call `ual_status` and check three fields: ``` listening: true url: ws://127.0.0.1:17860 editors: [ { sessionId: "ue-xxxxxxxx", project: "MyProject", ... } ] ``` - `listening: false` → the plugin did not start, or the port is taken. Look for `EADDRINUSE` in the DSH log. - `listening: true` but `editors: []` → the bridge is waiting. Confirm the UE project is open and UnrealAgentLink is enabled. For the **first instant** after an editor connects its record has only `sessionId` / `connectedAt` / `lastSeenAt` / `heartbeats` / `stale`; fields like `project` appear only once the editor pushes `project.info`. That is a normal state, not an error. Then try a pure read with no side effects: ``` ual_call { method: "level.get_current" } ``` **The full walkthrough — workflows, reading failures, troubleshooting — is in the [tutorial](docs/01-tutorial.md).** --- ## Requirements | Item | Requirement | |---|---| | Unreal Engine | 5.0 – 5.8 | | UnrealAgentLink | the C++ plugin itself, dropped into your project's `Plugins/` | | Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | | DSH runtime | this plugin installed as a bundle | ### You do not need UEBox The UEBox desktop app is **not a dependency**. It is another client from the same vendor that happens to use port 17860 too, so running both at once is a port conflict — that is the whole relationship. The evidence: - `UnrealAgentLink.uplugin:25-34` declares exactly two dependencies, both engine-shipped: `IKRig` and `PythonScriptPlugin`. No uebox module. - Every entry in `UnrealAgentLink.Build.cs` is an engine module (UnrealEd / AssetRegistry / MovieScene / Landscape …). No uebox SDK. - The string `uebox` appears three times in the entire source, all of them `// Copyright uebox.ai` headers. - Nothing in the source calls uebox.ai. The only `FHttpModule` use reads the local machine's proxy settings (`UAL_ProxyDiagnostics.cpp:167`). Once the plugin is in your project it runs on its own: `StartupModule` unconditionally calls `Init("ws://127.0.0.1:17860")` (`Core/UnrealAgentLink.cpp:86-97`), pushes `project.info` the moment it connects, and has no handshake, token, or authentication. > To move the port: `-UALServer=ws://127.0.0.1:17861` on the editor side, and the `port` setting on this side. ### Manual install without the script The script above is a convenience; the underlying mechanism is four lines of manifest plus one product command. Where `` is `web` — `desktop` works too, with the one substitution noted at the end of this section — and `$DSH_HOME` is `~/.dsh` by default: ```bash # 1. build once, then copy only what npm pack ships npm run build cp -r lib cordis.patch.yml package.json LICENSE README.md \ "$DSH_HOME/profiles//.vendor/" # 2. register the dependency and the bundle layer (both are required) "$DSH_HOME/profiles//package.json" # add the two entries shown below # 3. let the real installer run dsh plugin --profile install # 4. prove the layer is composed dsh --profile --dump-config | grep -A2 '# == dsh-unreal-agentlink' ``` Step 4 is the one step `desktop` cannot run: the CLI refuses to boot that profile from the command line, so prove it with `dsh plugin --profile desktop list` instead (see below). The two entries, in `/package.json`: ```json "dependencies": { "dsh-unreal-agentlink": "file:C:/Users/you/.dsh/profiles/web/.vendor" }, "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-unreal-agentlink"] } } ``` Both are mandatory and they fail differently: a listed package that declares no `dsh.bundle` fails **loud** at boot, while an installed package that is not listed contributes **no layer a

plugins.description: A transparent always-on-top desktop pet for DSH on Linux (X11 / XWayland)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet-desktop-linux

[**English**](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A desktop pet for DSH (DeepSeek Harness) on Linux: a small transparent,
always-on-top GTK3 window that floats over your desktop and animates according to
what your DSH sessions are doing — idle, working, waiting for an answer, failed,
or finished and awaiting review. It is not click-through: the window keeps its
input region, so clicks on the pet land on the pet.

**Platform: Linux with X11 or XWayland only.** Windows, macOS and native Wayland
(no XWayland) are not supported. See [Requirements](#requirements).

![The pet floating transparently over the desktop](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-1.png)

The window has no background and no border — the wallpaper shows through, and the
pet stays on top of ordinary windows. The sprite follows your DSH sessions:

![Idle, working, waiting, failed and review poses](assets/screenshots/desktop-pet-linux-2.png)

> **Canonical copy:** this plugin is only published as
> `dsh-pet-desktop-linux` (no scope) under the `Wlaeg` account. Any other
> package with this name is not ours.

---

## This is not a meta-package

This plugin ships **its own working program**; it is not a bundle that only
re-exports somebody else's dependency list:

| Part | File | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop program | `desktop/pet.py` | The pet window itself: GTK3 transparent window, spritesheet animation, right-click menu, work-status dialog |
| Host half | `lib/index.js` | Probes system dependencies, spawns/stops the Python program, exposes the HTTP routes, reads and writes the config file |
| Browser half | `client.js` | The **Desktop Pet** panel in DSH Settings, with the packaged `locale/{en,zh}.json` manifest strings |

The single dependency, `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet`, is used **only to read the pet
sprite sheets**. This plugin deliberately does not copy that artwork into its own
repository: store rules require a bundle's dependencies to resolve to the original
author's published package, so this plugin depends on the upstream npm package
and resolves the artwork path at runtime
(`require.resolve('@michengai/dsh-codex-pet/package.json')`). See
[Artwork and licensing](#artwork-and-licensing).

The upstream plugin draws a pet **inside the DSH web page**. This plugin draws a
**separate always-on-top desktop window** that works while the page is in the
background, minimized, or closed. They are different things, not duplicates.

---

## Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Platform | **Linux with X11 or XWayland.** Verified on Manjaro GNOME (Wayland session, pet runs through XWayland) |
| DSH | Any DSH build with the Cordis plugin system that provides `webServer` and the `settings.section` slot |
| Node | **>= 22** (DSH's own requirement) |
| Desktop session | A GTK3-capable session. Under GNOME/Wayland the pet is an XWayland client — a **pure Wayland session with XWayland disabled will not work** |
| npm dependencies | `@michengai/dsh-codex-pet` (artwork lookup only) |

### System packages

The Settings panel probes five of these — Python 3, PyGObject, GTK3, GdkPixbuf
and `xdotool` — and shows the matching install hint for your distribution when
one is missing. The other two rows (the WebP loader and `zstd`) are not probed;
check them yourself with the commands below if the pet starts but looks wrong.

| Component | Arch / Manjaro | Debian / Ubuntu | Fedora |
|---|---|---|---|
| Python 3 | `python` | `python3` | `python3` |
| Python 3 + PyGObject (`import gi`) | `python-gobject` | `python3-gi` | `python3-gobject` |
| GTK3 typelib | `gtk3` | `gir1.2-gtk-3.0` | `gtk3` |
| GdkPixbuf typelib | `gdk-pixbuf2` | `gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0` | `gdk-pixbuf2` |
| WebP loader for GdkPixbuf | *(built into `gdk-pixbuf2`)* | `webp-pixbuf-loader` | `webp-pixbuf-loader` |
| `zstd` CLI *(only if Python < 3.14)* | `zstd` | `zstd` | `zstd` |
| xdotool | `xdotool` | `xdotool` | `xdotool` |

```sh
# Arch / Manjaro
sudo pacman -S python python-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 zstd xdotool

# Debian / Ubuntu
sudo apt install python3 python3-gi gir1.2-gtk-3.0 gir1.2-gdkpixbuf-2.0 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool

# Fedora
sudo dnf install python3 python3-gobject gtk3 gdk-pixbuf2 webp-pixbuf-loader zstd xdotool
```

The session event files are zstd-compressed. Python 3.14 and newer decode them
with the standard library (`compression.zstd`); on older interpreters the plugin
falls back to the `zstd` command-line tool, so install `zstd` if your `python3`
is older than 3.14. Without either, the pet still runs but never leaves `idle`.

The sprite sheets are WebP files, so GdkPixbuf must be able to decode WebP.
Depending on your distribution's GdkPixbuf version this may need the separate
`webp-pixbuf-loader` package (Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora). You can check yours with
the command below; if it prints `False`, install the loader package:

```sh
python3 -c "import gi; gi.require_version('GdkPixbuf','2.0'); \
from gi.repository import GdkPixbuf; \
print('webp' in [f.get_name() for f in GdkPixbuf.Pixbuf.get_formats()])"
```

The plugin's dependency probe checks GTK3, GdkPixbuf and `xdotool` by name but
does not decode a WebP sprite itself; if the loader is missing, the pet window
appears and the sprite fails to load, which shows up in the log tail.

`xdotool` is used for the two EWMH window hints GTK3 cannot set by itself:
`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE` (keep above) and `_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY` (show on every
workspace). Without it the pet still appears, but it will not stay on top of
other windows or follow you across workspaces.

Decoding goes through `GdkPixbuf.PixbufLoader` and frames are drawn as
`Gtk.Image` pixbufs, so **Pillow is not needed**, and because no drawing goes
through a `cairo.Context`, **pycairo is not needed either**.

---

## Installation

This is a DSH Cordis plugin **bundle**. Install it through DSH's plugin manager
(`plugin_manager`, action `install_bundle`), pointing `target` at either:

- the **Git repository** — `https://github.com/Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux`
- or a **local checkout** — the absolute path to this directory

Equivalently, from a DSH shell:

```sh
# once published to npm
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# straight from the repository
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Wlaeg/dsh-pet-desktop-linux

# from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-pet-desktop-linux
```

The bundle declares its own patch in `package.json`:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" },
    "client": {
      "platform": "web",
      "immediately": true,
      "inject": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer"]
    }
  },
  "icon": "./assets/icon.png"
}
```

(`dsh.client.inject` is a client-module **load-order** declaration: DSH loads the
listed packages' browser bundles before this one. It is not Cordis service
injection. The browser half declares the services it actually needs itself:
`return { inject: ['slots', 'locale'], apply }`.)

and that patch is a single `insert` that mounts the host half:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-pet-desktop-linux
      name: 'dsh-pet-desktop-linux'
      config: {}
```

The browser half is declared by `dsh.client` and bound to the row whose `name` is
the bare package name — subpath rows do not carry a browser half.

After installing, reload the DSH Web UI page so the browser half registers its
Settings panel. Nothing else is required: **DSH starts the pet window by itself**
as soon as it boots (`autostart` defaults to `true` — see “Configuration”). The
pet process stops when you stop it or uninstall the bundle.

> Replacing an already-installed copy (for example after editing the source)
> needs a restart of the DSH host process — the running process keeps the JS
> module generation it loaded at startup. A page reload is not enough.

---

## Features

**Window**

- Borderless, transparent GTK3 window — only the pet is visible, the window
  background is fully transparent
- Always on top (`_NET_WM_STATE_ABOVE`), so it stays above normal windows
- Sticky across workspaces (`_NET_WM_STATE_STICKY`, via `xdotool`) — no API for
  this exists in GT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-composer-launcher

**One "+" panel for compositions, plugins and MCP.**

> ⚠️ **DSH 1.5 only** (`>=0.1.5-rc.2 <0.2.0`). Newer DSH releases will be supported in follow-up updates.

> 🟢 **Collision risk: very low.** This is a **pure UI plugin with no server-side seam at all** — it never rewrites requests, tool results or the system prompt, so the "functional collision" layer does not apply. All **four** client slots it takes are `list` / `keyed`, never `chain`. See [Compatibility](#compatibility).

**English** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-1.5-4c6ef5.svg)](#compatibility)
[![Host](https://img.shields.io/badge/host-desktop%20%7C%20web-2f9e44.svg)](#compatibility)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-lightgrey.svg)](#compatibility)

**The composer's `+` button, turned into a real menu.**

---

## Table of contents

- [What this is](#what-this-is)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [The browser extension](#the-browser-extension)
- [Settings](#settings)
- [HTTP routes](#http-routes)
- [Interface language](#interface-language)
- [🔗 Integration](#-integration)
- [Known limitations (stated plainly)](#known-limitations-stated-plainly)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Compatibility](#compatibility)
- [FAQ](#faq)
- [Repository layout](#repository-layout)
- [Self-check](#self-check)
- [License](#license)

---

## What this is

By default the `+` button left of the composer opens a file picker. Everything else you may want to point the model at — a browser tab you are looking at, an earlier conversation, a skill, an MCP server, one of the plugins installed on this machine — has to be typed by hand, or referenced with `@`.

`dsh-composer-launcher` replaces that button with a **three-group menu**:

| Group | What is in it |
|---|---|
| **Add** | files and folders, earlier chats, plan mode, goal mode |
| **Capabilities** | slash commands, skills, MCP servers |
| **Common plugins** | one row per installed plugin, plus an "all plugins" row |

What you pick does not get pasted in as text. It becomes a **reference chip** on a rail above the input box — the same native chip kind the host already renders for `@` references — and only turns into message text when you actually send.

There is also an **optional browser extension** (`DSH Tab Bridge`) which pushes your real browser's tabs to the plugin over a loopback HTTP bridge, so the Tabs row lists the pages you genuinely have open rather than a throwaway debug instance.

---

## What it does

### 1. The `+` menu (three groups)

A 360px panel, opened from the button at the `conversation.input.left` slot.

- **Add** — *Files and folders* (the host's own picker, multi-select, drag-and-drop; falls back to `@` references when the host exposes no folder picker), *Chats* (via `remote.sessionReferenceResolver`; chats only, no files), *Plan*, *Goal*.
- **Capabilities** — *Commands* (whatever the host's slash-command service offers), *Skills* (read live with `ctx.remote.skills.list({ sessionId })`), *MCP* (needs the host's `remote.mcpManager`).
- **Common plugins** — one row per plugin returned by `ctx.remote.pluginInventory.list()`. That list is read from the host on every load, so installing, removing or disabling a plugin is reflected immediately and there is no cache to keep in sync. Three modes decide which rows appear: `pinned`, `frequent`, `mixed` (see [Settings](#settings)).

Every row can be switched off individually from the settings card.

### 2. Reference chips

Picked items land on a rail **above** the input box (`conversation.input.dock`). A chip is `{ label, kind, icon }` plus an optional `url`, where `kind` is one of `web`, `plugin`, `skill`, `mcp`. Clicking the `×` removes it.

Two properties are worth naming, because both were bugs before they were features:

- **A web chip keeps its address.** A page title with no URL is useless to whoever reads the message — the chip carries the URL and the payload includes it.
- **A session reference stays a chip.** Writing a reference back through the plain-text draft API silently downgrades it to body text; the plugin renders it as a chip instead and never round-trips it through the text editor.

Chips are **per session**, so two chat tabs never share a rail.

On send, each chip is serialised into the message with a short marker, so the model can tell a referenced page from an attached file:

| Chip kind | Marker |
|---|---|
| web page | `【参考网页】<title> — <url>` |
| plugin | `【使用插件】<name>` |
| skill | `【技能】<name>` |
| MCP server | `【MCP】<name>` |

> These markers are literal and stay in Chinese in both interface languages. They are part of the text the **model** reads, not interface copy — translating them would change what the model sees.

### 3. Settings card

Registered on the `settings.plugin.item` slot as a card titled **Launcher** — 「启动器」 in the Chinese interface. It is collapsed the first time you open it and remembers that choice. All twelve fields are listed under [Settings](#settings).

### 4. Debug browser (fallback)

The Tabs row can also read tabs over a remote-debugging port from a Chromium process it starts itself. That is what **Launch debug browser** does — and when the extension is staged, the same call attaches it with `--load-extension` and then verifies through the debugging port that it really mounted, so this route needs no manual step at all (see [The browser extension](#the-browser-extension)). It stays a fallback rather than the primary path because it only ever sees that one throwaway-profile instance, never the browser you already have open.

### 5. Loopback bridge

The host half owns a small HTTP bridge on `127.0.0.1:43130` (override: `DSH_LAUNCHER_BRIDGE_PORT`) so the extension can push tabs into it. It binds loopback only, yields politely if an older instance already holds the port, and is used for nothing else.

---

## Screenshots

**The `+` menu — Add / Capabilities / Common plugins — with the Tabs row fed by the extension**

![The composer + menu with the Tabs group and the connected extension](screenshots/01-composer-menu-tab-bridge.png)

**The Tabs row reading a real Microsoft Edge window over the bridge**

![Tab list pushed from Microsoft Edge](screenshots/02-tab-list-edge.png)

**The MCP servers the Capabilities group can reference — the row is built from the host's `remote.mcpManager`**

![MCP servers listed by the host](screenshots/03-mcp-servers.png)

**The plugin inventory the Common plugins group is built from, including its "N / M" narrowing counter**

![Plugin inventory with composition filtering](screenshots/04-plugin-inventory.png)

---

## The browser extension

The plugin works without it — the Tabs row simply says the extension is not installed and points at the button. With it, the row lists the tabs of your **everyday browser**.

### Three ways to get it loaded

Chromium will not let anything silently sideload an extension into the browser you use every day. That is a browser security rule with no plugin-side workaround, so the goal is a different one: make every *remaining* step either automatic or one click.

| Route | What happens | Manual steps |
|---|---|---|
| **A — a browser this plugin starts** | The plugin spawns a separate Chromium process with `--load-extension` pointing at the staged copy, then **verifies through the debugging port that the extension really mounted** | none |
| **B — your everyday browser** | The Tabs row offers *Open the extensions page* and *Copy the extension path*, so loading it once is a paste and a "Load unpacked" | one time, ~20 seconds |
| **C — managed machines** | Chromium enterprise policy (`ExtensionSettings` / `ExtensionInstallForcelist`) pointing at a self-hosted, signed CRX plus an HTTPS update manifest | admin rights; **not shipped here** |

**Route A is verified, not assumed.** After launching, the plugin asks the debugging port for its raw target list and looks for *this* extension's own worker (`chrome-extension://<id>/background.js`) rather than "some extensio

plugins.description: 给 DSH 里助手回复加气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质；工具条、过程行、统计行等周边信息也能一起同步
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-assistant-bubble [![Awesome DSH Plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) 使用皮肤插件从wallpaper里导入深色壁纸时，会发现ai回复的文字是无背景的，导致字和壁纸糊在一起无法阅读。所以让大肥鱼单独写了一个小插件实现气泡功能。 这下可以愉快地使用壁纸了。 . 有一些气泡间距的小问题，可能对观感有小影响，但是不太好修，所以就放在那里了， 插件开启前 开启后。气泡透明度之类的可以自己调，单独在设置里开了“助手回复气泡”的分区页。 ————以下内容都是肥鱼写的 给 DSH 里**助手回复**加一层自己的气泡底，可选液态玻璃材质；工具条、过程行、统计行等周边信息也能一起同步。 ## 为什么需要它 DSH 官方会话界面里，气泡（`..._bubble`）只属于**你发送的消息**；助手回复是一段**没有背景**的正文， 直接压在壁纸上。所以壁纸 / 皮肤类插件的"气泡不透明度""玻璃透明度"都管不到助手回复 —— 深色壁纸下助手的字就看不清了。这个插件补的就是这一块。 ## 功能 - **助手回复气泡**：圆角 + 可调底色；可选液态玻璃（白釉高光 + 模糊 + 厚玻璃折射 + 落地阴影）。 - **周边信息同步**：工具条（复制 / 点赞 / 分享 / 用量 / 时间）、过程折叠行、过程分组头（运行中）、 思考触发条、会话统计行、上下文占用环、运行行 —— 同一份材质、同一组参数，滑块一动一起变。 - **只给"真的有内容"的元素画底**：每个锚点都先核对有没有看得见的文字（≥2 个字）或可见的按钮 / 图标， 空壳一律不画 —— 所以不会出现"只有底色、没有文字"的空白气泡。 - **「工作步骤展示」明细行**：工具调用行（「运行命令」「网页获取」等）与「思考」行也有气泡 —— **折叠**时是紧凑小胶囊、**展开**时保持宿主原本的大横条。 - **非会话页面也有底**：「插件」「自动化任务」「技能中心」「上下文洞察」这些独立页面在皮肤下同样能看清文字 —— 用一条**通用规则**覆盖所有注册到主内容槽的页面（含第三方），并排除会话槽，所以聊天区仍是"气泡浮在壁纸上"。 设置页里有一个**可展开的分组**，可以单独开关、单独调浓度。 - **操作条常驻**：取消宿主"非最后一条要悬停才显示"的门控。 - **宽度跟随内容**：气泡不拉满整行。 - **宽表格收进气泡**：宿主原本让宽表格按滚动容器整屏出血，这里改为气泡内横向滚动。 - **无障碍**：系统开启「减少透明度」时自动去掉模糊与白釉。 ## 非会话页面 皮肤把 AppFrame 的背景令牌弄透明后，独立页面的文字会直接压在壁纸上。插件用一条通用规则给这些页面的内容根铺底， 并在设置里给了独立开关与浓度： ![非会话页面铺底（插件页示例）](docs/assets/non-chat-pages.png) 设置 → 助手回复气泡 → 最下方那个**可折叠分组**（折叠时只有一行字，展开后是开关 + 滑块）： ![设置里的「非会话页面底色」](docs/assets/page-setting.png) ## 安装 **目前最省事的方式：在 dsh-market（插件市场）里搜 `Assistant bubble` 或作者 `yutianliang`，点一下安装。** 或者直接从 GitHub 装（最新 `main`）： ```bash # 从 GitHub 安装（最新 main） dsh plugin --profile web add github:yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble ``` 官方桌面端也可以走侧边栏 **插件** 页 → 添加插件 → 填 `github:yutianliang/dsh-assistant-bubble`。 本地改代码时用 `link:`：`dsh plugin --profile web add link:E:\path\to\dsh-assistant-bubble`。 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-assistant-bubble`。 ## 设置 安装后，**设置 →「助手回复气泡」**（独立分区，10 个控件）： | 控件 | 作用 | 默认 | | --- | --- | --- | | 液态玻璃 | 白釉高光 + 模糊 + 厚玻璃折射；关掉 = 平实心气泡 | 开 | | 周边信息同步 | 上面那七处周边信息是否同材质 | 开 | | 气泡不透明度 | 关闭液态玻璃时的底色浓度 | 60% | | 玻璃底色浓度 | 玻璃挡下的底色浓度，越高越不透 | 50% | | 雾化 | 玻璃的模糊半径 | 3px | | 玻璃颜色 | 6 个预设色块 + 取色器自定义 | #ffffff（深色 #12141a） | | 白釉强度 | 表面高光与边缘折射强度，0–200% | 100% | | 深色单独设置 | 打开后深色主题用另一套上面四项 | 关 | | 非会话页面底色 | 给「插件」「自动化任务」「技能中心」「上下文洞察」等独立页面铺底（可展开分组） | 开 | | 页面底色浓度 | 独立页面的底色浓度，只影响非会话页面 | 60% | 值保存在浏览器本地 `localStorage["dsh-assistant-bubble:settings"]`（清缓存会回默认值）。 ## 兼容性 - **不声明 `engines` / `peerDependencies`**：安装与启用不会被版本检查拦下。 - 客户端半区**不声明** `dsh.client.inject`：模块无条件加载，气泡样式一定生效； `slots` / `locale` 两个服务用 `ctx.inject` 运行时等待，拿不到只丢设置页。 - 唯一外部依赖是宿主写在 DOM 上的语义属性与 CSS-Module 类名后缀。宿主大版本更新后最坏的情况是 **样式静默失效**（看起来像没装），不会报错、不会牵连其它插件。 ## 实现要点 所有参数走 CSS 变量，设置页把值内联写到 `body` 上： ``` --dab-solid-alpha 实心气泡底浓度 --dab-glass-alpha 玻璃挡底浓度 --dab-glass-color 玻璃色（r, g, b） --dab-blur 雾化半径 --dab-sheen 白釉强度倍数 ``` 玻璃配方对齐 [`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) 的玻璃面： 白釉渐变 + `blur() saturate(1.3) brightness(1.04)` + 双向内阴影折射 + 落地阴影。 ### 思考面板的标题行 展开「思考」时，宿主会给面板内部的**粘性标题行**铺一层实心底色（`--dsw-alias-bg-base`，深色主题下近黑， 展开后就是压在内容上的一条黑带）。这里把它换成**同一颜色的半透明版**并保留吸顶： ```css background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dsw-alias-bg-base) 80%, transparent) ``` 滚到顶部时仍能遮住下方内容，但不再是一条实心黑条。（不用 `backdrop-filter`：那会把下方的浅色文字 糊成一条白带。） ### 挂在哪些锚点上 | 位置 | 锚点 | | --- | --- | | 助手回复正文 | `[data-chat-flow-kind="assistant-step"] div[class*="_root"] > div[class*="_body"]` | | 工具条（复制 / 点赞 / 用量 / 时间） | `[data-turn-tail] [class*="_actions"]` | | 过程折叠行「已完成，用时 N 秒」 | `[data-turn-process]` | | 过程分组头「正在分析请求 · ⋯」 | `[data-process-activity]` | | 思考触发条 | `[data-turn-trigger]` | | 工具调用行（运行命令 / 网页获取…） | `[data-tool] [data-disclosure-row]` | | 「思考」行 | `[data-variant="think"] [data-disclosure-row]` | | 会话统计行「N 轮 M 步 · tok/s」 | `[data-composer-stats]` | | 上下文占用环「41%」 | `button[class*="_trigger"]:has(> svg[viewBox="0 0 14 14"])` | | 运行行「深度求索中⋯」 | `[data-chat-running]` | | 宽表格 | `.md-table-wide` | ## 开发 实现细节、设计取舍与踩过的坑见 [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)。 ## License MIT

# dsh-ruliu

把**百度如流（InfoFlow）**接到 DeepSeek Harness：在如流里给机器人发消息就能驱动 DSH 会话，DSH 的回复自动回推到如流。

- 入站：如流开放平台的**回调（webhook）模式**，注册一个 HTTP 路由接收消息
- 出站：assistant 的文本回复发回单聊/群聊（群聊带引用回复）
- 交互：斜杠命令（`/new` `/list` `/use` `/end` `/status`），命令优先于对话
- 审批与选项：工具审批和 `ask_user_question` 会**同时**推到如流和 Web 页面，回 `/1` `/2` … 即可
- 常用 DSH 命令也能在如流里发：`/permission`（看 / 切权限）、`/compact`（压上下文）
- 零额外依赖：只用 `node:crypto` + 全局 `fetch`，不需要装官方 SDK

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-ruliu
```

bundle 默认 `enabled: false`（不会自己启动）。启用要在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖配置 —— 见下。

## 配置

安装并重新加载 DSH 后，在 Web UI 的 **设置 → 如流** 里填四项：**AppKey、AppSecret**（如流发给你的应用凭证）
以及 **checkToken、AESKey**（如流后台「接收消息服务器」里的两个值）。回调地址与注册由插件负责，
点一次「注册回调到如流」即可。

> **为什么不默认自动生成 Token/AESKey**：官方 SDK 的 `updateCallbackUrl` 确实接受调用方生成的
> token / encodingAesKey，但实测在**如流后台已经配过「接收消息服务器」的机器人**上，接口带过去的
> 新 AESKey 不一定被消息管道采用 —— 表现是如流推来的消息解不开（webhook 回 `500 decryption failed`），
> 而接口不回显落库内容、也没法查询，出问题时很难发现。所以自动生成改成显式开关
> `autoRegisterCallback`（默认 `false`，在设置页「高级设置」里）：只有明确知道这个机器人的密钥
> 由插件管理时才打开。解密失败时插件会往已知如流会话发一条告警（出站不依赖 AESKey，还发得出去），
> 不会让你只看到「发消息没反应」。

如果当前 DSH 是已经运行的旧版本，安装新版本后需要让插件重新加载一次；本地 link 开发环境还需要加载仓库里的 settings companion。正常从新版本安装时，客户端设置页面随插件一起加载。

> **两份客户端产物必须同源**：`lib/client.js`（`package.json` 的 `./client`）和
> `ui/lib/client.js`（link 环境下按 `ui/index.mjs` 单独挂的 companion）都由
> `client/settings.cjs` 生成，`npm run build` 会同时写两份，测试里也断言两者字节一致。
> 只更新其中一份会出现「宿主发的是新版、页面渲染的是旧版」—— 改设置页却看不到效果，
> 实测踩过一次。

首次安装或无法使用图形设置页时，也可以把 [配置模板](examples/cordis.patch.yml) 合并到 `${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`，但个人凭证不要提交到 GitHub。

找到下面这段，把尖括号里的内容替换成你自己的值：

```yaml
- id: dsh-ruliu
  config:
    enabled: true
    appKey: '<这里填如流开放平台的 AppKey>'
    appSecret: '<这里填如流开放平台的 AppSecret>'
    agentId: 123456                 # 机器人 Agent ID，只填数字；不需要可以留空
    checkToken: '<如流后台「接收消息服务器」里的 Token>'
    encodingAESKey: '<同一个页面里的 EncodingAESKey，22 位>'
    autoRegisterCallback: false      # true 时上面两项可留空，由插件生成并注册（见上文风险）
    apiHost: 'https://api.im.baidu.com'
    webhookPath: '/dsh-ruliu/webhook'
    publicCallbackUrl: ''           # 留空 = 按浏览器地址/本机内网地址推导
    cwd: '/path/to/your/workspace'
    msgType: 'text'
```

必填四项：

| 配置项 | 填什么 | 从哪里获取 |
|---|---|---|
| `appKey` | 如流应用 AppKey | 如流开放平台的应用详情页 |
| `appSecret` | 如流应用 AppSecret | 同一个应用详情页；插件会自动计算接口所需的 md5，不要手动加密 |
| `checkToken` | 回调校验 Token | 如流后台「接收消息服务器」 |
| `encodingAESKey` | 消息加密 AES Key（22 位 Base64URLSafe） | 同一个页面 |

`appKey` / `appSecret` 是如流**发给你的**应用凭证（用来换 `app_access_token` 发消息）；
`checkToken` / `encodingAESKey` 是回调模式下的**双方约定值** —— 如流推送事件时用它们签名、
加密，所以插件和后台必须一致。不要把真实值提交到 GitHub。

其余都可选：

| 字段 | 必需 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `agentId` | 可选 | 机器人 ID。留空时发消息不带 `agentid` 字段，只影响部分需要它的接口 |
| `autoRegisterCallback` | 可选 | 默认 `false`；`true` 时缺 token/AESKey 就由插件生成并调 `updateReCallUrl` 注册（风险见上） |
| `apiHost` | 可选 | 默认 `https://api.im.baidu.com`；百度内网机器通常使用 `http://apiin.im.baidu.com` |
| `webhookPath` | 可选 | 默认 `/dsh-ruliu/webhook`，要和如流后台填的一致 |
| `publicCallbackUrl` | 可选 | 如流服务器能访问到的**完整**回调地址，例如 `http://10.206.116.22:8080/dsh-ruliu/webhook`；留空则按「浏览器 origin → `DSH_WEB_URL` → 本机内网 IPv4」推导 |
| `cwd` | 可选 | 新建 DSH 会话的工作目录，改成 DSH 实际运行的目录 |
| `msgType` | 可选 | 出站消息类型，`text`（默认）或 `md` |

**机器地址**：如流后台「接收消息服务器」里的回调 URL 必须是**如流服务器能访问到的**地址：

```text
http://<机器内网IP>:8080/dsh-ruliu/webhook
```

例如 DSH 机器内网 IP 是 `10.10.20.35`，就填 `http://10.10.20.35:8080/dsh-ruliu/webhook`。
不能填 `127.0.0.1` 或 `localhost`；DSH 不监听 8080 时换成实际端口。

这一段**不用手工去如流后台填**：设置页点「注册回调到如流」就会把地址 + Token + AESKey 一起
写进机器人后台；打开 `autoRegisterCallback` 时，首次挂载也会自动注册一次。地址推导顺序是
`publicCallbackUrl` → 浏览器 origin → `DSH_WEB_URL` → 探测到的本机内网 IPv4，跳回环和 docker0
之类的虚拟网卡。推导不出来时，在设置页「高级设置 → 对外回调地址」里显式填一个。

如流会先发一次 `echostr` 校验（插件按 `md5(rn + timestamp + checkToken)` 验签并原样回显），通过后才开始推消息。

## 行为

- **会话映射**：一个如流会话（单聊对端 / 群）↔ 一个 DSH 会话，映射存在 `<profile>/.dsh-ruliu/sessions.json`。首次收到消息时用 `ctx.agents.create()` 建会话，之后复用。
- **投递**：`agent.followup(createUserMessage({...}))`，即正常的一次用户回合。
- **回推**：订阅 `session/event` 的 `assistant/message`，取文本块拼接后发出（群聊带 `reply.messageid` 做引用回复）。
- **秒回**：回调先回 `200 success` 再异步处理，避免如流重投。
- **去重**：按消息 id 做 5 分钟窗口去重（如流会重投）。
- **大整数精度**：`messageid` 超过 2^53-1，插件从**解密后的 JSON 原文**用正则抠取，不走 `JSON.parse`。
- **审批 / 选项桥**：工具审批和 `ask_user_question` 会同时推到如流与 Web 页面（同一张卡片），
  哪边先答哪边生效。如流侧用 `/1` `/2` …（多问题按顺序 `/1 2`，多选 `/1,3`，无选项直接回文字）。
  只对「由如流驱动的会话」介入，其它会话完全不变。
- **命令桥**：`/permission`、`/compact` 走宿主的 `ctx.commands.execute()`，和网页端是同一套实现；
  白名单之外的 `/xxx` 仍按普通消息交给模型。

## 命令

在如流里直接发（命令优先于对话，都不进模型、不烧 token）：

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/new [提示词]` | 开一个新会话，可带首条提示词 |
| `/list`（别名 `/sessions`） | 列出最近的会话，最多 10 条 |
| `/use <序号>`（`/switch`、`/resume`） | 把本聊天切到 `/list` 里的第 N 个会话 |
| `/end` | 结束当前绑定，下条消息开新会话 |
| `/status` | 看当前绑定的会话与工作目录 |
| `/1` `/2` … | 回答审批或模型提问（有等待项时；多问题按顺序 `/1 2`，多选 `/1,3`，无选项直接回文字） |
| `/permission` | 查看当前权限预设；帮助里会列出本部署实际可切的名字（如 `workspace-write（需要时问审批）` / `danger-full-access（不问审批）`） |
| `/permission <预设>` | 切换权限：沙箱模式 + 审批策略一起换 |
| `/compact` | 压缩当前会话的上下文 |
| `/help`（`/?`） | 显示帮助 |

`/list` 的输出长这样：

```
🗂 **最近的会话**（用 `/use <序号>` 切换）

1. 测试如流与DSH链路
2. 我要做数字人的表情控制，让 ← 当前
3. 8010端口下载文件夹网页
```

**按「最近活跃」排序，不打印时间和活跃标记**：排序口径取自 `sessionController.list()` 的
`updatedAt`（= `max(createdAt, 最后一次用户消息时间)`），和 Web 侧边栏完全一致 —— 所以刚从
如流或 Web 任一侧聊过的会话就会排到第 1 条。该服务不可用时退回本插件自己从 `session/event`
攒的时间戳，再不行才按创建时间。时间和「🟢 活跃」都不打印：IM 是窄屏，这两项会把标题挤到
换行，而「活跃」本来就是排序依据，标出来是冗余信息。

**`← 当前` 标的是本聊天真正绑定的那条会话**：如流这边一个聊天只绑一条会话，而 `/list` 列的是
整个工作区的会话，两者不是一回事。注意只有**用户敲进来的消息**会推进活跃时间（审批、上下文注入
这类事件不算），所以「我刚点了下这个窗口」不一定等于「这个会话变成最近活跃」。绑定会话如果已经
掉出最近 10 条，`/list` 会在末尾补一行「当前绑定的是『标题』」，不会让它凭空消失。

**列表里不打印 `session-<uuid>`**：那是 DSH 的内部实现细节，IM 里的使用者读不出信息量也用不上
—— 切换靠序号。会话 id 只出现在 `<profile>/.dsh-ruliu/log.ndjson` 的 `command-list` /
`command-use` 事件里（`command-list` 还会带上渲染结果的 `preview` 和 `bound`），排查问题时看
日志即可。`/status` 同理，显示的是会话标题而不是 id。

**会话标题**：`/list` 会用 `sessionQuery.readTitleSnapshots()` 给历史会话补标题（软取，
拿不到就显示 `(未命名)`，不影响主流程）。

## 已知限制（v0.1）

- 只有 **webhook 模式**；websocket 模式（官方 SDK，无需公网回调）未实现
- 双路是 race：一边答了之后，另一边的卡片**不会自动收掉**（没有取消 API），会自己超时/关闭；
  过期卡片上再回 `/1` 只会收到一句「已经在另一边答过了」
- 命令桥只接 `/permission` 与 `/compact`，其余 DSH 命令仍需在 Web 页面发
- **不做媒体**：图片/语音/文件消息只记日志并忽略
- 出站只发文本/markdown，不发图片/文件/卡片
- 一个如流会话同一时刻只绑一个 DSH 会话（用 `/use` 切，不能并发）

## 排错

- **回调 403**：`checkToken` 与如流后台不一致。改过 Token 或换过机器后，点一次设置页的
  「注册回调到如流」重新注册。
- **回调 500 / decryption failed**：`encodingAESKey` 与如流后台不一致（注意它是 Base64URLSafe，
  原始 22 位）。插件这时会往已知如流会话发一条告警（10 分钟一次），日志里是 `decrypt-failed`。
- **注册失败**：日志里看 `callback-register` 事件的 `code` / `message`；常见原因是推导出的回调地址
  如流访问不到（填「对外回调地址」），或宿主装了代理导致 `apiin.im.baidu.com` 走代理返回 502
  （把该域名加进代理直连名单）。注册失败不影响 webhook 继续服务，已注册过的机器人照常推消息。
- **回调 400 unsupported content type**：请求没带正确的 `Content-Type`，或后台推的不是这三种形态。
- **发消息失败**：看 `Authorization: Bearer-<token>`（连字符）与 `code:"ok"`（字符串）判定；
  出站走的是宿主进程的 fetch，若 `api.im.baidu.com` 在内网直连而宿主装了代理，
  需要把该域名加进代理的直连名单（`no_proxy` / 插件的 `noProxy`）。
- **插件没挂上**：`enabled: true` 且 `appKey`/`appSecret` 都非空，否则日志会写
  `dsh-ruliu: 凭证不全（需要 appKey + appSecret），通道未挂载`。只缺 token/AESKey 时通道照常挂载，
  日志写 `credentials-missing`，收消息会因为解不开而 500。
- **改完代码不生效**：profile 的 `hmr` 行要把插件目录加进 `config.root`，
  否则模块不会被监听（默认只监听 profile 配置）。改完 HMR 直接换模块，
  **不用重启 dsh**（重启会掐断如流这条线）。

# 避峰岗（dsh-peak-valley-router）

> 峰时站岗换班：谷时让 DeepSeek 干苦力，峰时换 ChatGPT Plus 顶班，你的 API 账单从此不再被高峰期收割。

DeepSeek Harness 的跨 provider 峰谷路由插件 + 公开 SKILL。详见 [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md)。

当前版本：**v0.12.0**（pre-1.0）。版本号唯一来源是 `package.json`；运行时可在设置页标题下方或 `debug.log` 的 `apply: vX.Y.Z, …` 行确认当前加载的是哪一版。变更记录与版本策略见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

## 它做什么

- **设置页「避峰岗」**：配置有序策略。每条策略 = 触发条件（生效星期 + 峰时窗口）+ 主模型（谷时）+ 可选副模型（峰时）。另有**高级思考模型**，它是**另一根轴**：只在会话本身要求 `max` 思考时使用（`reasoningEffort === 'max'`），**不作为未命中策略时的兜底**。未命中任何策略的时刻（周末、假期）→ 用**第一个方案的主模型**。设置页顶部会写明「此刻生效：model@effort · 原因」，例如「无匹配方案（周末/假期），用首个方案的主力模型」，所以任何一次目标都能解释，不会像故障。
- **Provider / 模型一律下拉选择**：候选来自运行时**已注册的全部 provider**——API 与你装的订阅套餐并列（如 DeepSeek、ChatGPT Plus / Codex、Claude、Grok、Copilot、Antigravity），模型经该 provider 的 `listModels` 接口读取。避峰岗自身**不会**出现在候选里：它是 provider 之上的一层选择器逻辑，不是 provider。
- **左侧「启用避峰岗」开关**：默认关闭 = 纯透传，行为与未装插件一致。开启后由避峰岗决定实际调用的模型，**连会话里已经选过的模型也会被改写**（会话自带的模型选择器本身不改动，只做功能接管 + 尽力而为的置灰提示）。
- **每会话独立状态 + 会话列表小灯 + 全局解耦**：
  - **全局 = 总闸**：侧边栏底部那个开关，切换它会对所有「跟随中」的会话一次性生效（扫一遍）。
  - **局部可单独改**：composer 输入区左侧第一个按钮切换**当前会话**；一旦单独改过，该会话就**不再被全局切换带走**（两个方向都是）。
  - **显式的「全局解耦」开关**：composer 左侧第二个按钮。两个圆环相接＝跟随全局，分开＝已解耦；点一下在「解耦 / 接回」之间切换。它**只切换连接关系**，不改变此刻是否生效。右键第一个按钮也能恢复跟随（等价快捷方式）。
  - **会话列表小灯**：每行一个微微发蓝光的小灯，亮 = 该会话此刻生效；已解耦的会多一圈淡环。全局默认开着时每行都会亮（它们跟随默认），只有被单独关掉的会话不亮。
  - **全局侧可见**：侧边栏开关的提示里会显示「· N 个已解耦」。
  - **已知限制**：行首位置由宿主条件渲染，下列四种行**不渲染**该插槽，小灯在这些时刻不显示——归档（archived）、空白（blank）、**正在运行**（显示状态点）、**有未读标记**。依据：`.recon/workspace.client.js` 里 `!row.archived && !row.blank && (showStatus ? … : unread ? … : renderSlot("sidebar.session.row.leading", …))`。这是宿主行为，插件不去改它。
  - 另需注意：小灯反映的是**开关意图**，不是"此刻一定生效"。若策略目标不在 provider 目录里（模型下线/改名），路由会**静默回落到会话原模型**，只在 `debug.log` 留一行——此时小灯仍是亮的。
- **多端可用**：开关同时挂在左侧边栏底部与 composer 输入区左侧。窄屏（<1024px 侧边栏自动收起、Windows/macOS 收起态整列宽度为 0）时由 composer 入口兜底，两个入口共享同一份状态。

```bash
node src/build-client.mjs   # 重建 lib/client.js（改了 src/client 或 lib/text.js 后必跑）
npm run verify              # 五套检查（只读，不写任何产物）
```

未触碰会话模型选择器）、版本一致性（`package.json` ↔ `CHANGELOG.md` ↔ `README.md`/`SKILL.md`
的「当前版本」）、产物新鲜度（**构建到临时文件比对，不重写仓库里的产物**）、仓库顶层文件集合、

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-peak-valley-router
         name: <本仓库/lib/index.js 绝对路径>
         config: { ...见 SKILL.md 的配置结构... }
   ```

装完**重启 DSH**，打开「设置 → 避峰岗」即可在 GUI 里配置多模型协同策略。

## 峰谷规则

- 高峰：北京时间周一至周五（不含法定节假日）09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00
- 谷时：其余时间（含周末、节假日全天），价格为峰时 1/2

## 运行时数据

插件只在 `DSH_HOME/plugins/dsh-peak-valley-router/` 下写三个文件：

- `policy.json` — GUI 保存的策略
- `state.json` — 开关状态：`{ enabled, sessions }`。`enabled` 是**全局默认**，`sessions` 是**每会话覆盖**表（没有覆盖的会话跟随默认；上限 500 条，按最近写入淘汰）。旧文件（只有 `enabled`）行为完全不变。
- `debug.log` — 诊断日志（只在 apply / 目录读取失败 / 开关切换 / 每个新接管目标时各记一行）

## 已知限制

- **跨窗口/多进程不同步**：开关状态在插件加载时读一次，客户端也不轮询。同一台机器上开两个窗口，A 的改动要等 B 重新加载才可见；两个 DSH 进程共用同一个 `DSH_HOME` 时，各自持有自己的快照，后写的一方会覆盖**整张** `sessions` 表（写入是原子的，但没有合并语义）。单窗口单进程使用不受影响。
- **目标模型不在目录里时静默回落**：策略目标（主模型/副模型/高级思考模型）若不在该 provider 当前的模型目录中（下线、改名、订阅登出），路由会保留会话原模型，只在 `debug.log` 记一行。此时开关与小灯仍显示"开"——它们反映的是**开关意图**，不是"此刻一定生效"。
- **配额/限流不归避峰岗管**：它只决定"用哪个 provider/model"。若目标 provider 的账号池处于 429 冷却（如订阅套餐的 5 小时窗口用尽），请求会在 provider 层失败。避峰岗不会自动改道到别的模型——那会让"为什么换模型"变得不可预测；需要时请改配置或暂时关掉开关。
- **行首小灯的显示条件**：见上文「每会话独立状态」一节的四条隐藏条件（宿主行为）。
- **并发点击**：写盘期间开关按钮是禁用的，被丢弃的那次点击不会报错（没有队列）。

plugins.description: DSH 助手人格与长期记忆插件：独立可用，不依赖其它插件。管 AI 自身的名字与角色、对用户的称呼、回复风格与自定义指令；人设支持全局 + 按工作区两级覆盖；长期记忆走三段式（候选捕获 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决才生效），并支持一键导入其它 AI 的历史记忆。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-anima

DSH 的**助手人格与外挂记忆层**——一个独立插件，装上即可用。

它管的是「**你自己（助手）是谁**」：AI 的名字与角色、你对它的称呼、回复风格、
以及你自己写的行为准则；再加一套**带待审缓冲区的长期记忆**，
以及输入框光轨、输入框快捷开关、工具确认门槛这些界面能力。
字段集不依赖任何其它插件，也不从别处读取配置。

> **工具名为什么是 `set_assistant_persona`**：`tools.register()` 遇同层重名直接抛错
> （`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2634`），与生态里任何同名工具共存时必有一方注册失败、
> 被 `.catch` 吞成一行 warn —— 那是发布级的静默故障。功能相似不要求撞名。

---

## 它解决什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **AI 自己的名字与角色** | `agentName` / `agentRole` —— 决定它怎么称呼自己、以什么身份说话 |
| 用户的称呼 / 背景 / 语气 / 长度 / 语言 | `addressUserAs` / `userOccupation` / `userBio` / `style` / `replyLength` / `language` |
| **按工作区两层覆盖** | 只覆盖声明的字段，其余继承全局；覆盖文件随目录走、可 git |
| **长期记忆** | 自动沉淀 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决 → 注入 |
| 输入框光轨 / 快捷开关 / 工具确认 | 界面与安全开关 |
| 人设预设 | 6 条内置 + 自建；也可把当前配置存成预设 |
| **十二个字段全是自由文本** | 存的就是注入的原话，另有「一键填入 + 示例」按钮组 |
| **记忆随工作区分层** | 全局记忆处处生效，工作区记忆只在匹配时注入 |
| **注入可解释 / 字符预算** | 每条为什么进 / 不进，条数与字符双约束 |
| **本地聚类与冲突提示** | 纯本地 bigram 相似度，只提示不自动合并 |
| **人设变更审计日志** | 谁在什么时候把哪个字段改成什么 |
| **一键导入外部 AI 的记忆** | 复制提示词 → 粘贴结果 → 机械切分 → 逐条裁决层级 |
| 长期记忆的「自动写入」 | ❌ 刻意不做（见下） |

### 关于与 `dsh-soul` 的关系

上表左侧的能力划分与 `dsh-soul` 0.7.0 的字段集**有交集**，实现上也刻意与它保持一致
（工具确认语义、光轨动效参数、重置保留预设）。但本插件**不依赖它**：
字段集完整自持，不读它的配置文件，两者可同时安装且标识全部错开。
这层关系的完整说明见下方「[致谢与差异化声明](#致谢与差异化声明)」。

## 四个差异化设计

功能对齐不等于没有自己的判断。以下四点是本插件相对主流记忆插件的**真实增量**，
每一条都对应一个具体的失败模式。

### 1. 双约束注入：条数与字符同时生效

多数实现只有一个「最多注入 N 条」的上限。问题是 40 条长记忆一样能挤爆上下文，
而用户看到的是「我只设了 40 条啊」。

本插件的 `selectForInjection` 同时受 `memory.maxInjected`（条数，默认 40）与
`memory.maxInjectedChars`（字符，默认 4000）约束，**取先到者**。两条上限各有各的适用场景：
条数管「别让模型看太多碎片」，字符管「别让一次注入吃掉半屏上下文」。

### 2. 注入可解释：看得见每条为什么进 / 不进

注入不是黑箱。设置页的「注入情况」列出**每一条已采纳记忆**的去留与原因：

| 原因码 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `included` | 已注入提示词 |
| `other-workspace` | 属于别的工作区，不在本会话注入 |
| `no-workspace-context` | 当前会话没有工作区信息，无法匹配工作区记忆 |
| `workspace-scope-unknown` | 标记为工作区记忆但没记录属于哪个工作区 |
| `over-max` | 已采纳条数超过注入上限，按时间取最新的 |
| `over-budget` | 单条就超出字符预算，取不下 |
| `dropped-by-budget` | 前面几条已占满字符预算 |
| `no-injection` | 记忆层已关闭或上限为 0 |

区分 `over-budget` 与 `dropped-by-budget` 是刻意的：前者要删那条，后者要腾位置 ——
报同一个码，用户不知道该动谁。原因文案由宿主下发（`INJECTION_REASON_TEXT` 只有一份），
客户端不重写翻译。

### 3. 本地聚类：只提示，不自动合并

待审缓冲区里若有多条明显在说同一件事，插件用**字符二元组（bigram）的 Jaccard 系数**
（纯本地、零依赖、零模型调用）算出相似度，把「这 3 条像在说同一件事」摆到用户面前。

**刻意不做自动合并**：合并意味着生成一段用户没说过的话。本插件的立场是
「判断什么值得记交给模型，什么真的生效交给用户」——自动合并恰好违背它。
聚类只让裁决更快，不替他裁决。同理「候选撞上已采纳记忆」只提示冲突，不改任何数据。

### 4. 人设变更审计日志

本插件有三个入口能改人设：设置页、`/anima` 命令、模型调用的 `set_assistant_persona` 工具。
而「工具确认」**默认是关的** —— 也就是说，模型可以直接把你叫它什么、它用什么语气回话改掉，
而你无从知道是谁在什么时候干的。

审计日志只记「改了什么」，不做判断、不参与提示词。它挂在 `StateStore.updateConfig` 这**一个**
收口上，而不是在各调用点分别埋点：所有写入路径最终都走这里，分散埋点迟早会漏掉一条，
而漏掉的那条恰恰可能是模型的静默改写。`resetConfig` 也走审计 —— 否则
「昨天还好好的，今天全空了」在日志里查无此事。

记录上限 200 条，独立成表（不塞进 `config`）：`config` 每次启动整条读入内存，
审计会涨到几百条，混在一起等于让启动开销随使用时长上升。
长值在写入时截断为 200 字并附「共 N 字」，数组/对象只记规模 —— 审计是索引，不是备份。

看到它的地方有两处：设置页「变更记录」卡（完整列表，可按条清空），
以及 `/anima show` 的**「最近变更」一行**——只显示最新那条，格式是
`[MM-DD HH:mm] <来源>：<字段名>`，**刻意不带具体值**：值可能很私人，而 `show`
的输出会被复制到对话里问人。

## 致谢与差异化声明

本插件的功能集**参考**了 [dsh-soul](https://github.com/Aliuyanfeng/dsh-soul)（MIT）与
`dsh-checkpoint-rewind` 的设计，并在若干处刻意与它们保持行为一致（存储惰性解析、
失败关闭的确认语义、重置保留用户预设、光轨动效参数）。

需要明确的是：

- **代码全部独立实现**，未拷贝上述项目的源码、注释、提示词文案或图形资源。
- 两处**动效参数刻意取同值**（8 层错位描边、虚线段长 12 / 步进 2.2 / 圆角 22 等），
  理由是避免同一台机器上出现两套观感。这类数值属于思想与参数，不受著作权保护；
  记在这里是为了不让读者误以为拷贝。
- **导航图标刻意画得不同形**：dsh-soul 用「光轨弧 + 火花」，本插件用「人像（头+肩）+ 火花」，
  单色 `currentColor`，viewBox 也另行收紧。
- **各类标识全部错开**，避免共存时互相顶替或注册失败：

  | 类别 | dsh-soul | 本插件 |
  |---|---|---|
  | 工具名 | `set_persona` | `set_assistant_persona` |
  | 设置页 id | `soul-settings` | `anima-settings` |
  | 光轨槽位 id | `soul-trail` | `anima-trail` |
  | 开关槽位 id | `soul-quick-toggle` | `anima-quick-toggle` |
  | 提示词 section | `soul:persona` | `anima:identity` / `:memory` / `:pending` |
  | 存储域 | —（自有文件） | `anima` |
  | 注入来源 kind | `plugin:dsh-soul` | `plugin:dsh-anima` |

工具名错开不只是礼貌：`dsh-tools` 的 `register()` 遇同层重名**直接抛错**
（`lib/index.js` 的 `NamedEntries` 冲突工厂），两者共存时必有一方注册失败、
并被 `.catch` 吞成一行 warn —— 那是发布级的静默故障。



## 核心设计：三段式记忆

这是本插件与市面上 15+ 记忆插件最不一样的地方。

```
对话中通过 remember 工具投递
        ↓
   待审缓冲区（不生效）
        ↓  每晚自动整理：去重 / 淘汰 / 与已采纳项比对
        ↓
   通知用户「有 N 条待你裁决」
        ↓
   用户在设置页逐个「采纳 / 丢弃 / 删除」
        ↓
   已采纳 → 注入提示词
```

**为什么不做静默自动写入**：记忆一旦静默写入就直接影响后续所有回答，写错了用户很难发现。
本插件把「判断什么值得记」交给模型，把「什么真的生效」交给用户。

整理这一步**纯本地、不调用模型**——只做去重、淘汰、与已采纳项比对，不做语义归纳。

记忆**分两层**：`global` 处处生效，`workspace` 只在 `cwd` 归一化后完全相等时注入。
不做「子目录继承」——工作区覆盖是精确匹配语义，记忆若采用继承语义，
用户在子目录里会看到父目录的记忆，排查起来极难。
分层之外的注入解释、预算与聚类见上文「四个差异化设计」。

## 凭据闸门

任何命中凭据形态的内容**在进入缓冲区之前就被拒收**（不落盘、不留痕），
覆盖私钥块、OpenAI/AWS/GitHub 令牌、通用 api_key / secret / 密码赋值、Bearer、
URL 内嵌凭据等 11 类模式。

理由：内容一旦落盘缓冲区，就处于「等待进入提示词」的状态，凭据不该走这条路。
凭据判定用的是 11 类正则的机械匹配，没有语义理解，会有误判——所以被拦下时界面会
把命中规则名一起说出来，用户可以删掉那串字符再粘贴。

## 一键导入外部 AI 的记忆

设置页记忆卡里有一个「导入外部 AI 的记忆」按钮，展开后是两步：

1. **复制提示词**——把一段整理画像的提示词发给你用得最多的那个 AI，让它把你的偏好
   整理成清单。按钮只在真的写进剪贴板后才显示「已复制」；没有剪贴板 API 时会明说
   「复制失败，请手动选中后复制」，不假装成功。
2. **粘贴结果**——粘贴框接受 AI 的输出，也接受你自己手写的笔记（不要求必须是 AI 生成的）。

解析后逐条预览，每条都能改层级（全局 / 本工作区）或直接丢弃，确认后才写进**待审缓冲区**
——和手动添加、模型投递走同一条路，仍然要用户逐条裁决才生效。

**切分是机械的，不做语义理解**：按 Markdown 标题、列表项、空行三种边界切；刻意不按句号切，
因为中文画像里「偏好：结论先行。」被切成两条会读不通。小节标签（如「我的使用画像」）
不进候选——它长得像记忆但没有可采纳内容。

**归类是建议不是判决**：`suggestLayer` 只看措辞——提到具体磁盘路径或「本项目 / 这个项目」
建议 `workspace`，提到「所有项目 / 一律 / 每次都要」建议 `global`。两条都没有时默认 `global`，
理由是把「记忆动不动就不生效」当默认体验，比跨项目污染更糟。每条建议都带一句理由显示在
条目下方，用户看到「本工作区」就能立刻知道凭什么。

**解析阶段就分流**：一条原文切完后按顺序过五道闸，没通过的会被分别归到不同的桶里，
每一桶都在界面上显示出来，**不静默少一条**：

| 处置 | 判定 | 界面上 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 过短（`< 4` 信息量） | 切出的碎片太短，通常是编号残留 | 只在汇总里报个数 |
| 超长（`> 500` 字） | 单条超过记忆上限 | 不截断，明确告知「请拆成几条」 |
| 凭据 | 命中 11 类正则之一 | 整条拦下并说明命中了哪条规则 |
| 重复 | 与已有记忆文本相同 | 单独列出 |
| 超条数 | 超出单次上限（默认 60 条） | 余下部分不进这一批，另开一次导入 |
| 同义 | 与待审缓冲区里的某条相似度 ≥ 0.6 | 在条目下方提示「已有一条很像」，**不自动合并** |

原文上限 40000 字符，超出直接报错而不是截断（截断等于偷偷丢掉用户画像的后半段）。
同义提示刻意只提示不合并：自动合并会生成一段用户从没说过的话。

---

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

本插件尚未发布到 npm，从仓库直接装：

```
dsh plugin add github:Melody-cx/dsh-anima#v1.0.0
```

或者手工改 profile 的 `package.json`：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-anima": "github:Melody-cx/dsh-anima#v1.0.0"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-anima" ] } }
}
```

`#v1.0.0` 是标签（也可以写 commit SHA，或整个省略以跟随 `main`）。**建议 pin 住一个版本**，
否则上游的任何改动都会在下次安装时直接进入你的 profile。git 源下载的是**整个仓库 tarball**
（本仓库很小），首次安装可能比 npm 源慢一些，超时的话重试一次即可。

然后 `pnpm install`，**重启 DSH**。宿主侧改动一律需要重启才生效。

### 从源码安装（开发用）

在 profile 的 `package.json` 里加依赖（也可以用 `/plugins` 界面）：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-anima": "file:<仓库目录的绝对路径>"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ /* ... */ "dsh-anima" ] } }
}
```

本地 `file:` 依赖是**复制**语义：改完源码要**重新安装**才生效，且重跑安装时若 pnpm 判定
`changed:false` 会直接跳过 —— 正确姿势是先 `remove_bundle` 再 `install_bundle`
（或比对 `node_modules` 副本与源码的 SHA256）。

**运行前提**（`package.json` 里已声明，装不上时先看这几条）：

- `engines.node` = `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`，`engines.dsh` = `>=0.1.6-0 <0.2.0 || >=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0-0`
- `peerDependencies` 四包：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`（`^4.0.1 || ^4.0.5-alpha.1`）、
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`
  —— 它们由宿主提供，插件不打包它们
- `dependencies.zod`（`^4.4.3`）是唯一真正要装的运行时依赖
- 存储栈需在 profile 里组合：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-json`（配 `root`）
  + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain`（配 `backend: json`）。缺了不会崩，但插件会退化成
  「存储不可用」，设置页会明说原因（见下「存储」一节）

## 配置

设置页新增一栏「**灵台**」（`settings.section` id = `anima-settings`，order 51）。

- **助手身份**：`enabled` / `agentName` / `agentRole` / `addressUserAs` / `userOccupation` / `userBio`
- **回复风格**：`style` / `headingLists` / `emoji` / `tables` / `replyLength` / `language` / `customInstructions`
- **工作区覆盖**：`workspaceOverridesEnabled` / `workspaceFileDir`
  覆盖文件默认写在 `<工作区>/.dsh-anima/override.json`（目录名可用 `workspaceFileDir` 改），随目录走、可 git、可拷给别人；
  该目录会自动写入 `.gitignore`（内容 `*`），避免私人语气设定被推到远程。
- **输入框光轨**：`trailEnabled` / `trailColor`（`#RRGGBB`，落盘统一大写）/ `trailSpeed`（`slow|normal|fast`）/ `trailWidth`（`thin|normal|thick`）
- **工具确认**：`requireToolConfirmation` —— 开启后模型调 `set_assistant_persona` 只**提交提议**，不写配置
- **长期记忆**：`memory.enabled` / `autoCapture` / `nightlyTriage` / `nightlyHour` / `maxPending` /
  `maxInjected` / `maxInjectedChars` / `notifyOnSessionStart` / `defaultLayer`

### 不做任何迁移

本插件**不读任何其它插件或自己旧版本的配置**。它是 1.0.0，此前没有发布过任何版本 ——
没有「老用户的介质」这种东西需要兼容，所以代码里既没有一次性迁移，也没有存储格式回退。
这两块曾存在于开发期，都已删除；留着它们的唯一作用是让后人以为有一批需要照顾的存

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-manager

**English** | [中文](README.zh.md)

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager)](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-DeepSeek%20Harness-4f6ef7)](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager)

Archive manager plugin: manage **archived sessions** and **active sessions** of DeepSeek Harness (DSH) in one place.

> **Quick install** (restart DSH afterwards and you are done)
>
> ```bash
> dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
> ```
>
> Other install methods: see [Installation](#installation) | Version downloads: see [Releases](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases)

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has built-in session archiving: archiving a session keeps its data **fully on disk** and merely hides it from the active list. But the built-in archive handling offers only a single filter ("Hide archived / All conversations / Archived only") and **no dedicated place** to review, archive, or clean up sessions in one spot — archived sessions simply pile up on disk.

This plugin fills that gap: it **reuses DSH's native archiving mechanism** and adds a dedicated management UI where "archive" and "delete" sit side by side.

## Features

### Sidebar entry

A new "Archive Manager" icon at the bottom of the sidebar (next to Settings); click it to open the management panel.

### Two-tab panel

The panel has two tabs, and **every session row offers archive-type actions and delete side by side**:

| Tab | Contents | Actions per row |
|---|---|---|
| **Archived** | All archived sessions | [Unarchive] [Delete] |
| **Active sessions** | Currently active sessions | [Archive] [Delete] |

Each entry shows:
- Session title ("Untitled session" when there is no title)
- Session ID (monospace)
- Bound workspace directory (**clickable** — opens directly in the file manager)
- Status badges: `session log` / `cache` / `data missing` / `running`

### Three operations

- **Archive**: calls DSH's native `archiveSession`; the session is hidden from the active list and its **data is kept exactly as is**
- **Unarchive**: calls DSH's native `unarchiveSession`; the session returns to the active list and its **data was never moved**
- **Permanent delete**: removes the session's **session log directory + projection cache** (irreversible)
  - The **bound workspace directory is never deleted** (by design, so your project files cannot be removed by accident)
  - A confirmation dialog guards the operation
  - The archive record is queued and cleaned up automatically by the plugin on the **next DSH start** — no manual step required,
    and after a delete no "empty-data session" will reappear in the active list

### Ghost entry detection

Entries in the archived list whose data was deleted long ago and only an archive record remains are marked "data missing"; deleting such an entry clears that leftover record.

### Agent tools

`archive_list` / `archive_add` / `archive_remove` / `archive_delete`, drivable with natural language.

## Screenshots

The **Archived** tab — every entry offers [Unarchive] and [Delete], and shows the bound workspace directory and on-disk data status:

![Archived sessions](assets/screenshot-2-archived-sessions.en.png)

The **Active sessions** tab — [Archive] and [Delete] side by side:

![Active sessions](assets/screenshot-1-active-sessions.en.png)

## Installation

> Replace `<profile>` in the commands below with your profile name; the DSH desktop app uses `desktop` by default.
> After installing, **restart DSH** and the "Archive Manager" icon appears at the bottom of the sidebar.

### Option 1: Install directly from GitHub (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager
```

DSH pulls the plugin from this repository and installs it into the profile as a bundle. To pin a specific version, add a ref:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager#v0.1.0
```

### Option 2: Download a release and install locally

1. Open the [Releases](https://github.com/Joe-0202/dsh-archive-manager/releases) page,
   download **Source code (zip)** of the latest version and extract it
2. Install using the path of the extracted directory:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<absolute path of the extracted directory>
```

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-archive-manager
```

Uninstalling removes only the plugin itself; it does **not** delete any session data or archive records.

## Usage

1. Click "Archive Manager" at the bottom of the sidebar to open the panel
2. In the "Active sessions" tab, click [Archive] on sessions you no longer need — they are hidden from the active list while their data is kept as is
3. In the "Archived" tab, review all archived sessions
4. Click [Unarchive] when needed to put a session back into the active list
5. For sessions you no longer need, click [Delete] → confirm → permanent delete (irreversible)

## Safety notes

- **Deletion is irreversible**: the session log and projection cache are removed outright, and a confirmation dialog is shown first.
- **The bound workspace directory is never touched**: even if a session is bound to `D:\projects\xxx`, deleting an archived session removes **only session data**;
  your project directory and the files in it are completely unaffected.
- **Archiving itself carries zero risk**: it only writes a marker; no data is moved or copied, and you can unarchive at any time.
- Session data is located by **scanning `$DSH_HOME/sessions/*/` for an exact sessionId match** rather than re-deriving
  the path encoding, which avoids deleting the wrong directory.
- Deletion is idempotent: if the target directory or cache is already gone, it counts as "already deleted" instead of raising an error.

## Implementation notes

- **Source of the archived list**: the runtime projection is preferred (`workspaceController.follow()`'s first-frame baseline carries
  `archivedSessionIds`; the stream is aborted as soon as it is read), with a fallback to the persistent snapshot in
  `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`. The panel therefore reflects the in-memory truth rather than a possibly stale disk copy.
- **Active sessions**: `sessionQuery.listSessions()` (which already excludes archived sessions), plus a defensive de-duplication pass.
- **Session title / cwd**: read from the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`
  (the cache embeds these values in a `{ <key>: { val } }` structure).
- **Session log directory**: `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace encoding>/<sessionId>/`, located by exact-match scanning;
  after deleting a session, if its workspace encoding directory becomes empty, that empty directory is cleaned up as well.
- **Archive / unarchive**: calls DSH's native `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`
  and `unarchiveSession(id)` — the plugin does not implement archiving semantics itself.
- **Removal from the archive set goes through the "pending-cleanup queue" (key design)**: permanent delete has three steps — delete the log, delete the cache, and
  **enqueue** the id, but **does not unarchive at that moment**.
  The reason: `unarchiveSession` means "send this session back to the active list", not "forget this id".
  If you previously opened a session in the archive panel, it stays in the harness's memory; deleting the on-disk data
  and then unarchiving makes the harness put this session — no data, but still in memory — back into the active list,
  where opening it necessarily fails with `session/not-found` — and **only a restart clears it**.
  Once queued, the session stays archived (so it can never appear in the active list) and the plugin runs
  `unarchiveSession` on the **next start** to finish the job — at that moment memory is clean, so unarchiving cannot trigger a ghost.
  Queue file: `$DSH_HOME/storages/archive-manager-pending.json`;
  queued entries are hidden from the panel immedi

# dsh-hermes-panel

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

A [Hermes](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) panel for
[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), in the right sidebar: start and stop the
gateway and dashboard, watch the dashboard beside the chat, and bridge DSH to Hermes.

For the native Hermes agent (`hermes-agent`). Not for `hermes-web-ui` / Ekko Studio.

## Panel

Open it from the ⊕ list in the right sidebar → **Open Hermes**. The strip on top switches between
three views and carries start/stop, restart and open-in-new-tab:

- **Dashboard** — the Hermes dashboard in an iframe, conversation on the left.
- **Record** — the Hermes ↔ DSH exchange, read from DSH's own session logs.
- **Setup** — health check, update, the DSH bridge, and the shared workspace.

Health and update run the `official-web` distribution's own PowerShell scripts. An upstream pip
install has neither, so those two buttons are disabled there and the panel says why. Everything
else works on any install.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @yang3333/dsh-hermes-panel
```

Then restart `dsh`: the host half is a Node module, and a page refresh does not reload it.

Needs DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` and an existing Hermes install — the plugin does not install Hermes, it
finds it or is told where it is. Windows only.

## Settings

Two directories, both optional. Empty means a default under the DSH home.

- **Runtime** — the Python environment Hermes runs in. Default `<dsh home>/hermes-panel/runtime`.
- **Data directory** — `HERMES_HOME`: profiles, sessions, `config.yaml`. Default
  `<dsh home>/hermes-panel/home`.

The rest: `dashboardPort` (0 = read from `.env`, else 9150), `sharedWorkspace`, `manageGateway`,
`autostart`.

Change them in the **Plugins** panel → **Official** → **Hermes Panel settings**.

## Bridge

With the bridge open, the panel writes the Hermes side (`mcp_servers.dsh`) into `config.yaml` and
checks that each profile's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` matches the running DSH. When one does not,
it prints the command that fixes it.

## Security

The HTTP routes are loopback-only and check `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`. `.env` parsing keeps only
`HERMES_HOME`, `VENV`, `HERMES_EXE` and `DASHBOARD_PORT`; no other value is stored. Do not bind DSH
to `0.0.0.0` while the plugin is enabled.

## Development

```sh
npm test          # hermetic; safe to run while Hermes is running
npm run test:e2e  # drives the real scripts and a real dashboard
```

The suite lives in `verify/`, one file per area, each with a comment saying what regression it
guards. `verify/smoke.mjs` loads the host half with an empty config, asserts it registers 17 routes
and that activation spawns nothing, then calls the status route with no Hermes installed.
`verify/config.mjs` checks that the config loads with all 6 fields volatile, that a value saved after
activation is what the panel reads, and that `.env` parsing keeps only the four whitelisted keys.

## License

MIT
