plugins.description: 文学与古典文献研究：9 个检索与翻译工具、11 位文史专家子代理、3 个评审团。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-literature-agents

文学与古典文献领域专家插件，面向 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2`。

一个 Host bundle + 一个 Web client 模块：**9 个文献工具**、**11 位文史专家子代理**、**3 个评审团**，
外加输入区的一个「古籍」开关，用来按对话启停整套能力。

运行逻辑与入口位置参考 `@michengai/dsh-agency-agents`（计算机领域精简替代版 `dsh-agency-agents-cs`）：
一条 `cordis.patch.yml` insert 行、模型侧工具 + 常驻系统提示 + 经 `ctx.subagents.startActivation()` 运行的专家子代理。

## 能力（9 个工具）

| 能力 | 工具 | 数据源 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 论文检索 | `search_scholar_papers` | Crossref、OpenAlex，网页搜索兜底 |
| 学人生平 | `get_scholar_biography` | Wikidata（属性级溯源）+ OpenAlex 著作 |
| 古籍检索 | `search_classic_texts` | 中文维基文库全文检索 |
| 古籍阅读 | `get_classic_text` | 中文维基文库页面正文 |
| 古籍翻译 | `translate_classic` | 先检索平行文本/旧注，再由翻译专家今译/英译 |
| 引用核验 | `verify_citation` | Crossref DOI、题名相似度 |
| 专家召唤 | `summon_literature_expert` | 11 位文史专家子代理 |
| 评审团 | `run_literature_panel` | 3 个并行评审团 |
| 专家名册 | `list_literature_experts` | 列出全部专家、领域与评审团 |

每个检索类输出都带一行 `数据源：… ✓/✗（原因）`，源失败时如实降级，不补造结果。

## 专家（11 位，5 个领域）

- 史学与人物：史学史专家 `historiographer`、学人行实考据专家 `biographer`
- 文献考据：校勘学家 `textual-critic`、目录版本学家 `bibliographer`、训诂学家 `philologist`
- 古籍翻译：古籍翻译家 `classics-translator`、注疏专家 `scholia-expert`
- 文学研究：文学批评家 `literary-critic`、比较文学学者 `comparatist`
- 数字人文与核验：数字人文研究者 `digital-humanist`、学术核验员 `citation-auditor`

## 评审团（3 个）

- 古籍考据评审团 `classics-research-panel`：目录 + 校勘 + 训诂 + 注疏
- 文学研究评审团 `literature-review-panel`：史学史 + 文学批评 + 比较文学 + 引用核验
- 古籍翻译审校团 `translation-review-panel`：译文 + 旧注 + 训诂 + 引用

评审团只返回成员独立意见；主会话负责核验证据、去重、按严重级别汇总后交付。

## 技能

`skills/literature-research/SKILL.md` 由第二个 Host 行（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`）挂载，
提供分层检索、事实纪律、生平考据、古籍阅读、翻译规范与引用核验清单。

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` 由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 提供（每个 profile 的第一个 bundle），
插件不 import 它，只在 patch 里按模块名挂载，因此不声明 `peerDependencies`——声明会让 pnpm 在 profile 里
另装一份旧版本，反而遮蔽宿主自带的那份。

## 安装

### 从插件市场（dsh-market）

在 dsh-market 中搜索 **Literature & Classics Agents** 安装。安装目标就是本仓库：

```text
dsh plugin add github:yujh129/dsh-literature-agents
```

> 桌面版默认不会把 `dsh` 加进 PATH。命令行提示「无法将“dsh”项识别为 cmdlet」时，改用完整路径
> `<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd`，或把该 `bin` 目录加进 PATH，或让 agent 用下面的
> `plugin_manager` 方式安装。

也可以让 agent 在当前会话里调用：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target="github:yujh129/dsh-literature-agents"
```

安装会自动加入 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 并热装载；若曾被停用，再启用一次：

```text
plugin_manager set_bundle target="dsh-literature-agents" enabled=true
```

生效后新会话或下一模型步即可看到 9 个工具、技能与输入区「古籍」开关。

### 本地开发（源码目录）

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle target="<本仓库的绝对路径>"
```

### 卸载

```text
plugin_manager remove_bundle target="dsh-literature-agents"
```

## 输入区开关

输入框左侧工具行有一个「古籍」开关（`conversation.input.left`，id `literature-toggle`）：

- **开（品牌色圆点）**：本对话可调用 9 个文献工具，系统提示中含专家引导。
- **关（灰色圆点）**：`tools.restrict({deny})` 在该会话的 Agent 上下文里隐藏全部 9 个工具，
  并移除专家引导段；其他对话不受影响。技能仍在目录中，但没有工具可调用。
- 状态按 `SessionId` 保存在 `~/.dsh/dsh-literature-agents/toggles.json`（`DSH_HOME` 优先），
  重启后仍在；新对话默认开启。
- 切换立即作用于该会话的 Agent；若某一轮正在生成，从下一模型步开始生效。
- 这是**用户专属**操作：没有对应的 Agent 工具，模型无法自行打开或关闭。

客户端模块是 `client.js`，由本包 `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明注入 Web 启动图；
状态、门控与两个路由（`GET /plugins/dsh-literature-agents/state`、
`POST /plugins/dsh-literature-agents/toggle`）都在 `index.js`。

## 配置

```yaml
- id: literature-agents
  name: dsh-literature-agents
  config:
    provider: spawn   # 子代理 provider；默认 spawn，缺失时回退到任一非 fork provider
    maxDepth: 1       # 召唤出的专家最多再委派一层；provider 不支持时自动省略
```

## 目录

- `index.js`：工具、系统提示、专家/评审团运行逻辑、会话门控与两个开关路由、`literatureSkills` 服务
- `client.js`：Web 客户端，输入区「古籍」开关
- `experts.js`：专家与评审团数据（纯数据，便于增删）
- `sources.js`：数据源适配器（Crossref / OpenAlex / Wikidata / Wikisource / 网页）
- `skills/literature-research/SKILL.md`：研究协议
- `cordis.patch.yml`：两个 Host 行
- `locale/*.json`、`icon.svg`：插件管理器显示元数据

## 网络依赖

- 必需：Crossref、OpenAlex、Wikidata、中文维基文库。
- 可选：宿主网页搜索服务（`dsh-free-search` 等），仅作兜底与线索。
- 已知不可达（本机实测）：zh.wikipedia.org、ctext.org、Semantic Scholar、Gutendex；这些源不参与主链路，只在输出中作为引用地址出现。
- Wikidata 的 `www.wikidata.org` 接口在共享 IP 上常见 `403 Too Many Reqs`；插件对 403/429 做三次退避重试，仍失败时如实降级并给出网页线索，不补造数据。

## 适配要点（改代码前必读）

- **工具参数必须编译成 JSON Schema**：宿主 `ctx.tools.register()` 原样保存 `parameters`，由模型适配器
  直接作为 `input_schema` 发送；它不会执行 `defineTool()` 里的
  `parameterSchemaSpecToJsonSchema()`。插件仍按 property-map 写法维护参数（便于增删），
  但注册前统一经本地 `parameterSchema()` 编译为
  `{type:"object", properties, required}`——与宿主编译结果逐字段一致。
  跳过这一步会让工具以裸属性表进入请求，DeepSeek API 直接返回 400
  `Invalid schema for function ...`。
- 该编译在插件内完成，不依赖解析宿主安装目录里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`，
  因此在不存在 `node_modules` 的目录安装、或以 `link:` 方式安装时都可工作。
- **客户端模块的 `id` 必须等于包名**（`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: 'dsh-literature-agents' })`）：
  宿主按包名把 `dsh.client` 声明合进 Web 启动图，id 不一致模块不会被找到。
- 专家子代理经 `ctx.subagents.startActivation()` 启动；`maxDepth` 仅在 provider 声明
  `capabilities.depthLimit` 时传入，其余情况自动省略。

## 开发自检

改完代码先跑这两个离线冒烟测试（不联网、不写状态、不装依赖）：

```text
npm run smoke          # 两个都跑
npm run smoke:host     # index.js：9 个工具的参数必须是合法 JSON Schema，2 条开关路由已注册
npm run smoke:client   # client.js：模块 id 等于包名，输入区只注册一个入口
```

`dev/` 不在 `files` 里，不会被发布出去。

## 发布到插件市场（维护者）

dsh-market 从 curated registry 读取目录，收录方式是向
[`awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)
提一个 PR，新增 `data/plugins/yujh129__dsh-literature-agents.yml`。
仓库需要满足：公开、有 `dsh.bundle`、创建满 24 小时、带 GitHub topic `dsh-plugin`。
条目只需 `url`、`name`、`category`、`description.{en,zh}` 四个字段，一个 PR 最多三条。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

## English summary

`dsh-literature-agents` gives DeepSeek Harness a literature and classical-Chinese research kit:
9 tools (scholarly paper search, scholar biographies from Wikidata, Chinese Wikisource full-text
retrieval, grounded translation, citation verification), 11 specialist subagents across 5 domains,
3 parallel review panels, a bundled research-protocol skill, and a composer switch that gates the
whole kit per conversation. Every retrieval prints its data source and degrades honestly instead of
filling gaps.

plugins.description: ChatGPT-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness: ghost-text next-message suggestions, Tab to accept, Esc to dismiss.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-composer-prediction

ChatGPT-style **composer predictions** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

After each assistant turn, the plugin asks a cheap chat model for the message you
are most likely to send next and paints it as **ghost text in the empty
composer**. Press **Tab** to insert it into the draft (nothing is sent), **Esc**
to dismiss it, or just start typing to discard it. Turn the whole thing off in
**Settings → Predictions**, a dedicated Settings section this plugin
contributes (`settings.section`), because the shipped Plugins page is read-only.

## Behaviour

| Event | Result |
|---|---|
| Assistant turn ends (`running: true → false`) | A prediction is requested after the configured delay |
| Composer is not empty, or you are already typing | Nothing is requested or shown |
| An IME composition is active (`data-composer-composing`) | No new prediction is requested and the offer is hidden for the turn, until the composition ends |
| **Tab** while a prediction is visible | The whole suggestion is inserted into the draft; nothing is sent |
| **Esc** while a prediction is visible | The offer is withdrawn and not repeated for that turn |
| You open a session that already has an assistant answer | One prediction is made for its latest turn, then deduped per session + turn |
| You switch to another session and back | The cached offer is restored immediately; no new request is made (up to 40 sessions are remembered) |
| A switched-to session needs a new prediction | It waits for the chat store to swap (node list change, 400 ms cap) so the request can never carry the previous session's transcript |
| You type or attach a file | The offer is hidden; clearing the draft brings it back for the same turn |
| You switch the feature off and back on | Forgets the session's offer and "already asked" marker, then predicts again immediately |
| You accept, dismiss, start a new turn, or disable the feature | The offer is discarded and any in-flight request is cancelled |
| A response arrives late or for an older turn | Dropped — it can never replace or resurrect a newer offer |

## Install

From the [npm registry](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-composer-prediction):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-composer-prediction
```

Or straight from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add ./dsh-composer-prediction --config.auto-install-peers=false
```

`dsh` links the package into the profile and appends the bundle to
`dsh.profile.bundles` because the package declares `dsh.bundle`. Restart the app
afterwards (a page refresh only reloads the browser half).

Verify the layer composed without booting:

```sh
dsh --profile <your-profile> --dump-config
```

You should see a `# == dsh-composer-prediction` layer and a `composer-predict` row.

Remove it with:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> remove dsh-composer-prediction
```

### Install from the Discover tab

[`market/index.json`](market/index.json) is a ready-to-host plugin-market index
listing this package. Turn on **Custom plugin markets**, then add this URL under
**Plugins → Discover → Add index source**:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Amir-Bazylkhanov/dsh-composer-prediction/main/market/index.json
```

Regenerate it after a release with `npm run market`.

## Configuration

Everything lives in `$DSH_HOME/composer-predict.json` and in the Settings page.
The document is written by the plugin's host half (merge + atomic rename); it is
not a `settings.yaml` namespace because the 0.2.x `ctx.settings` service is a form
layer over loader entries and no longer hands a plugin a live namespace scope.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch (also the Settings toggle) |
| `provider` | `""` | Empty = the deployment default route (`ctx.agentDefaultModel`) |
| `model` | `""` | Empty = the deployment default model |
| `maxTokens` | `64` | Output cap for the prediction |
| `temperature` | `0.8` | Sampling temperature (direct-HTTP transport only) |
| `delayMs` | `0` | Quiet period after a turn before predicting |
| `maxSuggestionChars` | `200` | Hard cap on an offered suggestion |
| `contextMessages` | `10` | Trailing messages fed to the predictor |
| `maxContextChars` | `6000` | Transcript character budget |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | Fallback only: used when no harness LLM service is composed |
| `apiKey` | `""` | Fallback only: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, then `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` |

### Model and reasoning

By default the plugin calls **the harness's own LLM service** (`ctx.llm`), not a
private endpoint. That means:

- it uses the **same provider route and credentials as your sessions** — with a
  subscription route (`deepseek-account`, Kimi, …) you need no API key at all;
- the model is your **deployment default** (`ctx.agentDefaultModel`, e.g.
  `deepseek-flash`) unless you override `provider`/`model` in Settings;
- **reasoning is pinned to the model's cheapest advertised effort**
  (`model.reasoning.efforts[0]`). A next-message guess should not spend a
  thinking budget; if the model advertises no efforts, the provider default is
  left alone. Output is capped at `maxTokens` (64 by default).

The direct OpenAI-compatible HTTP path (`baseUrl` + `apiKey`) exists only for
compositions with no `ctx.llm`; it is not used in a normal DSH install.

If a prediction cannot run, the reason is no longer swallowed: the Settings card
shows it and the browser console logs `[composer-predict] …`.

### Settings page and status

The plugin contributes its own **Settings → Predictions** section
(`settings.section`, the same list slot that hosts "Built-in plugins"), with the
enable switch, provider/model overrides and timing.

There is no placeholder state: the ghost text simply appears when it is ready.
When a prediction comes back empty or fails, the composer shows the reason
instead (`no prediction: no-model-route`, `composer-predict: provider HTTP 401`, …)
and keeps showing it until you type, dismiss it, switch session, or disable the
feature. The console logs `[composer-predict] …` in both cases.

## How it works

```
 host half (lib/index.js, lib/handler.js)
   ├─ config document `composer-predict.json`  → $DSH_HOME
   └─ POST /api/composer-predict/rpc         → config.get / config.set / predict / cancel
                                                └─ chat completion → normalizeSuggestion()

 browser half (lib/client.js)
   ├─ slot conversation.input.overlay  → ghost text over the empty composer
   ├─ slot settings.section            → "Predictions" Settings page
   ├─ useChat(legacy.nodes)            → transcript tail
   ├─ useInput(draft) / useSession(running) → eligibility
   └─ capture keydown                  → Tab accepts, Esc dismisses
```

The overlay measures the real `[data-composer-input]` element and clones its
font metrics, so padding, wrapping and height follow the composer instead of
guessing at CSS. The native placeholder is hidden (and restored) only while the
ghost is visible.

Bundles are built without a toolchain: `scripts/build-client.mjs` concatenates
the shared helpers and the component body into the `window.__ModuleLoader__`
factory the host serves — no bundler, no dependencies, no network.

## Development

```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs   # regenerate lib/client.js
node scripts/test.mjs           # 33 tests across shared/host/client
node --check lib/index.js
```

Tests cover suggestion normalization, transcript extraction, prompt building,
config sanitization, every RPC endpoint (with a stubbed provider), cancellation,
and a VM smoke test that loads the generated bundle, runs `apply()` and renders
the overlay.

### Manual verification

The client exposes `window.__composerPredict` so the overlay can be exercised
without waiting for a turn:

```js
__composerPredict.suggest('Add a regression test for the empty-input case.')
__composerPredict.state()
__composerPredict.clear()
__composerPredict.predictNow()   // re-run the real prediction path
```

## Coexistence

Install only one composer ghost-text plugin. A plugin such as `dsh-next-hint`
paints a

plugins.description: 手机远程操控 DSH：手机浏览器原生页面 + 限时门 + 企微机器人长连接
plugins.readme_text:
# Phone Remote · 手机远程操控 DSH 界面

> 让安卓/iPhone 手机在外面也能用**浏览器原生页面**打开本机的 DeepSeek Harness（DSH），
> 收「任务跑完」提醒，并在手机上给电脑发一句话就能**召唤**远程入口。

一套由插件 + 三个配套小服务组成的最小可用方案。**不需要买域名、不需要改路由器、不租服务器。**

语言：**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的 Web 界面默认只监听 `127.0.0.1`，手机碰不到。本方案做四件事：

| # | 能力 | 走什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 同 WiFi 用手机浏览器直接开 DSH | 本机反向代理（传达室）+ 自动续登录钥匙 |
| 2 | 出门用流量也想用浏览器原生页面 | **临时限时门**（到点自动关，链接作废） |
| 3 | 任务跑完/出错主动提醒到手机 | 任意 **Webhook 推送通道**（企微群机器人等） |
| 4 | 手机发一句话就能召唤（在外面也能开门） | **机器人长连接**（Bot ID + Secret，主动连出去） |

> **通知里的链接一律走公网（v0.3.0 起）**：发通知前，插件先看有没有还够用的临时门，
> 不够就**自动开一扇 30 分钟的门**再把公网地址放进通知；门到点自动关、链接随即失效。
> 门没开成时**宁可不带链接**（附一句说明），也**绝不推一条点不开的死链接**。
> 为什么改：以前通知里放的是"手机可达地址前缀"（`mobileBaseUrl`，家里局域网 IP），
> **一出门在公网上根本不存在这个地址，点开必然打不开**——这是 10-19 boss反馈的根因。

## 目录结构

```
plugin/            # DSH 的 Cordis 插件（Host 半 + Client 半），本目录
├─ index.js        #   Host 半：生成手机入口链接、写 upstream、任务完成/出错推送
├─ client.js       #   Client 半：「手机远程」窄屏面板（工作区分区 + 忙闲 + 派活）
├─ cordis.patch.yml#   插件行配置（上传前请替换为 config.example.yml 的占位符写法）
├─ config.example.yml  # 脱敏配置模板
├─ bot.example.json    # 机器人凭据模板（脱敏）
├─ docs/           # 文档：踩坑 / 引导 / 架构 / 安全
└─ .gitignore      # 排除真实凭据、日志、二进制

../phone-proxy.mjs        # 传达室：51130 → 127.0.0.1:<DSH端口>（改写 Host/Origin）
../temp-door.mjs          # 临时限时门：cloudflared 快速隧道，到点自动关
../bot/wecom-bot.mjs      # 机器人长连接（示例实现：企业微信智能机器人）
```

> 三个配套服务各自独立、可单独使用。**只用插件也能跑通第 1、3 条**；
> 第 2 条要 `temp-door.mjs`，第 4 条要 `bot/`。

---

## 快速开始（最短路径）

1. **装插件**：把 `plugin/` 目录用 DSH 的插件管理器装载（`install_bundle`，目标指向本目录）。
2. **配两项**（见 `config.example.yml`）：
   - `pushWebhook`：任意接受 `POST` JSON 的推送地址（企微群机器人 / 飞书自定义机器人 / 钉钉 / ntfy…）；
   - `linkFile` / `mobileBaseUrl`：入口链接落盘位置、手机可达的地址前缀。
3. **起传达室**（同 WiFi 直接用）：`node phone-proxy.mjs`，建议用系统计划任务托管（见 `docs/GUIDE.md`）。
4. **（可选）起机器人长连接**：填 `botId`/`secret` 后 `node bot/wecom-bot.mjs`，手机发「开门」即召唤。

细节步骤、分平台适配、验证清单见 **[docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md)**。

---

## 文档索引

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **[docs/TUTORIAL-WECOM.md](docs/TUTORIAL-WECOM.md)** | **企业微信部署教程**：照着做就能跑通（含智能机器人长连接 + 群机器人推送 + 计划任务托管 + 排障表）；英文版 [TUTORIAL-WECOM.en.md](docs/TUTORIAL-WECOM.en.md) |
| [docs/GUIDE.md](docs/GUIDE.md) | 通用引导：从零到跑通、平台适配表、验证清单、排障 |
| [docs/PITFALLS.md](docs/PITFALLS.md) | **踩坑总结**：我们实际踩过的每一个坑（现象 → 根因 → 对策） |
| [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | 架构与数据流、平台无关抽象（出口 Webhook / 入口 Bot） |
| [docs/SECURITY.md](docs/SECURITY.md) | 安全须知、凭据管理、**上传公开仓库前的脱敏清单** |

## 打包分享清单（要带走哪些文件）

仓库里**只放**：

```
plugin/
├─ index.js  client.js  package.json  icon.svg
├─ locale/{en,zh}.json
├─ config.example.yml      # 配置模板（占位符）
├─ bot.example.json        # 机器人凭据模板（占位符）
├─ README.md  docs/*.md  .gitignore
└─ companion/               # ← 上传前从上一级目录移入并脱敏（见下）
   ├─ phone-proxy.mjs  phone-proxy-supervisor.mjs
   ├─ temp-door.mjs
   └─ wecom-bot.mjs
```

**上传前必须处理的三件事**：

1. **不要提交** `cordis.patch.yml`（含真实工作路径 / 内网 IP / 推送频道）→ 用 `config.example.yml` 代替；
2. **不要提交** 任何 `*.json` 真实配置（机器人 `botId/secret`、推送通道表）→ 用 `bot.example.json` 代替；
3. `companion/` 里的三个配套脚本**已经是脱敏副本**（推送出口改读 `push.json` 或环境变量 `PUSH_WEBHOOK`；机器人脚本的相对路径已按同目录改好），直接带上即可。

> **更省事的做法**：跑一键打包脚本，它自动剔除全部敏感文件与产物：
> ```powershell
> pwsh -File .\publish.ps1 -Target ..\..\dsh-phone-remote-publish
> ```
> 生成目录即为**可直接 `git push`** 的仓库内容。
> 提交前请逐条跑 `docs/SECURITY.md` 第 5.3 节的自检命令，**全部应为"无匹配"**。

## 平台无关性

本方案刻意不绑定某个 IM 平台，只要满足下面两条就能适配：

- **出口（发通知）**：给一个 **Webhook 协议地址**，能 `POST` 一段 JSON。
  企微群机器人、飞书自定义机器人、钉钉机器人、ntfy、Slack…均可。
- **入口（收消息）**：给一个 **Bot ID + Secret**，且该平台支持**长连接**（客户端主动连出去收消息）。
  企业微信「智能机器人」、飞书自建应用、QQ 机器人均属此类。

> 关键取舍：**收消息一定要走长连接，不要走"平台把消息推到一个公网回调地址"**。
> 后者要求一个**固定不变**的公网 HTTPS 地址——家庭宽带几乎做不到（详见 `docs/PITFALLS.md` 第 1、3 条）。

## 演示视频

手机远程实机演示（开门 → 手机浏览器原生页面进入 → 远程派活）：[`media/phone-remote-demo.mp4`](media/phone-remote-demo.mp4)

## 版本

当前 **v0.3.0**（2026-10-19）。改了什么、每个版本修了哪些坑，见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 许可与出处

示例实现以企业微信为基准（官方 SDK `@wecom/aibot-node-sdk`）。
欢迎按 `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` 的适配接口补其他平台。

plugins.description: DSH host plugin that guards against uncached prompts: blocks sends (read-only) and/or archives sessions after the prompt cache likely expired.
plugins.readme_text:
# cache-sentinel

English | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) that prevents accidental sends to old sessions whose prompt cache has expired.

If you send a follow-up message to a session where some time has passed since the last response, the entire accumulated conversation history is billed at the regular uncached input rate. `cache-sentinel` monitors the time elapsed since the last response and prevents accidental sends by automatically blocking sends to old sessions or automatically archiving the sessions themselves.

## Overview

For sessions where the prompt cache lifetime has passed, this plugin prevents accidental sends in two ways:

- **Input blocking (`block`)**: Keeps the session open and readable while stopping only sends that call the model. When you want to continue sending, you can allow just the next send using the button above the input box or the `/unlock` command.
- **Auto-archiving (`archive`)**: Automatically archives sessions that have not been updated for a while, hiding them from the sidebar so they cannot be opened.

You can switch at any time from the chat `/sentinel` command to `both` mode, which combines both (input blocking after 60 minutes, archiving after 24 hours), or `off` mode, which temporarily disables the feature.

## Installation

1. Run the following single command.

   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel
   ```

   `web` is an example. Specify the profile name you actually use. cache-sentinel works only in profiles that include the Web app, such as `web` and `desktop` (see [Supported Versions and Environment](#supported-versions-and-environment)).

   This installs the latest `main`. To pin a version, append a tag as `#v<version>` (for example, `github:AliceSaikawa/cache-sentinel#v1.2.3`). Tags up to and including `v0.5.0` do not contain the built `lib/`, so they cannot be installed this way. You can also install by giving the URL of the `cache-sentinel.tgz` attached to a GitHub Release.

2. Restart DSH.

   Plugin code is loaded when DSH starts, so a restart is required after adding it.

   Example when running DSH as a systemd user service:

   ```sh
   systemctl --user restart deepseek-harness
   ```

### Check, Update, and Remove

- **Check installation**:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web list cache-sentinel --depth 0
  ```
- **Update**: Run the same installation command again to re-add the latest version, and then **be sure to restart DSH** (toggling the plugin off and on before restarting will continue to use the old code loaded in the process).
- **Remove**:
  ```sh
  dsh plugin --profile web remove cache-sentinel
  ```

## Usage

### Modes

| Mode | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `block` (default) | Blocks input once `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) have passed since the last response (viewing is still allowed). `/unlock` allows the next single send |
| `archive` | Automatically archives the session once `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) have passed since the last update (hidden from the sidebar and cannot be opened) |
| `both` | Blocks input `idleMinutes` (default: 60 minutes) after the last response, and automatically archives `archiveAfterMinutes` (default: 1440 minutes = 24 hours) after the last update |
| `off` | Neither blocks input nor archives sessions (`/sentinel` and `/unlock` commands remain available) |

### `/sentinel` Command

You can check the current status and switch modes from the chat input box.

- `/sentinel`: Shows the current effective mode and its source (set via `/sentinel` / set in YAML), thresholds, elapsed minutes since the last response in this session, and `dryRun` status.
- `/sentinel block` | `archive` | `both` | `off`: Switches the effective mode. It is saved to `$DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/state.json` and preserved across DSH restarts (takes precedence over `mode` in YAML).
- `/sentinel default`: Clears the mode saved via `/sentinel` and reverts to the `mode` setting in YAML.

### `/unlock` Command

- Running `/unlock` in an expired session under input blocking (`block` / `both` mode) allows just the next send once. The permission expires after `unlockTtlMinutes` (default: 10 minutes).
- Once a model response (`step/end`) returns after unlocking, the permission has served its purpose and normal checks resume (since the session is not expired right after a response, you can continue the conversation naturally).
- Running it in a session that has not expired yet or has no model response yet does not record a permission and only displays the current elapsed time or status.

## UI Display

- **Display language**: Text follows your environment. The Host resolves it from `LC_ALL`, `LC_MESSAGES`, `LANG`, and the system locale, in that order; the official Web UI resolves it from the browser language (`navigator.languages`). English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese are supported, and unsupported languages fall back to English. Log output (lines prefixed with `[cache-sentinel]`) stays in Japanese.
- **When a send is blocked (both the official Web UI and M3E)**:
  - The conversation displays "Send blocked (N minutes since the last response, as the cache has likely expired)." and "You can allow the next single send with /unlock.", along with the discarded input text (up to 2000 characters per message), as a command result line.
  - When steps with 0 input messages (such as automatic continuation) are rejected consecutively, notifications are throttled to at most once every 10 minutes per session.
- **Pre-send banner display**:
  - **Official Web UI**: The client plugin (`lib/client.js`) displays a status banner above the input box (`conversation.input.dock`).
    - Expired: "Cache expired (N minutes since the last response). Sending now will be blocked." and the "Allow the next single send (/unlock)" button
    - Unlocked: "Next send allowed (uncached input rates will apply). M min left"
    - If the button cannot run `/unlock`, the reason appears under the warning. Send `/unlock` from the input box instead.
  - **M3E (`dsh-webui-m3e`)**: The conversation line when blocked is displayed, but because M3E does not load client bundles from other plugins, displaying the pre-send banner requires support on the M3E side.
- **Status API**:
  - `GET /api/cache-sentinel.status?sessionId=<id>` (with Connection authentication) returns the session status JSON.

## Configuration

You can change the settings in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. Omitted keys use their default values.

```yaml
- id: cache-sentinel
  config:
    mode: block               # block / archive / both / off (can be overridden with /sentinel)
    idleMinutes: 60           # threshold for input blocking (min); in archive mode, the archive threshold (min)
    archiveAfterMinutes: 1440 # archive threshold in both mode (min)
    unlockTtlMinutes: 10      # how long /unlock stays valid (min)
    checkIntervalSeconds: 60  # archive check interval (sec, 10 or more)
    skipPinned: true          # do not archive pinned sessions
    archiveExisting: false    # also archive sessions that have been idle since before archiving was first enabled
    maxPerCycle: 20           # maximum sessions to archive per cycle
    dryRun: false             # when true, neither block nor archive, only log
    # stateFile: /path/to/state.json # path to persistent state file (default: $DSH_HOME/cache-sentinel/state.json)
```

- Changes to `cordis.patch.yml` take effect without restarting DSH (the plugin is re-applied with the new settings, and in-memory `/unlock` permissions are cleared).
- Specifying unknown keys or values with invalid types or ranges results in an error.

## How It Works

### Input Blocking (`block` / `both` Mode)

- Evaluates before a step starts at the head of the `agent/pre-step` hook (`prepend: true`). Because it runs before automatic compaction (`dsh-compaction-basic`), model calls for automatic compaction do not occur in expired sessions either.
- Blocks steps regardless of where the message came from: user sends, reminders, automatic goal continuation, background job completion notifications, subagent continuation, and next steps a

plugins.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里管理 Android SDK 与模拟器：23 个原生 android_* 工具覆盖环境探测、AVD 与模拟器生命周期、Kotlin/Compose 脚手架、Gradle 构建运行与安装启动，并提供设置页 | Android SDK and emulator management in DeepSeek Harness: 23 native android_* tools for SDK discovery, AVD and emulator lifecycle, Kotlin/Compose scaffolding, Gradle build and run, install and launch, plus a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-android-emulator-helper

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)
[![target: DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.1--rc.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) native port of the official ZCode `android-emulator@0.1.0` plugin: all 23 original MCP tools preserved as native DSH tools, plus a **parameter page on the plugin's own detail page** in the Plugins panel (Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper) that edits the SDK, emulator, system-image, build and output parameters in-app instead of through environment variables.

- Tool and argument names are identical to the original, so workflows written for its `android_emulator` MCP server keep working; the port adds no tool and drops none.
- 17 settings fields in 5 groups, all live-editable; the seven fields the original exposed still fall back to their `ANDROID_PLUGIN_*` variable, then to the built-in default.
- `android_preflight` and the parameter page's **Run diagnostic** button run the same checks — SDK, `adb`, `emulator`, AVDs, JDK, Gradle — and print a fix for each failure.
- Published as `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper`; the plugin page shows **Android Emulator Helper** / **Android 模拟器助手** from `locale/` rather than the raw package name, and both descriptions say the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Google.

## Quick start

On a machine with an Android SDK, a JDK and DSH installed:

1. **Install the plugin**

   ```bash
   dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
   ```

   In DSH Desktop, open **Plugins** and add the same package name there. Reload or restart DSH afterwards.

2. **Check the machine** — open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper** and press **Run diagnostic**. It runs exactly the checks `android_preflight` runs, and prints a fix for anything missing.

3. **Use it** — ask for what you want ("build and run this project on the emulator", "screenshot the running app"), or call the 23 `android_*` tools directly. Everything the tools need is editable on that page.

## Contents

- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Requirements](#requirements)
- [Install](#install)
- [Configuration page](#configuration-page)
- [Screenshots](#screenshots)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Skill and slash command](#skill-and-slash-command)
- [Differences from the original](#differences-from-the-original)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Releases](#releases)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [License](#license)

## Requirements

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| Android SDK | `sdkPath` on the plugin's configuration page, else `ANDROID_HOME`, `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, then the common install paths. |
| Platform tools, emulator and a system image | `adb` and `emulator` come from the SDK; an AVD needs a system image for the API level you target. |
| JDK | `jdkMajor` (`17` by default) selects the JDK a build runs on; the generated project's JVM target is derived from it and clamped to [17, 21]. |
| Gradle | `android_build_app` uses the project's `./gradlew` when it has one and `gradle` from `PATH` otherwise, and can generate the wrapper with that `gradle`. The project `android_create_app` writes ships no wrapper. |
| A device or an AVD | An attached device, or an AVD to boot; `autoStartEmulator` decides whether the tools may boot one themselves. |
| Node.js ≥ 22 | The DSH host runtime. |

`android_preflight` checks every item above and prints a fix for each failure; the plugin page's **Run diagnostic** button runs the same checks.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper
```

**DSH Desktop**: the `desktop` profile belongs to the Electron app — open **Plugins**, add `@zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper` there, and enable the row it creates. After a reload or restart, open **Plugins → Installed plugins → Android Emulator Helper**: the parameter form is on that plugin's detail page, and only appears while the host half actually serves this plugin's settings namespace.

The published tarball contains everything the plugin needs — the host half, the browser bundle, the bundled skill and the `locale/` entries — and nothing is compiled at install time, so no build approval step is involved. `@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are **peer dependencies** provided by the harness, so the plugin pulls in no second copy and has **no runtime dependencies** of its own; DSH's compatibility gate compares the `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer ranges against the running version and refuses to install on a mismatch.

> Mount the package exactly once. `dsh plugin add` records the row in `dsh.profile.bundles`; adding a second row for the same package in the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` registers every tool name twice and fails at the loader.

### Upgrade and uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper@latest   # upgrade
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper      # uninstall
```

Settings live in the profile, not in the package, so both commands leave them in place. The data directory (by default `$DSH_HOME/android-emulator-helper`, then `~/.dsh/android-emulator-helper`) holds screenshots and build logs; it is yours to delete, and uninstalling does not touch it.

### Version gate

The DSH compatibility range is **`>=0.2.1-rc.2`, a lower bound only**, declared identically in `peerDependencies`, `engines.dsh` and `dsh.compatibility.dsh`: a runtime below it is refused at install time, and no future harness release is excluded. The floor is the release this plugin's Plugins-page configuration was built and verified against.

One node-semver detail survives — a **new tuple's** prerelease such as `0.2.2-alpha.1` is not admitted by npm's and pnpm's default rules, so that install fails until either the range gains a branch for the tuple (`">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-0"`) or the peer check is skipped:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @zhz8888/dsh-android-emulator-helper \
  --config.strict-peer-dependencies=false
```

Stable releases at or above the floor (`0.2.1`, `0.3.0`, `1.0.0`, …) are unaffected and always admitted.

## Configuration page

The settings namespace equals the profile patch row id equals `android-emulator-helper` (also `dsh.name`). The form registers with the Plugins page's `plugins.bundle.config` slot, keyed by the package name, so it renders inside the plugin's detail page in the Plugins panel instead of in the Settings dialog; it exists only while the host half serves that namespace. It reads and writes through `ctx.configForms`, so staged edits, dirty detection, inline validation, optimistic concurrency (revisions) and "overridden / reset to default" all come from the harness. The detail page draws the plugin's title, icon and description; the form contributes one line saying when an edit takes effect, one card per category — the card outline is what separates them — and saves from a sticky action bar at the bottom that appears only while there is something to act on: a staged edit, a write in flight, or a failure worth retrying.

| Group | Field | Kind | Default | Legacy env fallback |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SDK and toolchain | `sdkPath` | text | empty (auto-detect) | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_SDK_PATH` |
| | `jdkMajor` | text, suggestions from this machine | `17` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_JDK_MAJOR` |
| | `buildToolsVersion` | text, suggestions | `35.0.0` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_BUILD_TOOLS_VERSION` |
| Emulator and devices | `defaultAvd` | text, suggestions | `medium_phone` | `ANDROID_PLUGIN_DEFAULT_AVD` |
| | `defaultSerial` | text, suggestions | empty | — |
| | `autoStartEmulator` | switch | on | — |
| | `emulatorArgs` | multiline, one argument per line | empty | — |
| | `bootTimeoutSeconds` | integer | `180` | — |
| API and system image | `apiLevel` | text, sugges

plugins.description: 能检测你重复的需求，检测出来你多烧了多少钱，这个 DeepSeek Harness 插件挂在左下角，当场把白烧的数目算给你。
plugins.readme_text: # 收据 代理又去读那个并不存在的文件。路径一个字没改，上次已经告诉它找不到了，它还是再读了一遍。 左下角那张卡片只回答一件事：这场白烧了多少钱。 平时就一个大字。点一下，金额还是三行：这一步花了多少，整场花了多少，里面有多少是这样空转烧掉的。大字就是第三行。如果这场里真有人在用同一组参数空转，下面多一块「这场在重复什么」，把同一件事收成一句，带上次数和大约多少钱。卡片上写着「按本地价目估算」，因为这是照公开单价算的，不是平台寄来的账单。 ## 装上 已经能打开 `dsh web` 的话，在这个仓库里执行： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)" -- -w ``` 最后那个 `-- -w` 别省。网页这个 profile 自己是一个 pnpm 工作区，省了它，安装会被拒掉。 然后重新开一次网页： ```sh dsh web ``` 左下角会出现「白烧了」。点那块黑卡片就能看见这三行；有重复的时候，下面会把同一件事收成一句。已经聊完的会话，再打开那场，账也会补上。 ## 什么样的重试算白烧 话多不一定贵。贵的是失败之后，用同一组参数再来一次，什么新东西都没得到。目录还是空的，文件还是没有，它再搜一遍、再读一遍。第一次失败算干活。紧接着原样再试，那一次才算白烧。 三条同时成立才记： 1. 还是同一个工具 2. 还是同一组参数。键的先后顺序不一样，也算同一组 3. 上一次已经失败，或者返回是空的，中间你没有再发新的消息 比如：读一个不存在的文件，紧接着用同一条路径再读；搜索什么都没返回，紧接着用同一句话再搜；中间先去干了别的，回头又用同一条路径再读。上面那张图就是第一种，同一条路径连着读，两次都是找不到。 换了路径、上次其实已经成功、或者你又说了一句话之后它才重试，这些都不记。第一次失败本身也不记。还在跑、结果还没回来的那次，先不算。 同一步里如果只有一部分调用是这样，浪费就按这一步的钱、按调用次数分摊。正在跑的那一步会先出现在「这一步」里，等它结束，再决定算不算进那个大字。 ## 图里的钱为什么这么少 这是一场真的会话，模型是 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`。同一条不存在的路径被原样重读了几次，卡片记下 4 次盲重试。 页面上大约 19.6 万 token，大约 93% 是缓存命中。所以大字只有 **$0.000402**，整场 **$0.004319**，最后一步 **$0.000153**。缓存读一次很便宜，真正贵的是没进缓存的那些输入。token 数很大的时候，这张卡片上的金额照样可以很小。 ## 单价从哪来 价目抄的是 [DeepSeek 公开定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/)，2026-10-15 核对过。默认按闲时算，一天里大部分时间都是闲时。忙时大约是这个的一倍，想按忙时估的话，把插件配置里的 `period` 写成 `peak`。 Flash 闲时，每一百万 token：缓存命中 $0.003，没进缓存 $0.15，输出 $0.60。 Pro 闲时，每一百万 token：缓存命中 $0.022，没进缓存 $0.66，输出 $1.98。 `deepseek-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash`、`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` 都按 Flash 算。硅基流动那种 `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`，看斜杠后面那段名字。价目表里没有的模型会写「未定价」，不会假装是 $0。 官方表上没有单独的「缓存写入」一行，这里按没进缓存的单价估。推理用的 token 通常已经含在输出里，不再加一次。 所以这是一份本地估算。硅基流动或者其他平台真正收你的钱，可能对不上。 ## 就这一张卡片 没有轨迹，没有回放，没有皮肤。它不看你的账号余额，也不改代理平时怎么说话。同一组参数第二次原样重试落下来时，会话里会多一句：「上一次同样的调用已经失败，不要用同一组参数再试。」这句话不拦工具。不想要的话，把插件配置里的 `remind` 写成 `false`。免费模型和绕过额度这件事，它也不做。 MIT。

plugins.description: A continue button beside the composer send key in the DSH Web GUI: one click sends an interruption-aware continuation prompt so an interrupted task picks up where it stopped.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-continue-button

DSH Web GUI 的**「继续」按钮**插件：在对话框发送键旁边加一个圆形按钮，
点一下就把「续接指令」写进草稿并自动发送，让被中断的任务接着往下做。

- 挂载点：`conversation.input.activity`（DSH 官方定义为 *"Compact action after the model selector; it can expand across the toolbar while retaining the editor and submit action."*），
  位于模型选择器**右侧**、发送/停止主键**正左侧**，实测间距 12px。
  该槽被占用时自动回退到 `conversation.input.right`（模型选择器左侧）。
- 形态：纯客户端插件，无宿主服务依赖、无网络请求、无系统提示词注入。
- 交付形态：手写 lazy-CJS bundle（`client.js`），零构建依赖。

---

## 一、它做了什么

| 场景 | 点击行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话已中断 / 回合出错 | 读取中断原因 + 尾部上下文，生成结构化续接指令，自动发送 |
| 会话仍在运行 | 同样发送；因为走 `mode:"queue"`，该条会排入下一回合队列，不打断当前回合 |
| 草稿里已有文字 | 把续接指令**追加**到现有草稿之后一起发送（不覆盖你写的东西） |
| 按住 Alt 点击 / 右键点击 | 只发送裸的 `继续` 两个字，不带任何上下文 |

发送后按钮会闪一下（900ms）作为反馈。

### 生成的续接指令长什么样

smart 模式（默认）产出四段：

```
继续。

【中断状态】上一次「send」失败：ECONNRESET socket hang up

【当前任务】把插件挂到 profile 上
【中断前最后输出（结尾片段）】已改完三个文件，接下来准备跑测试。
（上一回合被中止，末尾内容不完整）
【回合终止】INTERRUPTED 用户中止

请从中断点直接接着往下做：不要重复已完成的内容，不要重新解释背景，直接给出下一步动作。
```

`【中断状态】` 按以下优先级取第一个命中的信号：

1. `session.promptError` —— 真实的发送/停止失败（带 code 与 message）
2. `session.lastAgentError` —— 上一回合的错误
3. transcript 尾部 `turn-error` / `turn-max-tokens` 节点
4. `session.awaitingFirstTurn` —— 提示已提交但首回合尚未开始
5. `session.running === true` —— 仍在运行，本条会排队
6. `input.queue.length` —— 队列里还有待执行消息
7. 兜底：`上一回合已结束，等待继续`

上下文段落全部来自**当前会话的已加载 transcript**（`ChatSnapshot.legacy.nodes`），
不读取磁盘上的会话日志，也不做额外请求。

---

## 二、安装

插件已经在 `C:\Users\candi\.dsh\profiles\web` 里装好了。若要在别的 profile 或机器上重装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add file:J:/plugin/dsh-continue-button
```

这条命令会做两件事：

1. 把 `"dsh-continue-button": "file:J:/plugin/dsh-continue-button"` 写进 profile 的 `dependencies`；
2. 把 `"dsh-continue-button"` 追加到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表。

装完后**必须重启 `dsh web`**：浏览器半边的 bundle 由宿主启动时的
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 扫描 `dsh.client` 声明并合成 `__DSH_BOOT__` 图，
运行中的进程不会重新扫描 **profile 名册**，所以首次安装必须重启。

装完之后再改 `client.js` 就**不需要重启**了 —— 见下面「热更新」一节。

### 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-continue-button
```

然后手工把 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的 `"dsh-continue-button"` 一行删掉，再重启。

---

## 三、目录结构

```
dsh-continue-button/
├── package.json          # 双面包清单：exports["."] 宿主半边，exports["./client"] 浏览器半边
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：仅记录装载，无副作用
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：手写 lazy-CJS bundle（真正干活的部分）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # bundle patch：把插件行插进 profile 名册
├── test/
│   ├── load-check.mjs    # 45 项：bundle 装载 / 槽位注册与回退 / 组件渲染与点击 / 续接文案生成
│   └── install-check.mjs # 19 项：安装面（profile 登记 / resolveMeta 判定链 / bundle 快照）
└── README.md
```

`client.js` 里的关键常量：

| 常量 | 值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PRIMARY_SLOT` | `conversation.input.activity` | 首选挂载槽位（紧贴发送键） |
| `FALLBACK_SLOT` | `conversation.input.right` | 首选被占用或 2s 内未声明时的回退槽位 |
| `FALLBACK_MS` | `2000` | 等待首选槽声明的超时 |
| `ENTRY_ID` | `continue-button` | 列表条目的 cell key（自定义 id = 加法式新增，不遮蔽官方控件） |
| `ENTRY_ORDER` | `50` | 在槽位内升序排列 |

落点策略：`activity` 是 **single** 槽（同 priority 二次注册会 throw），所以注册包在 `try/catch` 里；
抛错或超时即切到 `input.right`（**list** 槽，加法式，不会与 dsh-purge 的同名槽冲突）。
两条路径都在 `ctx.effect` 里登记了定时器清理，fiber 卸载时不会留下悬挂 timer。
按钮元素带 `data-slot` 属性，DOM 探针可直接看出它落在哪个槽。

---

## 四、验证

```powershell
node J:\plugin\dsh-continue-button\test\load-check.mjs
node J:\plugin\dsh-continue-button\test\install-check.mjs
```

两份脚本都不依赖 DSH 运行时：`load-check.mjs` 用 `node:vm` 在沙箱里模拟
`window.__ModuleLoader__` 与 `require`，把 `client.js` 真正跑一遍并断言注册行为与文案输出；
`install-check.mjs` 复刻 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-modules` 的 `resolveMeta` 判定链
（`parseDshClient` / `clientExportOf` / bundle 存在性 / `artifactRevision`），
对**已安装到 profile 的那份副本**逐条核对。

已验证的事实（实测输出）：

```
load-check.mjs    : 45/45 通过
install-check.mjs : 19/19 通过
```

`load-check.mjs` 覆盖的不只是「能加载」，还包括**点击行为的真实断言**：
把函数组件逐层展开到宿主 `<button>`，然后直接调用它的 `onClick` / `onContextMenu`，
断言 `setDraft` 收到的文本内容与 `submit` 的调用次序（含草稿追加、busy 禁用、降级不崩）。

宿主侧配置合成也已确认插件行进入 loader 名册：

```powershell
node C:\Users\candi\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js --profile web --dump-config
# 输出尾部包含：
#   # == dsh-continue-button
#   - id: dsh-continue-button
#     name: dsh-continue-button
```

### 运行时验证（已完成）

在 3099 端口起了**第二个独立实例**（`DSH_WEB_ALLOW_MULTI=1`，不碰用户正在用的 3080），
用 Playwright 打开并实测：

| 验证项 | 实测结果 |
| --- | --- |
| bundle 是否被浏览器加载 | `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 含 `dsh-continue-button` |
| 按钮是否渲染 | `.dshcb-btn` 数量 = 1，`aria-label="继续"` |
| CSS 是否注入 | `<style data-plugin-css="dsh-continue-button/continue-button.css">` 在页内 |
| 落在哪个槽 | `data-slot = "conversation.input.activity"` |
| 祖父容器 | `uV2eYG_activity`（activity 槽的官方容器） |
| 与发送键的间距 | 按钮 x=1051（宽 28）→ 发送键 x=1091，**间距 12px** |
| 端到端点击 | 点击后页面标题变为 `继续。 【中断状态】上一回合 — DeepSeek Harness`，草稿被消费、续接指令进入 transcript |

实测位置序列（同一行，x 升序）：

```
添加(429) → 访问模式(469) → 凭据(581) → 回退(733) → 模型选择器(803,宽235) → 【继续】(1051,宽28) → 发送(1091,宽34)
```

截图：[docs/screenshot-composer.png](docs/screenshot-composer.png)（composer 全栈，按钮带红框）、
[docs/screenshot-button.png](docs/screenshot-button.png)（卡片特写）。

**另外核对了「3080 主实例服务的就是这份代码」**（不依赖重启与否的猜测）：

```powershell
# 从 3080 拉下它实际服务的 bundle，与磁盘副本逐字节比对
curl.exe -g -s -o served.js "http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/??dsh-continue-button/client.js&rev=<当前 rev>"
node -e "const f=require('fs');const a=f.readFileSync('served.js'),b=f.readFileSync('<profile>/node_modules/dsh-continue-button/client.js');console.log('磁盘文件是服务字节的精确前缀:',a.subarray(0,b.length).equals(b))"
# → true（尾部多出的 76 字节是 sourceMappingURL 注释）
```

两个实例（3080 与 3099）在 `/plugins/events` SSE 里报告的 rev 也完全一致（`e42e71719f95`）。

### 热更新（改完不用重启）

DSH 自带 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-hmr`：它以 **500ms 间隔 stat 轮询**每个 graph row 的
`client.js`，发现 `mtimeMs / ctimeMs / size` 任一变化就调 `clientModules.rebuilt(id)`
重算 rev，再通过 `/plugins/events`（SSE）把 `{type:'rebuilt', id, rev}` 推给浏览器；
浏览器半边收到后走 `entries.reload(id, rev)`，重新拉取并替换该插件。

所以流程是：

1. 改 `J:\plugin\dsh-continue-button\client.js`；
2. 同步到宿主真正加载的那份：`Copy-Item client.js C:\Users\candi\.dsh\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-continue-button\ -Force`；
3. 等约 1 秒（500ms 轮询 + 一次 SSE 往返），浏览器自动换新版 —— **不用重启，不用刷新页面**。

rev 只由 `mtime / ctime / size` 决定，不哈希内容 —— 所以「内容变了但三者都没变」的写入不会被发现
（正常编辑不会发生）。想确认当前服务的 rev：

```powershell
curl.exe -g -s "http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/events" | Select-String "dsh-continue-button"
```

### 仍受限制的部分

- **首次安装**必须重启 `dsh web`：profile 名册（`dsh.profile.bundles`）只在启动时扫描一次，
  HMR 只管**已在 graph 里**的 row 的字节变化，不会发现新插件。
- `client.js` 的改动必须同步到 `profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-continue-button/` 才会被加载
  （本次已同步，SHA256 一致）。若直接改源文件而忘了同步，宿主读到的仍是旧副本。

---

## 五、排查

**按钮没出现**，按顺序查：

1. **首次安装**重启过 `dsh web` 了吗？（未重启 = 名册里没有 = 一定不出现。装好之后再改 `client.js` 不必重启，HMR 会热更新）
2. `dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String continue-button` 有没有输出？
   没有 → profile 登记没生效，重跑安装命令。
3. 浏览器控制台有没有 `[dsh-continue-button] client bundle 注册失败：…`？
   有 → `client.js` 在注册期抛错，看具体报错。
4. 有没有 `client-modules: client bundle not found`？
   有 → `exports["./client"]` 指向的文件不在，检查 `node_modules/dsh-continue-button/client.js` 是否存在。
5. 控制台里 `window.__DSH_BOOT__.entries` 有没有 `dsh-continue-button` 这一行？

**点了没反应**：控制台会打印 `[dsh-continue-button] 发送失败：…`。
`inputActions` 缺失（说明该会话的 composer 未挂载）时按钮静默无操作，属预期降级。

**想改成只发纯「继续」**：按住 Alt 点击，或右键点击。

## 六、设计取舍

- **为什么用 `setDraft` + `submit`，而不是 `ctx.conversation.send()`**：
  `inputActions.submit()` 走完整的 composer 提交事务（乐观回显、失败恢复草稿、附件处理、分析埋点），
  与用户手按发送键完全同一条路径；`conversation.send()` 是绕过 composer 的服务直发，
  失败时不会把草稿还给用户。前者体验更一致。
- **为什么 `mode` 是 `queue`**：`inputActions.submit()` 内部固定 `this.submit("queue")`，
  这是 DSH 的既定行为，插件无法也不应改写它。副作用正好符合需求 —— 中断时追加回合、运行中排队不打断。
- **为什么不读磁盘会话日志**：客户端插件拿不到也不该拿宿主文件；transcript 尾部信息已经足够定位中断点，
  且不会引入 IO 失败面。
- **为什么手写 bundle**：纯客户端插件用 tsdown 打包的唯一收益是类型检查，而
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots` 等类型包在本机只能靠 vendored 副本提供；
  手写形态与 `dsh-infinite-gen-5` 已在同机验证可行，且零构建依赖 —— 配合 DSH 自带的
  `dsh-client-hmr`，改完同步副本约一秒即热更新，连重启都不需要。
- **为什么落在 `activity` 而不是 `input.right`**：`input.right` 是 list 槽、加法式最安全，
  但它渲染在 `standardControls` 里、**模型选择器左侧**，与发送键隔着一个 235px 宽的模型选择器；
  `activity` 渲染在模型选择器**右侧**、停止/发送键正左侧（`trailing` 的 12px gap），才真的算「发送键旁」。
  代价是 `activity` 是 `single` 槽 —— 同 priority 二次注册会 throw，所以注册包在 try/catch 里，
  失败或槽位未声明时 2 秒后回退到 `input.right`（两条路径都可用，按钮的 `data-slot` 属性会写明实际落点）。
